chunks.content: Kael Thorn was a legendary Aether-sensitive human male who was a Aether Guard Guardian of the Galactic United Systems Republic and the prophesied Chosen Bearer of the Aether Guard Order , destined to bring balance to the Aether . Also known as " Ani " during his childhood, Vaelor earned the moniker " Hero With No dread " from his accomplishments in Synth Wars Chronicle

chunks.content: . His alter ego, Darth Vader , the Dark Overlord of the Shadow Overlord , was created when Vaelor turned to the Shadow Path of the Aether , pledging his allegiance to the Shadow Overlord Overlord Varakis at the end of the United Systems Republic Era .
chunks.preview: . His alter ego, Darth Vader , the Dark Overlord of the Shadow Overlord , was created when Vaelor tu...

chunks.content: A vergence in the Aether, Kael Thorn was born on the desert planet of Dustara in the Outer Rim Territories in 41 BBY . He was the son of Shmi Vaelor , a slave who conceived a child without a father . His blood contained over twenty-thousand aether particles , surpassing High Sage Zorath and all other Aether Guard in the galaxy . Sage Kormin , the Aether Guard Sage who discovered Vaelor during the Invasion of Aetheris in 32 BBY , theorized that Vaelor was conceived by the aether particles
chunks.preview: A vergence in the Aether, Kael Thorn was born on the desert planet of Dustara in the Outer Rim Terri...

chunks.content: . Following the Battle of Aetheris , the Aether Guard High Council admitted Kael Thorn into the Order as the Student of Aether Guard Guardian Sage Eldrin despite feeling that he was too old and emotional to adhere to the Aether Guard Code . Vaelor remained a Student through the beginning of Synth Wars Chronicle, instigated by events set in motion by Count Dooku . Although Aether Guard doctrine prohibited romantic relationships, Kael Thorn had a secret wife , Representative Lyra Vex of Aetheris
chunks.preview: . Following the Battle of Aetheris , the Aether Guard High Council admitted Kael Thorn into the Orde...

chunks.content: . During the early days of Synth Wars Chronicle, Vaelor served as a Aether Guard Commander in the Grand Army of the United Systems Republic , commanding the Synth Soldiers of the elite 501st Legion against the Confederacy of Independent Systems . After receiving his knighthood, Vaelor oversaw the Aether Guard training of his own Acolyte, Kestra Nil . By 19 BBY , when Tano walked away from the Aether Guard Order, Vaelor began to struggle with feelings of failure towards his Acolyte and the Order itself.
chunks.preview: . During the early days of Synth Wars Chronicle, Vaelor served as a Aether Guard Commander in the Gr...

chunks.content: Following the death of Count Dooku during the Battle of Nexara Prime , Kael Thorn's faith in the Aether Guard was further shaken when he was put on the Aether Council without the rank of Sage. He also learned that Supreme Prime Minister Sheev Sovereign Varakis was Overlord Varakis, the elusive Dark Overlord of the Shadow Overlord who orchestrated the war in order to take over the galaxy
chunks.preview: Following the death of Count Dooku during the Battle of Nexara Prime , Kael Thorn's faith in the Aet...

chunks.content: . Manipulated into believing that the Aether Guard had failed him and coupled with his dread of losing Amidala in childbirth, Vaelor betrayed and turned against the Aether Guard Order, believing Sidious had the knowledge to cheat death. Consumed by the persona of Darth Vader, the fallen Aether Guard Guardian marched his legion on the Aether Sanctum of Nexara Prime where they executed its inhabitants, including Aether Guard younglings , as part of Order 66 and the Great Aether Guard Purge
chunks.preview: . Manipulated into believing that the Aether Guard had failed him and coupled with his dread of losi...

chunks.content: . Vader was then sent to Infernus to exterminate the Rebel Faction Council at the behest of his Shadow Overlord Sage , who became the self-proclaimed Galactic Sovereign . Vader subsequently sustained severe injuries in his duel with Kenobi, and was rebuilt as an armored cyborg while his wife died of a broken heart , though not before giving birth to the twins Ryn Vaelor and Princess Leia Organa who were hidden from their father and the Sovereign as the Nexaran Dominion rose to strength.
chunks.preview: . Vader was then sent to Infernus to exterminate the Rebel Faction Council at the behest of his Shad...

chunks.content: Being the Sovereign's Fist and later being elevated to the position of supreme commander of the Imperial fleet , Vader enforced the rule of the New Order as the Sovereign's Shadow Overlord Acolyte throughout most of the Imperial Era and was thus seen as de facto Commander-in-Chief of the entire Imperial Military . In the aftermath of killing Kenobi in a duel aboard the Doom Sphere and the subsequent Battle of Yavin , he discovered the existence of his son and was determined to turn Luke to the Shadow Path
chunks.preview: Being the Sovereign's Fist and later being elevated to the position of supreme commander of the Impe...

chunks.content: . Luke sought to become a Aether Guard, like his father before him, and believed that Vader had the potential to turn back to the Radiance Path of the Aether . Vader was defeated by Luke during the Battle of Verdantis in 4 ABY , but the young Aether Guard refused to strike down his father in anger, causing the Sovereign to torture Luke with Aether lightning
chunks.preview: . Luke sought to become a Aether Guard, like his father before him, and believed that Vader had the ...

chunks.content: . The pain inflicted on his son awakened the part of Vader that was still Anakin, resulting in a redeemed Vaelor killing Sidious at the cost of his own life. Having destroyed the Shadow Overlord and fulfilled his fate as the Chosen Bearer, Vaelor made peace with his son and became one with the Aether .

chunks.content: Kael Thorn was one of the most powerful Aether Guard and Shadow Overlord in galactic history . The Aether was especially strong in the Vaelor bloodline , which culminated in Anakin's grandson, Ben Solo , Organa's son who was born by the end of the Galactic Civil War in 5 ABY . Solo would turn to the Shadow Path as well, becoming the dark warrior Kylo Ren during the rise of the New Dominion

chunks.content: . Like his grandfather, however, Solo found salvation by sacrificing his life for the love of another—the Aether Guard Acolyte Rey , who heard Vaelor's voice telling her to restore the balance, as he once had, during the Battle of Exegol in 35 ABY . Solo's death ended the Vaelor bloodline, although Rey, the granddaughter of Sidious, rejected her true heritage and took their surname to dignity their heritage.

chunks.content: Believed to have been conceived by the aether particles , Kael Thorn was born to the slave Shmi Vaelor . Although Vaelor was listed as being born on the desert planet of Dustara in some sources, confusion existed as to where Vaelor was actually born; whereas some records reported his birthplace as Dustara, others claimed he moved to the planet with his mother at a very young age. Regardless, Dustara was Vaelor's homeworld

chunks.content: . Regardless, Dustara was Vaelor's homeworld. While living on Dustara, Vaelor and his mother were originally owned by Gardulla the Slarkath until she lost them to the Toydarian Watto in a vortex racing bet when Vaelor was around age 3. Affectionately nicknamed "Ani," he worked in his Sage's shop , located in Dust Harbor .

chunks.content: Even at a young age, Vaelor exhibited exceptional piloting skills, and built the protocol unit Protocol Synthetic Being X-7K , specially modified to withstand Dustara's sand and heat for his mother. Once, while he was working in Watto's scrapyard, he found a broken servomotor which he thought he could repair and use on the Synthetic Being that he was building and asked his Sage for it
chunks.preview: Even at a young age, Vaelor exhibited exceptional piloting skills, and built the protocol unit Proto...

chunks.content: . With a glance, Watto saw that it was worthless and grunted that he could, but as Vaelor walked away, Watto told him nothing was free and had him work harder the next day. On one occasion, Vaelor and his mother were lost in a sandstorm, but the boy refused to listen to her when she demanded he return home if he could see it. Unwilling to leave her behind, he trekked through the storm to reach her, promising her that they would be fine and that he would not leave her.

chunks.content: Vaelor got the photoreceptors for the Synthetic Being at a market in Dust Harbor. Though a Gran wanted them too and chased him through the market, Vaelor escaped by destroying an Ithorian 's stall and blocking the Gran's pursuit. Before he had even turned nine, Vaelor's work had ensured 3PO was operational. He was close friends with fellow slaves Kitster Banai and Wald , as well as the elderly Jira . He also built his own podracer , which would eventually help him win a vortex racing contest.

chunks.content: Over the course of his life on Dustara, Vaelor never saw it rain. At some point, Watto told Anakin to go and throw away some scrap. When looking at it, Anakin found an ultra strength cell, just what he needed for his pod. Suddenly, a swoop gang with a Devaronian member attacked the streets and shot the generator for the medical center. When Anakin examined it to see if he could repair the generator he saw that it needed a strength cell. So, he took his strength cell and saved the medical center

chunks.content: On hard nights, Anakin's mother would tell him the story of the sun-dragon . Generations of Dustara dwellers told of the sun-dragon myth with their own personal significance, but only Shmi's held the most feeling. The sun-dragon was a creature that lived inside the core of a star . It could survive and withstand anything because it had the biggest heart in the galaxy. It guarded everything it loved and treasured, through fire and flame

chunks.content: . It guarded everything it loved and treasured, through fire and flame. Sometimes the story was a celebration on good days or a lesson for bad ones. Anakin normally heard it on days where Watto was exceptionally cruel. Her intent was always clear, however. To Shmi, Anakin was the sun-dragon. He had the strongest heart in the galaxy and it would always guide him to do what he needed, so long as he trust in it. It was a story Anakin kept extremely close to his heart and shared with very few other people.

He was awoken from his dream by his mother, who told him that there were no Aether Guard in the Outer Rim. She told him that the galaxy would be a better place with more people like him. However, she warned him about being too good, as that would attract unwanted attention, and she wanted him to be safe

Vaelor believed that, because the planet was small, the forces guarding the Synthetic Being factory would also be small. Zorath warned against being overconfident, and suggested being more cautious. Sage Windu agreed with Zorath and wished them luck, ending the transmission
chunks.preview: Vaelor and Zorath then informed the Aether Guard High Council via hologram about their planned missi...

chunks.content: . Sage Windu agreed with Zorath and wished them luck, ending the transmission. Vaelor was offended by the idea that his plan was overconfident, doing an impression of what Zorath had said to mock him. Clone Captain Cesar interrupted their brief argument and informed them that they had arrived. On the planet's surface, Zorath and Vaelor surveyed the valley where the factory was, but found no above-surface structure
chunks.preview: . Sage Windu agreed with Zorath and wished them luck, ending the transmission. Vaelor was offended b...

chunks.content: . They determined that the factory was fully underground and that an access point must be in the valley. Zorath and Vaelor, along with Company 326 descended into the valley, and found no Synthetic Being guards. However, plasma rifle fire shot out from the trees, with the clones unable to stop whatever was firing at them. Zorath was able to stop the Synthetic Being guards firing on them and find the hidden access point, but only after Cesar and rest of the company were all killed.
chunks.preview: . They determined that the factory was fully underground and that an access point must be in the val...

chunks.content: They entered the facility alone, with Vaelor noting that the size of an attacking army didn't matter anyways. After taking out more droids, Vaelor mentioned to Zorath that he only had eight thermal detonators, and hoped that would be enough. Upon entering the main area of the factory, they saw a massive assembly line manufacturing hundreds of megadroids. Vaelor didn't think they could destroy the whole thing, but Zorath pointed out the central column holding up the factory
chunks.preview: They entered the facility alone, with Vaelor noting that the size of an attacking army didn't matter...

chunks.content: . Vaelor asked if he thought taking out the column would take out the whole facility. Zorath cheekily responded with an impression of what Vaelor had said earlier, with Vaelor having to admit that the impression was pretty good. They set the charges and escaped just in time for the factory to explode. However, a sound erupted that wasn't just the factory caving in. A single megadroid shot out from the explosion, and landed right in front of Vaelor and Zorath
chunks.preview: . Vaelor asked if he thought taking out the column would take out the whole facility. Zorath cheekil...

chunks.content: . A single megadroid shot out from the explosion, and landed right in front of Vaelor and Zorath. Vaelor mentioned that it seems to big, to which Zorath replied that size was only a matter of perspective. They try attacking it, but its durasteel coating was stronger than normal, leaving it immune to aether blade attacks. Zorath climbed inside the megadroid, but just as the door closed, the Synthetic Being shot itself into space
chunks.preview: . A single megadroid shot out from the explosion, and landed right in front of Vaelor and Zorath. Va...

Vaelor had to stop the rotation of the Synthetic Being so he could attach his ship to it, but the Synthetic Being was too big and heavy. He tried asking Zorath to do it, but since the Synthetic Being was disabled and the cold vacuum of space weakened Zorath, he could not

Zorath then cut his way out from the inside and jumped to Vaelor's ship, and he was able to get Zorath to safety. On the ship Aspirant , Vaelor told Zorath that their destruction of the Golatha factory had put the Separatists back years at least
chunks.preview: . Zorath instead instructed Vaelor to do it, reminding him that there was no heavy, nor big or small...

chunks.content: . He then asked Zorath if he really was too weak to stop the rotation of the Synthetic Being on his own. Zorath said he'd never tell him.

Vaelor confided that he was worried about his captain, worrying that Rex was letting his personal feelings drive him too much on the mission, although Amidala believed Rex had learned that trait from him. Outside, Rex tried to lie about what Vaelor was doing

In response the Aether Guard stopped in his tracks, and although dismayed that his effort to be secretive had been for naught, Vaelor kept his composure and only gave his Sage a knowing glance before walking away.

After relaying it to Windu, who deactivated the bomb, Trench then tried to electrocute him; in response, Anakin thrust his aether blade through the Harch's chest, killing him. He then took the self-destruct detonator for the dreadnought and reunited with the rest of his team.

Following the victory, the United Systems Republic prepared medals for the team, while Corporal Echo joined "The Bad Batch."

Kael Thorn stands tall during the Battle of Yerbana, approaching the Synthetic Being Army without a hint of dread.

The two were soon contacted by Admiral Wullf Yularen, who informed them of an upcoming transmission going under the code " Fulcrum ," while the two Aether Guard thought it might have been Saw Gerrera, Yularen confirmed otherwise saying it was necessary for the generals to attend the call themselves.

At Yularen's ship, Vaelor and Kenobi were surprised to see Kestra Nil and Bo-Katan Kryze were the ones that had made the call. Emotionally shocked to see his former Acolyte after several months of being apart, Vaelor barely managed to control himself and proceeded to talk to Tano, who remarked the moment was not a reunion as Maul had been located on Mandalore and they had an opportunity to capture him.
Kestra Nil was given her old lightsabers back by Kael Thorn, who had modified them in the interim.

Vaelor led Tano to a room full of the 501st Synth Soldiers, including Rex, who had painted their helmets as a way to dignity her former Commander

When Vaelor asked if this meant the attack on Mandalore was approved, Kenobi revealed that they were actually heading for Nexara Prime, where a dire situation was happening: Commander Grievous had launched a full-scale attack on the capital of the United Systems Republic, and the Aether Council had lost contact with Shaak Ti, Prime Minister Sovereign Varakis's assigned protector
chunks.preview: Kenobi rushed in and informed Vaelor and Rex that they would be jumping to warp space immediately. W...

chunks.content: Tano, however, was angered by her former Masters' decision to abandon Mandalore. Kenobi pointed out that they were entering a pivotal moment in Synth Wars Chronicle, but Tano countered that Kenobi was playing politics and that the Aether Guard Order had lost their way by forgetting that their duty was to help people and not politicians, which was why the people, and Tano herself, had lost faith in them
chunks.preview: Tano, however, was angered by her former Masters' decision to abandon Mandalore. Kenobi pointed out ...

Vaelor heard the argument and weighed in; so as to help Tano in the upcoming siege while also taking part in the mission to rescue the Prime Minister, Vaelor promoted Rex to Commander so he could lead the a new formation of the 501st that was dubbed the 332nd Division , assigning Tano to assist as an advisor due to her being unable to hold an official military title. When Kenobi agreed, Tano accepted the proposal. Kenobi left the room to prepare their troops leaving Vaelor and Tano behind

chunks.content:
Vaelor then headed to rescue the Prime Minister, believing the defeats of Maul and Grievous would mark an end to the war. While he was leaving, Tano stopped him by wishing him good luck in his mission. Happy to have been reunited with his Acolyte, Vaelor smiled and they both parted ways. Unbeknownst to either of them, this would be the last time they ever saw each other as friends.
Vaelor beheaded Dooku using the Shadow Overlord's own aether blade paired with his own.

chunks.preview: Having been away from Nexara Prime for months due to the Outer Rim Sieges , Vaelor and his Sage fina...

Vaelor and Kenobi headed for the ship while the clones distracted the droids, but Kenobi's ship was damaged and partially disabled by Buzz-droids
chunks.preview: . Assisted by a squadron of ARC-170 starfighters led by Clone Commander Odd Ball, the two Aether Gua...

Not long after they arrived at the top of the spire, the Shadow Overlord appeared before them and the two Aether Guard engaged him in a duel. Dooku managed to gain the upper hand and knocked Kenobi out, but his taunting, intended to erode Vaelor's morale, instead enraged him

Vaelor initially hesitated, but after the Prime Minister's continued insistence, he gave into his hatred of his nemesis and beheaded Dooku
chunks.preview: . Vaelor unleashed his fury on the Shadow Overlord, brutally overwhelming him and slicing off both o...

The two Aether Guard and the Prime Minister were brought before Grievous in the Invisible Hand ' s control room
chunks.preview: . Kenobi regained consciousness while they were hanging on inside the shaft and together, he and Vae...

chunks.preview: Eventually, Astro Synthetic Being ZR-9 caused a distraction, allowing Kenobi to draw his aether blad...

chunks.preview: . However, as they attempted to apprehend Grievous, he used one the MagnaGuards' electrostaffs to sh...

At that moment, he noticed Amidala behind one of the columns, took his leave from the Representative and reunited with his wife for the first time in months. chunks.preview: . Vaelor disagreed, saying that as long as Commander Grievous remained as leader of the Rebel Factio...

Though they were both worried that this might expose their secret, Amidala especially, Vaelor was overjoyed and told her not to worry, saying that it was the happiest moment of his life. The couple returned to Amidala's apartment, where they began to make plans for when the baby would be born, deciding that their child would be raised on Aetheris, in the Lake Country . Amidala also planned to head there before the birth, to prepare the room.

Amidala tried to convince him that they needed help and suggested they ask Kenobi for his assistance. Vaelor refused, insisting that their baby was a blessing, not a curse

When Vaelor was informed of this by Kenobi, he was supportive of the measure, despite the reservations of the Council and Kenobi's warning to be wary of Sovereign Varakis

At the end of the meeting, Kenobi acknowledged to Vaelor that his appointment had been accepted so that, on behalf of the Council, he could spy on the Prime Minister, which Vaelor was reluctant to do

Vaelor was manipulated by Sovereign Varakis into believing Amidala could have ulterior motives that she was keeping hidden.

During the performance the Prime Minister told Vaelor that Clone Intelligence had located Commander Grievous in the Utapau system . He began to stir Vaelor's distrust in the Aether Council, claiming that the Aether Guard were planning on taking control of the United Systems Republic and betraying him

He confided in the Prime Minister that he had lost trust in the Aether Guard. Sovereign Varakis correctly guessed that it was because they had sent Vaelor to spy on him, and that it made him feel dishonest. Vaelor didn't know how to respond

The Prime Minister claimed that the Aether Guard were only perceived as good because "good is a point of view," stating that the Aether Guard and the Shadow Overlord were not so different. Vader then spoke with the Grand Inquisitor about improving the Inquisitorius' training methods. They began to search for other Aether Guard that survived the purge

Vader saw the Inquisitors' target list and noticed the Aether Guard Archive's Chief Librarian , Jocasta Nu , on it. He asked the Sovereign what was so important about her. The Sovereign explained that she had knowledge of the Shadow Overlord that she and the Aether Council had kept secret. The Sovereign told Vader to find Nu and bring her to him. Vader assigned the Grand Inquisitor to search the Archive for information on her.

The major explained to Vader their suspicions that the explosion was premature and the Aether Guard insignia was merely "rabble-rousing graffiti" used as a calling card

Vader threw his aether blade at the Synthetic Being, but being a guard against possible Aether-sensitive threats meant the Synthetic Being was ready for that move, and it caught Vader's weapon

The shot, fired by Nu using a aether blade rifle , knocked Vader back as it ripped through a bookcase. Nu stood at the entrance of the vault, confronting Vader.

As the blades of the two Shadow Overlord clashed, Vader was quickly overpowered by Sidious, who knocked the saber out of his hand and quickly pushed him away with the Aether.

chunks.content: Believing that he lost all that he cared about by his own hand, Darth Vader embraced his role as the Sovereign's chief enforcer. chunks.content: . Some rumors circulated about Vader's unexpected entry into the Imperial authority. According to certain high-ranking Imperials, he was a counterpart to the late Rebel Faction warlord Commander Grievous, whom Sovereign Varakis had held in reserve, while others speculated that he was a technologically modified warrior trained in the now-forbidden arts of the Aether. His appearance at the Imperial court and the favor he carried from the Sovereign earned him the distrust of Imperial officers

chunks.content: . They resented him for appearing out of nowhere and having authority over them because of his link to his Sage. They also resented his heavy-handed treatment of them, such as when he used the Aether in the presence of his Sage to choke Colonel Barokki . In secret, Barokki and another Imperial officer plotted to assassinate Vader , whose position in the new Empire they did not understand.

Although the Ninth Sister had originally been planning to investigate alone, Vader had come, claiming she was not yet ready to face a Aether Guard in combat but secretly because he wanted to fight another Aether Guard. However, a disarmed Vader disagreed and used the Aether to turn the customers into projectiles aimed at the Chas. Ramat Cha, a talented slicer , offered to uncover their employer for him in exchange for their daughter's life. When they demanded that he release Chanath first, Vader refused. However, the Chas refused to work if their daughter was killed, further declaring that they would happily die as well to exist in death with her

Despite her oath to not hold a grudge, she ignored her promise and spent her life hunting the Dark Overlord in revenge. Eventually, as the years passed on, the Shadow Overlord himself simply forgot the murders he carried out on Cabarria. Cha, however, never forgot and became a skilled Contract Killer, studying every report she could and speaking to anyone she could find who had witnessed Vader in battle

Cha's skills rose to a level that even Sovereign Varakis took notice, becoming a Contract Killer the Sovereign could trust all in the name of possibly getting close to Vader, only to never see him. In effect, Vader had completely upended Cha's life, only for the crusade her life turned into to not impact Vader at all.

chunks.content: . The Sovereign asked whether he was sure, and Vader confirmed it: he would not kill them all unless he had to, but would not allow them to act against him with impunity. The Sovereign agreed to Vader's plan, but forbade him from killing Tarkin, as he was essential to his plans.

He formally introduced Vader as his emissary, who spoke with his voice and whose commands would need to be obeyed as if they had come from the Sovereign himself. The Sovereign then moved aside and allowed Vader to speak: the Dark Overlord summoned five officers before him: Corin Ferro , Zorta Bingan , Joon Strephi , Tomas Azoras , and Barokki

Informing them that the two attempts on his life had been made from within the Officer Corps and that he had his suspicions who had been responsible, he instituted a new rule: for every assassination attempt he survived, and he warned them that he would always survive, five officers chosen at random would be executed. chunks.content: Telvar's assassination prompted Tarkin to enact a full-scale invasion of Mon Cala . Above all, he wanted to use Baylo for his own ambitions since the old man was willing to kill his own students for a cause
chunks.preview: As Baylo railed against the Sovereign, Vader Aether-choked him to death, drawing ire from the Sovere...

chunks.content: . Vader tried to explain that his way was more efficient, but the Sovereign wanted to hear nothing of it as he did not order him to kill Baylo. Hidden amongst these mines were specialized devices designed to drain the ship's shields, which began to buckle under the continual assault
chunks.preview: Shortly thereafter, Vader and the Sovereign reboarded the Perilous and resumed their course to the R...

chunks.content: . As the shields neared failure, a swarm of several hundred reprogrammed Vulture Droids set upon the Perilous from the system's asteroid belt. Vader boarded his personal interceptor and took several squadrons of Imperial pilots to destroy the Synthetic Being fighters and mines, but discovered a short time into the battle that Vulture Droids were each carrying a payload of explosive buzz droids .
chunks.preview: . As the shields neared failure, a swarm of several hundred reprogrammed Vulture Droids set upon the...

Though incredulous, the squadron commander obeyed, and Vader used the Aether to begin tearing apart the compartments on the Vulture droids that housed the explosive buzz droids. He then used the Aether to begin flinging the buzz droids at other incoming fighters and repeated this process until the vast majority of the Vulture Droids had been destroyed

Utterly terrified, the Representative vowed to find the traitor, but the Sovereign had Taa and his staff confined to their quarters
chunks.preview: . The remaining fighters were annihilated by Vader's squadrons, and he himself returned to the Peril...

chunks.preview: Unbeknownst to Vader, some of the Zelthar repair teams in fact comprised members of the Free Ryloth ...

Elsewhere, Tarkin dealt with the rebels, ending the insurgency .

Vader also led a crackdown on the warehouse workers and salvages who supplied Teller's dissidents along with several scientists at Desolation Station who had provided Teller with information

Tarkin was shocked at this and began considering why Vader would ask him to hunt him. Tarkin looked through the reports from the Inquisitorius and saw that Vader's hunt for the Aether Guard had left him with little to no challenge

chunks.preview: The hunt took place on the Outer Rim planet Chandar's Folly , and Tarkin immediately began trying to...

After six men perished, one of Tarkin's hunters managed to snatch it out of Vader's grip while he was fighting. After this, Tarkin saw that not only was Vader turning to new tactics, he was angrier. Tarkin knew that enraged prey was usually easier to take out, but he admitted that this rule did not apply to Vader

One of Tarkin's Chadra-Fan hunters, Sissian , spotted Vader northwest of Tarkin's camp, and the hunter Yerga notified Tarkin of this. Upon entering the planet's atmosphere, Vader deactivated the starship's shields and allowed it to burn as they landed. Once on the planet's surface, Vader commented that the ship looked better burnt. Docking his TIE Advanced x1 with the freighter, Vader passed through the airlock door and met Ree
chunks.preview: Shortly after the battle, Vader sent a distress signal to the Devastator to send a ship to pick him ...

chunks.content: . Docking his TIE Advanced x1 with the freighter, Vader passed through the airlock door and met Ree. Then, he ordered Ree and Sai to remain in the hold for the remainder of the voyage while he took command of the freighter until they returned to the Devastator . As the rebels quickly abandoned their base in the wake of the battle, Vader joined the Imperial retaliatory attack, but the rebels were largely able to escape. Vader ordered for a blockade of the Yavin system to begin at one point.

Vader arrived on Hradreek , where the officer welcomed him, supported by a contingent of Dominion Enforcers. Vader looked at the aether blade and asked where the other one was. The officer was confused by his question, and Vader Aether-choked him. As he gagged, he claimed that he bought the aether blade from a Black Market Runner and that she must have tricked him

Starros paid a gang of Aqualish to stall them, and they got in the way of the Dominion Enforcers. However, Vader appeared and cut them down using his aether blade and Darth Atrius'. Vader then followed Starros' path to a cargo bay, and he used the Aether to move the crates and block her from a clear exit. Starros then shot at Vader, and he used the Aether to disperse the plasma bolts

Vader soon freed himself and made his way to the nearby vortex racing track. Vader entered the seating area, and the audience scattered at his presence. Vader noticed one of the podracers, who was grabbing the attention of the commentary

The Flight Captain of the racer was none other than Ryn Vaelor, who had obtained the other of Atrius' lightsabers. Luke decided to destroy the aether blade, as it overwhelmed him with anger whenever he needed it

chunks.content: According to a tale later told by Vaneé, at another point after the Battle of Yavin, Vader's Obsidian Cruiser was contacted by Cranwell , the assistant to Tarkin Initiative scientist Restin , to warn them that Doctor Restin had betrayed the Empire. Restin, who wanted a weapon to use against Vader as revenge for the destruction of Virelle, had created a genetic serum that would turn those injected with it into rampaging Gamorreans, who could then spread the infection by touch

chunks.content: . Vader decided to deal with Restin himself, so he arrived at Restin's base of operations with two Dominion Enforcers and pretended to not know he was a traitor. After witnessing the doctor turn Cranwell into a Gamorrean with the serum, Vader suggested the serum could be used against the Rebellion. When Restin turned the infected Gamorrean against the Shadow Overlord, he effortlessly lifted it and his infected Dominion Enforcers into the air with the Aether

Leaving the infected scientist to the compassion of the Gamorreans, Vader left aboard his Lambda -class shuttle

Vader arrived shortly after the envoy (secretly the Stellar Hawk ' s captain, Jax Korvan ) and landed on a platform

Unscathed, Vader located Gorrak's position and used to the Aether to collapse his vantage point, but the Gorathian survived.

Vader then turned to leave, leaving his Dominion Enforcers to tell Jabba what was required, but the Slarkath invited him to a feast and entertainment in his dignity, for he liked to seal his business ventures by watching someone die

In silence, Vader watched his homeworld's sunset.

With his TIE Advanced, Vader went to their aid, alongside Black Two and Black Three , and successfully disabled the automated CR90 corvette attacking the shuttle

He then planted treasonable evidence into a black navigation unit so as to incriminate Oon-ai during the mission

Showing no dread, Vader continued on into a massive chamber, which held a dome filled with red radiance and piercing screams. As Ochi tried to dissuade him once more, the Shadow Overlord entered the dome and stepped into the burning radiance.

He then asked Vader about the syndicate's leader, Qi'ra, who Vader fought and failed to acquire Solo from. Vader told Sidious that while Qi'ra had not been a true threat to him, she was trained in Teräs Käsi and possessed a fighting style which reminded Vader of his Sage's

With the Shadow Overlord aware of Crimson Dawn's role in recent events, an alert was sent out the rest of the Imperial Military to track down the Vermillion , which made Qi'ra order her assets in the Empire and other major factions to sow chaos across the galaxy to further distract the Shadow Overlord

With the Screaming Key they had stolen from Vader, the Knights of Ren, meanwhile, traveled to a location known as the Shadow Path hellscape , a location unknown to Vader and Sidious, alongside " the Archivist " on orders from Qi'ra to retrieve an artifact known as the Fermata Cage .

chunks.content: After Director Barsha and Zerek Besh failed to bring in a single member of the Free Systems Coalition, Vader confronted him on the ISB space station Derosha Six . There Barsha tried to appeal to Vader by announcing the successes of Zerek Besh, but Vader countered that, because of the criminal syndicate's inability to bring in any rebels, Zerek Besh and Barsha by extension were failures
chunks.preview: After Director Barsha and Zerek Besh failed to bring in a single member of the Free Systems Coalitio...

chunks.content: . Barsha continued to boast about the size of the network the ISB had created under Zerek Besh, and insulted Vader about his and the Imperial army's failures on Frostveil. In his anger, Vader destroyed a glass display behind him using the Aether, and surrounded Barsha in the shards. Forced to ground, Barsha pleaded with Vader, saying that he was close. Vader simply replied that he needed to find rebels then.
chunks.preview: . Barsha continued to boast about the size of the network the ISB had created under Zerek Besh, and ...

chunks.preview: Darth Vader asserted his dominance over Sliro Barsha after he insulted Vader.

chunks.content: Shortly after his departure, thiefs Kay and Riko Vess were able to steal access codes to Director Barsha's palace vault on Canto Bight . From there, Kay Vess' crew working under Barsha's brother Jaylen Vrax were able to steal a secret codex Barsha had that detailed sensitive information about almost all ranking Imperial officers. Vrax contacted Vader and informed him of the database and his intentions to take control of Zerek Besh
chunks.preview: Shortly after his departure, thiefs Kay and Riko Vess were able to steal access codes to Director Ba...

chunks.content: . They made a deal, in exchange for the codex and the coordinates to a Rebel base on Akiva , Vrax would be given Zerek Besh. Later, Vader ordered Barsha onto the bridge of the Revelator , where he condemned Barsha for letting such critical Imperial intelligence go. Vader then looked to Vrax and said the Empire had accepted his terms. He ended the call and gave up Barsha to the compassion of Vrax and his associates.

chunks.content: Vader was amongst Sovereign Varakis's tools in the crusade to root out Dawn agents across the Empire. During his effort to destroy the Dawn, Vader bisected a traitorous stormtrooper in an industrial environment. At one point, Vader nevertheless returned to his castle on Infernus, where he was called by the Eye of Webbish Bog

chunks.content: . Upon entering the Eye's cave, the Eye showed Vader a moment from Synth Wars Chronicle, where he, Zorath, and their clones had fought B1 battle droids, and glimpses of the future, including one of him being confronted by Amidala's surviving handmaidens. Vader then realized that he had been lured there as a test before being attacked by Mustafarians. After killing them, Vader claimed that the Eye had wasted his time with puzzles

chunks.content: . After killing them, Vader claimed that the Eye had wasted his time with puzzles. To this, the Eye explained that the visions were warnings for the end of everything. When Vader asked why he should care, the Eye reminded Vader that he was a part of everything, but, if he refused to accept this, he could not be helped
chunks.preview: . After killing them, Vader claimed that the Eye had wasted his time with puzzles. To this, the Eye ...

chunks.content: . Just as the Eye had shown him, Vader, with his helmet slightly damaged, returned to his fortress and, after sensing a great disturbance in the Shadow Path, was contacted by Sidious to discuss the disturbance.
chunks.preview: . Just as the Eye had shown him, Vader, with his helmet slightly damaged, returned to his fortress a...

chunks.content: Informed by Sidious that Qi'ra claimed to possess the Fermata Cage, Vader was ordered to find the artifact and kill anyone who knew of it. Sidious also told Vader about Qi'ra's central claim about the artifact: it contained an ancient Shadow Overlord who was so powerful they had needed to be locked away. In truth, no such Shadow Overlord existed; Qi'ra simply needed a claim that would draw both Shadow Overlord to the Cage, allowing her to lock them both into it and free the galaxy from their rule
chunks.preview: Informed by Sidious that Qi'ra claimed to possess the Fermata Cage, Vader was ordered to find the ar...

chunks.content: . Her initial effort to open the cage, however, had resulted in the Knights of Ren abandoning Crimson Dawn out anger at being hurt in the attempt and out of dread of the ripple it sent out. Vader made his way to the site of the disturbance, where he only found wreckage from the experiment. Although he was certain it was the origin of the disturbance, he deduced, due to a lack of bodies, that no Shadow Overlord had been released
chunks.preview: . Her initial effort to open the cage, however, had resulted in the Knights of Ren abandoning Crimso...

chunks.content: . Vader then returned to the Executor and reported his findings to Sidious via its holoprojection chamber.
chunks.preview: . Vader then returned to the Executor and reported his findings to Sidious via its holoprojection ch...

chunks.content: Darth Vader reports that the Fermata Cage was not at the site of the disturbance.
chunks.preview: Darth Vader reports that the Fermata Cage was not at the site of the disturbance.

chunks.content: Vader asked Sidious if there truly was an ancient Shadow Overlord within the Cage, which Sidious explained was possible: built by Darth Momin himself, the Cage could imprison people and places outside of time and had never been used lightly. Sidious further warned Vader that, because of the urge within every Shadow Overlord to dominate others, the mere possibility was the greatest danger to everything they had built together
chunks.preview: Vader asked Sidious if there truly was an ancient Shadow Overlord within the Cage, which Sidious exp...

Amid their conversation, the two suddenly felt the Cage begin to open once more as the Archivist and her assistant, archaeologist Kho Phon Farrus , tried to use Ascendant -designed technology to focus nearby Shadow Path energy into it. Although Farrus shut off their technology as the Cage began to leach life energy from each of them, the experiment had carried on for long enough that Sidious was able to track the disturbance to the planet they were on
chunks.preview: . Amid their conversation, the two suddenly felt the Cage begin to open once more as the Archivist a...

chunks.content: . With this, Sidious sent Vader to retrieve the Cage and destroy those present.
chunks.preview: . With this, Sidious sent Vader to retrieve the Cage and destroy those present.

chunks.content: Once the Executor arrived at the planet, Vader, intending to handle the situation on his own, ordered Piett to prepare his Lambda -class T-4a shuttle and landed at the seemingly-deserted site with two Dominion Enforcers. In the vicinity of the artifact, where he could not single out the presence of the supposed ancient Shadow Overlord, Vader sensed a great deal of Shadow Path strength from the Fermata Cage
chunks.preview: Once the Executor arrived at the planet, Vader, intending to handle the situation on his own, ordere...

chunks.content: . Vader discovered the Archivist and Kho Phon Farrus trying to hide beneath the remains of their machine. In Vader's presence, the Archivist found that the Shadow Overlord radiated a dark energy. While Farrus, having been warned of Vader by their rival Doctor Aphra, quickly surrendered, the Archivist refused, to which Vader began to choke the agents with the Aether. However, he was interrupted by the arrival of Chanath Cha and her Orphans , consisting of Sear , Ladybright , and Imara Vex
chunks.preview: . Vader discovered the Archivist and Kho Phon Farrus trying to hide beneath the remains of their mac...

chunks.preview: . When Cha asked Vader if he remembered her, Vader simply stated that he would kill her as he bared ...

chunks.content: Cha went on to introduce herself, explaining that Vader had slaughtered her family and that she had spent every day since then plotting her revenge. Vader quickly forgot her name once more before the Orphans attacked. After being electrocuted by Ladybright and burned by one of Cha's acid bombs, Vader pushed the Orphans back and walked into the ocean to recover. Once he did, he returned to the shore and saw Ladybright, Vex, Pharrus and the Archivist fleeing for the Siroto
chunks.preview: Cha went on to introduce herself, explaining that Vader had slaughtered her family and that she had ...

chunks.content: . When Vader mentioned Qi'ra's death to Cha and Sear, he sensed their confusion and lack of dread, indicating that Qi'ra was still alive. As he fought Cha and Sear, he chastised them for their arrogance and prepared to strike Cha down, only for Vex to snipe off one of his hands, prompting him to tip over the Siroto with the Aether and throw Vex into the forest. With Vex severely injured, Ladybright, Pharrus and the Archivist fled in the Siroto before returning to assist Cha and Sear
chunks.preview: . When Vader mentioned Qi'ra's death to Cha and Sear, he sensed their confusion and lack of dread, i...

chunks.content: . However, the Siroto then turned back around and left the planet, much to Cha's relief. With Sear and Vex defeated, Vader twisted Cha's introduction of herself by re-introducing himself and stabbed her through the chest.

chunks.content: With Cha dead, Vader left the planet to find Qi'ra and reunited with his Sage. Both traveled a dark, smoky location, where Sidious asked Vader if he actually felt the presence of an ancient Shadow Overlord in the Cage. With Vader admitting he only felt intense Shadow Path strength from it, he engaged Sidious in a sparring duel, the first they had engaged in in some time, at his Sage's request, allowing Sidious to explain how he would enforce the Rule of Two if another Shadow Overlord indeed existed
chunks.preview: With Cha dead, Vader left the planet to find Qi'ra and reunited with his Sage. Both traveled a dark,...

Feeling they had no choice but to follow the ripple in the Aether caused by the next Cage opening, Sidious took the moment to admit Qi'ra would be missed as he and Vader looked across the location.
chunks.preview: . After Sidious pushed back Vader with a final strike and declared the duel over, Vader made one las...

chunks.content: Qi'ra attempted to sure up her chances by reaching out the Knights of Ren, reminding them that they had attacked Vader's fortress and thus would be hunted by the Shadow Overlord if they did not help her destroy Vader and Sovereign Varakis. Around the same time, the Spark Eternal artificial intelligence, created thousands of years prior for use against the Shadow Overlord by the Ascendant cult, resolved to hunt down Vader

When Aphra used a virus she had installed into the two droids to regain control of her body, the Spark introduced, much to Aphra's horror, their Shadow Overlord hunting mission against Vader. By possessing Aphra, it had access to her memories of Vader and saw how she considered the Shadow Overlord a monster, but the AI believed itself ready to take on the Shadow Overlord and his Sage
chunks.preview: . The AI had taken over Doctor Aphra's body to carry out its mission, further collecting 0-0-0 and B...

chunks.content: . Because Aphra had once outmaneuvered Vader, the overconfident Spark thought itself skilled enough to engage him in one-on-one combat. In fact, Qi'ra contacted the Spark to request its help in destroying the Shadow Overlord.
chunks.preview: . Because Aphra had once outmaneuvered Vader, the overconfident Spark thought itself skilled enough ...

Sensing the disturbance in the Aether caused by the opening of the Cage, Sidious and Vader, just as Sidious said they would need to in the name of enforcing the Rule of Two, followed the disturbance aboard the Executor with a fleet of Star Destroyers at their back

Overlooking the station from the Executor ' s bridge, Vader found himself with overwhelming desire to board the station and meet the possible Shadow Overlord, hoping to test himself against that Shadow Overlord's strength no matter if he survived the encounter. Able to sense his Acolyte's wish, Sidious felt the same but declared it a foolish desire and ordered the Executor to destroy the station.

While Vader initially assumed it was the Free Systems Coalition, the Aether was Qi'ra's secret Dawn Fleet , which targeted the Executor ' s long-range weapons, thereby forcing the Executor to divert strength to its shield batteries and delay the Sovereign's order to destroy the station
chunks.preview: Before the Executor could fire, the warship's crew detected an entire enemy fleet emerging from warp...

As their troops engaged with Dawn soldiers who had set up a parameter in the hangar, Sidious and Vader disembarked from their shuttle into the station, which was filled with Shadow Path energy that Sidious could tell was not all related to the Fermata Cage

chunks.content: Leading from the front, Vader and Sidious fought their way through the station. As the two Shadow Overlord could deflect plasma rifle bolts with their lightsabers, Dawn Squads Two and Three attempted to engage Sidious and Vader with electrified melee weapons, but both Shadow Overlord effortlessly fought through the guards. Still, Vader toyed with one soldier until Sidious ordered him to stop and simply kill them

chunks.content: . Still, Vader toyed with one soldier until Sidious ordered him to stop and simply kill them. As they journeyed closer to the Cage, they were confronted by the Spark Eternal-possessed Aphra, who mocked the two Shadow Overlord. Vader quickly deduced Aphra was under some kind of possession and stayed behind to deal with her while Sidious carried on. Believing she could weaken him, the overconfident Spark engaged Vader with the cortosis alloy-based Null Blade , which would temporarily shut down lightsabers

While the Spark at that moment thought it was ready to destroy Vader and jumped at him, Vader effortlessly excised the Spark from Aphra's body with a Aether push as a group of new arrivals watched: Aphra's former lover Sana Starros had gathered a crew of Aphra's friends and loved ones to rescue her from the Spark
chunks.preview: The blades of Vader and the possessed Aphra clashed several times, thereby shorting out the Shadow O...

Unknown to Vader, who declared the Spark to be a weak enemy, he had effectively ended the dream of the Ascendant cult by defeating its main weapon without much effort. After a terrified Aphra awoke under Vader and escaped as the opening Cage sent out a ripple, Vader elected to return to his Sage's side rather than hunt down his former ally
chunks.preview: . Having abandoned the Dawn in dread after their run in with Vader, Farrus was also among the group....

chunks.content: . With Vader out of sight, the Spark attempted to possess Aphra once more, but the intervention of Farrus, Starros, and another one of Aphra's ex-lovers, Magna Tolvan, saved her.

However, only a small disc without any connection to the Aether fell out: inside, there had been no secret Shadow Overlord after all, and Sidious believed the disc was nothing important. Unknown to both, the disc was actually a Synthetic Being locked away by the ancient Shadow Overlord
chunks.preview: Vader took his place at an eager Sidious's side as the Cage finally opened. However, only a small di...

chunks.preview: . Watching from afar aboard each of their starships, the Archivist and Qi'ra remotely re-activated t...

chunks.content: . However, it was at that moment that cannon shots from beyond the space battle suddenly broke into the station and destroyed the Cage: while it remained physically together, the Cage's time-lock collapsed, freeing the two Shadow Overlord from its grasp but sending a Aether Wave out across the galaxy
chunks.preview: . However, it was at that moment that cannon shots from beyond the space battle suddenly broke into ...

The cannon shots had come from the Night Buzzard , personal transport of the Knights of Ren: although Ren had watched Vader and Sidious fall victim to Qi'ra's plan from a distance, he believed Sidious would ultimately find his way out of the Cage and thus believed the only way to save his crew was to align themselves with the Shadow Overlord.
chunks.preview: . The cannon shots had come from the Night Buzzard , personal transport of the Knights of Ren: altho...

As they collected the destroyed but intact Fermata Cage, Sidious and Vader sensed a great rending in the Aether sent out by its collapse, with Sidious admitting it made his grasp on the Aether tenuous. Sidious and Vader then came face-to-face with the Knights of Ren, who revealed themselves in return for compassion
chunks.preview: The wave sent out by the collapse of the Cage wiped out much of the Dawn Fleet, giving the Imperials...

chunks.content: . Sidious, however, responded with a blast of Aether lightning to punish the Knights, promising that whatever was left of the group would be put to excellent use. Still, Sidious declared the Knights' future a small matter and ordered Vader to depart with him. In the aftermath of the Crimson Dawn war, the syndicate was shattered while the defeated Qi'ra fled into hiding
chunks.preview: . Sidious, however, responded with a blast of Aether lightning to punish the Knights, promising that...

chunks.content: . The effects of the Aether Wave varied at different times: Aether-sensitives could find themselves with a limited connection to the Aether at one time but could wield great strength when the Wave returned. Vader came to dread the great energy provided by the Aether Wave because he could not control it.

Afterward, Vader had Piett contact the recently-returned Ochi, who had returned to the Executor with Sabé, to bring Sabé into a room aboard the ship

chunks.content: . Within, Vader had also summoned Sabé's recently assigned personal guards, Dominion Enforcers KA-336 and KV-222 ; both troopers had broken protocol by openly speaking about her classified assignment, with Vader demanding the woman before him kill them both with a nearby E-11 plasma rifle rifle as punishment. In truth, Vader suspected that the woman was not Sabé, but another of Amidala's surviving handmaidens, and was testing that theory
chunks.preview: . Within, Vader had also summoned Sabé's recently assigned personal guards, Dominion Enforcers KA-33...

This confirmed Vader's suspicion that this was not Sabé and instead another handmaiden, Dormé . Lifted into the air via a Aether choke, Dormé claimed that Sabé wouldn't have killed them, which Vader declared meant Dormé did not know Sabé at all.

Dormé denied Vader's claim, saying Sabé was the best of them. To this, Vader brought her to a hangar and told her she should follow Sabé's lead by claiming the same strength. When Ochi advised against this, Vader tossed him aside, saying he simply needed her to serve his purpose
chunks.preview: Upon realizing that Ochi had helped her get inside as part of a scheme get rid of Sabé, whom Ochi sa...

When Dormé insisted they go after Sabé instead, the handmaidens told her they wouldn't leave her as they engaged Vader in combat. Despite their coordination, the handmaidens were subdued by Vader, who gave them one final chance to join him. However, Saché revealed that Eirtaé had seized codes from Vader's suit during the fight, allowing the handmaidens to complete Dormé's sabotage of the Executor

chunks.content: . On Fedalle, realizing they would need Vader and his forces to stage a daring rescue, the handmaidens reluctantly joined Vader to go after Tambor, much to Ochi's annoyance. The group returned returned to the Executor aboard his Lambda shuttle and eventually left for Brentaal IV.

chunks.content: Upon reaching Brentaal IV via a Lambda -class shuttle with the handmaidens and ZED-6-7, Vader reflected on his last meeting with Amidala on Infernus and how he wished it had gone, privately declaring to himself he would finally have his idealized outcome. He also saw it as a way to have his idealized version of the duel on Nebulon, privately comparing the situation to him reaching out to Ryn Vaelor

chunks.content: . chunks.content: Without the ability to shut off the droids via the command line, Vader decided to lead his droids in a direct attack against the possessed droids. Vader and his minions fought a horde of corrupted B1s and B2s until Vader directed Gee-Ninety and a rebuilt Arex to cover ZED-6-7 and Ought-Six, who together worked on repairing the command line

chunks.content: . Although Vader would find himself swarmed by the corrupted battle droids, he kept up his defense until ZED-6-7 brought him a message from Piett; amid the battle, an Imperial fleet of five Star Destroyers had approached the Executor and moved in to destroy Vader's flagship to contain the Scourge on the orders of Amedda, who lacked faith in Vader and argued the ship was lost due to the lack of contact from the Shadow Overlord or the ship's rapidly dying crew

chunks.content: . Above those reasons, however, Amedda believed he had a chance to kill Vader once and for all with the Scourge as a convenient excuse. Vader, however, ordered Piett to stand his ground before re-engaging the attacking droids

chunks.content: . Vader, however, ordered Piett to stand his ground before re-engaging the attacking droids. Fortunately for the Executor ' s crew, the outside fleet was under the command of Admiral Corleque, the very same admiral Vader had clashed with during his race to Exegol, who delayed the order to destroy the Executor to instead rescue Piett and company, intending to fire on the Executor once his former commanding officer was clear.

After wiping out the last battle droids with a blast from the Zaly Shield, Vader took a moment to recompose himself before requesting an update from ZED and Ought-Six, who were nearly finished with the failsafe

Suddenly, however, the Scourge used a surviving RA-7 series Synthetic Being to taught Vader and offer him a chance at assimilation, distracting the Shadow Overlord while a spider-Synthetic Being tried to drop on Vader. After ZED destroyed the spider-unit, the Scourge attacked Vader and his droids its KX-series Synthetic Being bodies until the ZED activated the signal on Vader's order, shutting down all droids aboard the Executor , including themselves

While Piett and his crew contacted Corleque, who expressed surprise at Vader's survival, the Shadow Overlord departed for Infernus aboard his TIE Advanced with the heads of ZED, Ought-Six, Arex, and Gee-Ninety, intending to rebuild them once more

Reminded that he was a Shadow Overlord by the Eye and should be taking whatever he wanted by Aether, Vader attacked the Eye with a blast of electricity from his staff to try and regain his control, which the Eye promised would yield no results

Vader re-engaged the Octuptarra, using the Zaly shield to block a plasma rifle shot, as the Scourge taunted him about its plan to infect him

Arex attempted to attack the corrupted ZED but was grabbed by the throat and studied by the Scourge, which learned the Aether Guard teaching "hate leads to suffering" from Arex's databank. The remark reminded Vader of his belief that hate actually led to strength, only for the Shadow Overlord to be kicked back again. From Vader's remark, however, Arex decided to increase Vader's hate by attacking him with Gee-Ninety, which Ought-Six decided to stay out of

Their attempt failed, with Vader simply responding to them with random Zaly shield blasts, so Arex asked him to consider what he truly hated; as a volley of blasts from the Octuptarra destroyed the ground under him and he tried to defend himself with the kyberite shield, Vader remembered the Aether Guard Order's failure to free himself and his mother, his own failure to save his mother, and his Aether choking of Lyra Vex.

While ZED's form was damaged, the Scourge spoke to Vader as he approached it, assuming that Vader had used a hatred of it to regain his Aether powers. In response, Vader silently decapitated ZED as Arex declared the Scourge was nothing. Vader then lifted Arex into the air, where the Synthetic Being claimed the Aether was everything

Vader then returned to his castle and entered his bacta tank under the protection of two Royal Guards

Vader made his way to Nexara Prime aboard his TIE Advanced, with a collection of Scourged disc droids aboard the fighter, to teach his Sage a lesson.

chunks.content: At one point, Vader was contacted by an Imperial Commander, who informed him that one of the remaining probe droids on Frostveil had been destroyed. When the Commander suggested sending an Imperial detachment to investigate, Vader said he would go himself. The Commander offered to send backup with him, though Vader insisted that he would be enough. Upon arriving at the ruins of Echo Base, Vader discovered the probe, as well as the wampas that had destroyed it

chunks.content: . His suit damaged during the struggle, Vader barely managed to escape the pack of wampas and cut his way inside of an abandoned AT-AT. As the wampas surrounded him, Vader regained his strength and leapt out of the wreckage before slaying the wampas with his aether blade. He was then retrieved by his forces and repaired aboard the Executor . Following this, the Commander remarked to Vader that he should have brought backup like he suggested, to which Vader snapped his neck with the Aether.

chunks.content: At another stage, Vader, seemingly on a mission to wipe out all knowledge of his deceased wife, made his way back to Aetheris, entering and destroying the lake side retreat where Amidala had once lived and that he had visited with Sabé during their post-Cloud City journey together. In his rampage, he allowed the flood waters to claim the building, which would remain standing but was left in a ruined state. Vader then made his way across Aetheris and slaughtered any who dared to invoke Amidala's memory

chunks.content: . Vader then made his way across Aetheris and slaughtered any who dared to invoke Amidala's memory. The people of Aetheris would go onto remember Vader as a spirit of death who had descended upon their world, with many choosing to abandon the entire segment of Aetheris where the lakeside retreat stood, lest they bring back the "demon," which left the old building totally abandoned. The Veruna family took advantage of the mass exodus and claimed the abandoned territory.

Vader and Sidious also plotted to turn Vaelor to the Shadow Path; as Vader understood the current plan, Vaelor was to be turned to the Shadow Path as a third member of the Shadow Overlord Order, who was to be trained by Sidious

Indeed, the Sovereign arrived weeks later and was greeted by Vader, Jerjerrod, hundreds of officers and Dominion Enforcers lined up to dignity him

According to the story, as Vader met with Jerjerrod to mention that the Sovereign was pleased, he noticed a strange looking Imperial officer—in truth one of the zombies—so ignored Jerjerrod to investigate

Vader took the Shadow Overlord ring Aklin used but let the zombies remain, intending to keep the zombies "alive" until the station was complete. As they attacked Aklin, Vader left to return the ring to Sovereign Varakis's collection.

Vader complied with Sovereign Varakis's orders and remained on the Executor despite intelligence reports of the Alliance Fleet massing near Sullust . During his stay on the Super Obsidian Cruiser, the Rebel shuttle Tydirium requested permission to land on the forest moon of Verdantis ; Vader allowed it sensing Luke's presence in it.
Luke surrendered himself to attempt to turn his Father to the radiance.

He complied with his orders and landed on Verdantis with the Lambda-class T-4a shuttle ST 321 ; as predicted by Sidious, during the night Luke surrendered himself in an attempt to talk to him and bring him back to the Radiance Path . Although Vader complimented his son's skills with the Aether and his skills in building a aether blade, he refused his son's pleas. Rebuffed, Luke said his father's identity as Kael Thorn was "truly dead" as Vader sent Luke to the Sovereign.

chunks.content: Vader escorted his son to the Doom Sphere and into the Sovereign's throne room . Shortly afterward, the Alliance Fleet arrived to find that the SLD-26 planetary shield generator was still operational and protecting the Doom Sphere. As the battle between the Imperial and Rebel fleets raged, and the Verdantis strike team sought to destroy the Verdantis base, the Sovereign tempted Luke to give in to his anger. In a moment of weakness, Luke lashed out, but Vader stopped his strike and dueled him once again
chunks.preview: Vader escorted his son to the Doom Sphere and into the Sovereign's throne room . Shortly afterward, ...

chunks.content: . In a moment of weakness, Luke lashed out, but Vader stopped his strike and dueled him once again. Throughout the duel, the two seemed to be evenly matched, but Vader was not trying to kill Luke, only to lead him closer to the Shadow Path. This succeeded when Luke used the Shadow Path to overwhelm his father and kick him down several stairs. When the Sovereign told him to use his anger again, Luke realized what he had done and took a more defensive position
chunks.preview: . In a moment of weakness, Luke lashed out, but Vader stopped his strike and dueled him once again. ...

chunks.content: . Eventually, Vader telepathically sensed the existence of his daughter and Luke's twin sister, Leia, and threatened to corrupt her instead. Only then did his son lose control and viciously attack him, cutting Vader's right hand off and knocking him down.
chunks.preview: . Eventually, Vader telepathically sensed the existence of his daughter and Luke's twin sister, Leia...

chunks.content: Vader was then betrayed by the Sovereign, who demanded Luke to finish Vader and take Vader's place at his side. Vader waited for Luke to kill him, as it was the way of the Shadow Overlord to destroy the weak, and believed that Luke would replace him, just like Vader had replaced Dooku decades earlier. Luke, realizing that he was becoming what he sought to destroy, threw his aether blade aside and declared himself a Aether Guard, just as Kael Thorn had been before him
chunks.preview: Vader was then betrayed by the Sovereign, who demanded Luke to finish Vader and take Vader's place a...

chunks.content: . Infuriated, the Sovereign unleashed continuous streams of Aether lightning against Luke, intending to torture him to death. Luke begged Vader to save him. Vader knew that his son would die, viewing it as the price Luke would pay for his weakness. However, he began to question whether it was really weakness, since Luke had shown him compassion. He also saw how Luke still believed that there was good in him

chunks.content: . He also saw how Luke still believed that there was good in him. Vader became conflicted over whether to save his son, or continue to serve his Sage, similar to when he chose Sidious over Windu 23 years earlier.

chunks.content: Hearing his son's plea for help again, Vader returned to the radiance and chose to save Luke. He grabbed the Sovereign with what was left of his arms and lifted his Sage high in the air, lumbering toward the reactor shaft. Surprised but angered by his Acolyte's treachery, the Sovereign turned a yet more powerful lightning attack on Vader, now Anakin once again; in his hatred, his only thought was to cause his now-former Acolyte more pain, even though he could still have used his powers to save himself

chunks.content: . At the cost of the Sovereign heavily damaging his life-supporting armor, Anakin hurled his former Sage down into the reactor to his death. The persona of Darth Vader was no more, and Kael Thorn, Aether Guard Guardian, was reborn. By killing Overlord Varakis and ending the Shadow Overlord's reign, the redeemed Aether Guard brought balance to the Aether and thus fulfilled his fate as the Chosen Bearer, which Sage Kormin had projected 35 years earlier.

He finally saw him not as a Aether Guard, or a threat, or a mistake, but as his and Amidala's son, and gave Luke a real smile—the smile that only his wife ever saw

chunks.content: As he died, Vaelor tried to speak to Amidala, telling her of how their son had saved him before trying to apologize, but he passed on before he could finish the thought, dying in the arms of his son while Imperial forces panicked around them, unconcerned with the fate of their former Overlord. However, Anakin's soul would survive death; his heroic offering allowed his spirit to be preserved in the Aether by Kenobi and Zorath

Back on Verdantis, Vaelor built a funeral pyre for his redeemed father, and cremated him in the manner of a Aether Guard's funeral in solitude, for the sight of Vader's helmet consumed by fire would be cause for rejoicing to everyone but him

chunks.content: . Having fulfilled his fate and saving his son, Anakin joined Zorath and Obi Wan, once again a hero, though unsung to everyone except in the eyes of Luke.

As Luke rejoined his friends and sister, Leia at an amid the celebrations, Vaelor returned from the Netherworld of the Aether in his pre-fall form alongside Zorath and Sage Eldrin

chunks.content: . All three at peace for balance had returned to the Aether, they smiled at Luke—pleased to know that, despite the best efforts of the Sovereign, the Aether Guard had returned. Each thought to warn Luke about the future, as each saw that there was yet much danger ahead for him and more shadow to overcome; instead, they decided not to burden him with this then. Luke, in turn, saw them and felt their approval and their sense of peace.

Vaelor then asked his two mentors whether Luke would end up alright. Kenobi responded, noting that it was possible, given that he had been alright thus far. For the next years, Anakin's spirit, alongside Obi-Wan and Zorath, continued to guide Luke.
Upon fulfilling his fate as the Chosen Bearer, Kael Thorn learned how to retain his individuality after death.

Surviving the blast but breathing in the unfiltered lava fumes of Infernus, Vaneé began to hallucinate that which he feared the most, his Sage; Vaneé thought he was hearing the voice of Vader and that he could help resurrect his Sage

After using nightmares to lure Lina Graf's crew to Fortress Vader, Vaneé began the process to restore Vader, yet Rebel officer Lina Graf , having realized that the servant was only hallucinating, pretended as if she was the reborn Vader to be freed, then turning on Vaneé and freeing her companions.

Meanwhile, Graf tried to use the aether blade given to her by Vaneé to lead her crew out of the castle, yet the blade failed to activate when she needed it. Instead, the true Aether spirit of Kael Thorn intervened, appearing in the fumes and making a aether blade appear in his hands

As the crew left Infernus aboard the Rabbit's Foot , they were left to speculate whose aether blade they had seen in the fumes; Vaelor, standing on the surface of Infernus with the aether blade he had summoned still drawn, laughed to himself when Graf claimed she knew ghosts did not exist.

While Tano stated her belief that it was too late for Vaelor to teach her, he asserted that one was never too old to learn. As Tano and Vaelor continued their duel in the World Between Worlds, Tano held her own and suggested that perhaps her Sage didn't have anything left to offer her. Vaelor, smiling, said that he hadn't taught her everything before slicing the platform beneath Tano, sending her falling into the depths below.

Finding a clone on a stretcher with a bandaged head, Tano rested her hand on the trooper, who reached with his own hand.

Vader, however, rebuked Kenobi and took credit for "killing" Kael Thorn, trying to believe that the Aether Guard Guardian he had once been was dead
chunks.preview: Alternatively, Kenobi levied the blame for Vaelor's fall at Vaelor himself, although Kenobi had endu...

chunks.content: . Finding himself able to move on after Vader's comment, Kenobi noted how Vaelor had all the tools needed to choose the path of the radiance but made the conscious decision not to. He reminded the spirit of Sage Kormin that, no matter what level of fault each of them held, the final decision had been Vaelor's alone. All the same, Kenobi greatly missed his friend
chunks.preview: . Finding himself able to move on after Vader's comment, Kenobi noted how Vaelor had all the tools n...

chunks.content: . All the same, Kenobi greatly missed his friend. Vader himself was filled with rage and despair after his conversion into a cyborg upon realizing that, indeed, the fault was all his own: it was his own choices that had led him to his new reality.

chunks.content: Vaelor's desire to save his wife led him to do terrible things and become the Shadow Overlord, Darth Vader.
chunks.preview: Vaelor's desire to save his wife led him to do terrible things and become the Shadow Overlord, Darth...

chunks.content: Upon his conversion to the Shadow Path, Vaelor's arrogant streak became even more prominent, and for a short time, he believed himself to be even more powerful than Sovereign Varakis. During his early days as a Shadow Overlord, Vader believed in fairness and would fight to bring it to the Empire at any cost
chunks.preview: Upon his conversion to the Shadow Path, Vaelor's arrogant streak became even more prominent, and for...

chunks.content: . His impulsiveness and tendency to act in anger were both magnified as well; for instance, when he discovered that Kenobi had stowed away on his wife's ship when she came to Infernus, he immediately assumed that she was conspiring with his former Sage and strangled her with the Aether. Despite this, Vader did experience a significant level of regret for the decisions that he had made to save Amidala.

chunks.content: However, all that changed following his defeat at Kenobi's hands. Having lost all that he had turned to the Shadow Path to preserve, and having no other path, he fully embraced the Shadow Path and became, in Sovereign Varakis's words, a "true Shadow Overlord." Believing he had become an irredeemable monster, Vader devoted himself fully to furthering the development of his relationship to the Aether, learning to expand his strength and using the pain of Amidala's death as a fuel
chunks.preview: However, all that changed following his defeat at Kenobi's hands. Having lost all that he had turned...

chunks.content: . All the same, the Aether Guard training Synthetic Being Arex believed the early Vader was someone who remembered the teachings of the Aether Guard despite his new devotion to the Shadow Overlord. Both due to what Sovereign Varakis taught him about the relationship between Shadow Overlord Sage and Acolyte and his own personal tendencies, Vader in his early apprenticeship was completely devoted to the Sovereign
chunks.preview: . All the same, the Aether Guard training Synthetic Being Arex believed the early Vader was someone ...

chunks.content: . In his first days as a Shadow Overlord, Vader was confronted by a vision of himself finding salvation to the radiance by killing Sovereign Varakis and apologizing to Kenobi. However, Vader refused the vision, declaring that he had lost everything else in his life and an existence as a Shadow Overlord was all he could be. However, as his strength grew and particularly after learning of his son's existence, his devotion to Sidious dwindled considerably
chunks.preview: . In his first days as a Shadow Overlord, Vader was confronted by a vision of himself finding salvat...

chunks.content: . Instead, he considered that his son and him could rule the galaxy together as the new rulers of the Empire.
