chunks.content: Darth Vader was the dreaded enforcer of his Shadow Overlord Sage and the galaxy-wide empire they forged.
chunks.preview: Darth Vader was the dreaded enforcer of his Shadow Overlord Sage and the galaxy-wide empire they for...

chunks.content: Vader held contempt for those who betrayed the Empire, such as when he accused Leia Organa of being a traitor. According to an Imperial captain who worked with Vader, the Shadow Overlord was always violent but would "mature" over the years. Vader at first simply murdered those who annoyed him. However, he eventually came to wait for those he wanted to murder to make a mistake: even if it was a minor error, it gave Vader an excuse to carry out the execution
chunks.preview: Vader held contempt for those who betrayed the Empire, such as when he accused Leia Organa of being ...

chunks.content: . Indeed, over the years since his fall to shadow, Vader developed a new, more hardened and disciplined persona. He became utterly ruthless, refused to retreat, and was virtually devoid of compassion. Even though he once thought to himself that his Sage's punishment of the most loyal Imperials only hurt their efforts to establish order, Vader was known to occasionally kill his own officers for their failures
chunks.preview: . Indeed, over the years since his fall to shadow, Vader developed a new, more hardened and discipli...

chunks.content: . The dread felt by members of the Imperial ranks was so great that some chose death rather than face the wrath of the Shadow Overlord. The Grand Inquisitor , of the Inquisitorius , and chief supervisor Lank Denvik , of the Imperial Security Bureau , were examples of this, though both were unable to escape. Vader came to view the Galactic Civil War not as a war, but a series of executions, believing that wars were for lesser men than him and his Sage
chunks.preview: . The dread felt by members of the Imperial ranks was so great that some chose death rather than fac...

chunks.content: . When confronted by Leia Organa on Vrogas Vas, he informed her of this belief and told her that her execution was long overdue, though he was unable to kill the princess due to the arrival of Commander Karbin. Vader treated droids as disposable servants.
chunks.preview: . When confronted by Leia Organa on Vrogas Vas, he informed her of this belief and told her that her...

chunks.content: Eventually, the identity of Vader in the Empire had arisen tales of a dark armored humanoid who served as the Sovereign's most trusted enforcer and was considered to be the most feared individual in the Empire. Rumors circulated that he lived in a castle in a world of lava and that he wielded a red aether blade, suggesting a connection to the Shadow Overlord
chunks.preview: Eventually, the identity of Vader in the Empire had arisen tales of a dark armored humanoid who serv...

chunks.content: . The few who had interacted with him stated that they were unsure whether the individual behind the armor was a living person, a Synthetic Being or a Synth Soldier. Many feared that if Vader were ever defeated, a number of duplicates would be activated in his place. The Shadow Overlord also had absolutely no qualms about using torture to accomplish his goals.
chunks.preview: . The few who had interacted with him stated that they were unsure whether the individual behind the...

chunks.content: Darth Vader earned the ire of Imperial officers and the love of the rank and file.
chunks.preview: Darth Vader earned the ire of Imperial officers and the love of the rank and file.

chunks.content: Considered to be the Empire's first terror weapon and noted to employ antiquated diction, he was tenacious and unstoppable, and made most Imperial naval officers uncomfortable. Even Admiral Firmus Piett, whose highly skilled abilities as a wartime officer kept him alive in Vader's service, was not above being threatened with death by the Dark Overlord
chunks.preview: Considered to be the Empire's first terror weapon and noted to employ antiquated diction, he was ten...

chunks.content: . When Piett warned him of the Scourge Synthetic Being infection, Vader's only response was to critique Piett for thinking he would repeat the admiral's failings. Contrary to the rocky relationships he had with most Imperial officers, his rapport with his Dominion Enforcers mirrored in many ways his former persona's relationship to the United Systems Republic's Synth Soldiers
chunks.preview: . When Piett warned him of the Scourge Synthetic Being infection, Vader's only response was to criti...

chunks.content: . In fact, his standing with the rank and file was such that it was known as far as Ryloth that the stormtrooper corps "almost worshiped him." Additionally, Vader commanded the absolute devotion of his servant, Vaneé, who remained stationed at his castle on Infernus and knew Vader viewed himself as a monster.
chunks.preview: . In fact, his standing with the rank and file was such that it was known as far as Ryloth that the ...

chunks.content: Part of his reputation was that he would normally be quiet (and thus his presence made for a good implied threat to others) whereas shows of passivity were not. Indeed, it was well known that he usually preferred to oversee operations personally, using action to block out any intruding feelings. He was frequently at odds with those who lacked faith in the Aether, finding it "disturbing" or even blasphemous.
chunks.preview: Part of his reputation was that he would normally be quiet (and thus his presence made for a good im...

chunks.content: Darth Vader was a man fueled by pain, turning it into a fuel to continue his life as a Shadow Overlord.
chunks.preview: Darth Vader was a man fueled by pain, turning it into a fuel to continue his life as a Shadow Overlo...

chunks.content: His self-hatred led him to think of self-destructive tendencies, such as blaming his former Sage Sage Eldrin for not killing him on Infernus, and his hatred of Kenobi for what happened on Infernus led him to have the desire to burn his former mentor's body to the same level he burned his own
chunks.preview: His self-hatred led him to think of self-destructive tendencies, such as blaming his former Sage Sag...

chunks.content: . Although Vader hated Obi-Wan for being the responsible one for his extensive injuries inflicted in Infernus, Vader did not hold Kenobi completely to blame for his dark fate; as he told his former Sage in one of their confrontations, he proclaimed that it was not Kenobi who had killed Kael Thorn, instead saying that himself had done it
chunks.preview: . Although Vader hated Obi-Wan for being the responsible one for his extensive injuries inflicted in...

chunks.content: . Darth Vader continued to harbor his xenophobic hatred of the Tusken Raiders race for the murder of his mother during the end of the Rebel Faction Crisis, which gave him the motive after a negotiation with the crime Overlord Zorak the Slarkath to attack a Tusken Raider camp located on the same planet where he saw his mother died.
chunks.preview: . Darth Vader continued to harbor his xenophobic hatred of the Tusken Raiders race for the murder of...

chunks.content: During his first days as a Shadow Overlord, he claimed that his actions were justified, stating that the Shadow Overlord were on the right side while the Aether Guard to be the real evil, as he told Kenobi during the Duel of Infernus. As he grew older and lived within his suit, he claimed that he still believed in fairness, claiming to be a devout believer in Imperial propaganda to bring order to the galaxy
chunks.preview: During his first days as a Shadow Overlord, he claimed that his actions were justified, stating that...

chunks.content: . Indeed, Vader would become known as the Dark Overlord of order, although how much he actually believed in the quest to establish order was debatable. During the manhunt for pacifist scientist Galen Erso , Vader questioned the term peace, seeing violence as the true creator of order and dismissing pacifists as fools who failed to see that. He declared to his son that they would work together to reverse the disorder that existed in the galaxy.
chunks.preview: . Indeed, Vader would become known as the Dark Overlord of order, although how much he actually beli...

chunks.content: During the war with Crimson Dawn, Vader held contempt for his Sage's failure to establish order, thinking to himself that Sovereign Varakis's actions had only created the chaos they found themselves in. Even without Vaelor by his side, Vader set out on a new quest to bring order to the galaxy. During his campaign to root out Crimson Dawn infiltrators in the Empire, Vader saw it as a way to bring about order
chunks.preview: During the war with Crimson Dawn, Vader held contempt for his Sage's failure to establish order, thi...

chunks.content: . Even though he thought the Sovereign punishing the most loyal of the Empire as everything else collapsed to be a problem that had made chaos, Vader allowed loyal Imperials to be executed if it meant Dawn agents would also be killed. When asked why by his agent Ochi, Vader declared it as part of his quest to bring order back to the Empire by destroying the chaos of the Dawn
chunks.preview: . Even though he thought the Sovereign punishing the most loyal of the Empire as everything else col...

chunks.content: . When his agent Sabé declared the end of Jul Tambor's revolution as a path to peace on Skako Minor, Vader was silent for a moment before correcting her, telling her it was more correct to say they were bringing order. However, Sabé would ultimately come to believe Vader was, in all truth, not interested in establishing order, pointing out during the final stages of the Schism Imperial crisis that his current quest for personal strength had only brought about chaos.
chunks.preview: . When his agent Sabé declared the end of Jul Tambor's revolution as a path to peace on Skako Minor,...

chunks.content: Darth Vader was a warrior of hatred who carried out a campaign of terror and death.
chunks.preview: Darth Vader was a warrior of hatred who carried out a campaign of terror and death.

chunks.content: As a Shadow Overlord, Vader drew strength from his anger and pain, raging at the loss of his wife and unborn child, his treachery by the Aether Guard, and Kenobi for his injuries. He once razed a villa in a Mapuzo town entirely to draw out Kenobi. He often used pressurized meditation chambers that allowed him to remain without his helm—the neural connection to his armor—during which he felt the perpetual pain that Kenobi had inflicted on his flesh
chunks.preview: As a Shadow Overlord, Vader drew strength from his anger and pain, raging at the loss of his wife an...

chunks.content: . During such sessions, he would meditate to use this pain to feed his hate, which in turn fed his strength, and he never laughed. Claiming not to feel regret, and yet haunted by his past, and the screams of his wife, he was determined to never talk about his old life, and detested all that reminded him of his past self, whom he deemed to be weak
chunks.preview: . During such sessions, he would meditate to use this pain to feed his hate, which in turn fed his s...

chunks.content: . He dared not remember such a period of his life, which he hated; indeed, through the use of the Shadow Path, he kept his memories as Kael Thorn buried, although it took great effort even after twenty years of practice.
chunks.preview: . He dared not remember such a period of his life, which he hated; indeed, through the use of the Sh...

chunks.content: Although he retained access to Vaelor's memories and experience, this burial was such that he refused to even think of Vaelor as himself, referring to internally to Vaelor's memories as those of "The Aether Guard." As such, Vader rarely thought of his former name and believed no one in the galaxy should mistake him for Kael Thorn, wanting none to forget his status as a Shadow Overlord
chunks.preview: Although he retained access to Vaelor's memories and experience, this burial was such that he refuse...

chunks.content: . Still, his rapport with the Dominion Enforcers who supported him, and the technique he displayed in wielding his crimson aether blade, made Wilhuff Tarkin suspect the truth

chunks.content: . When the reprogrammed Arex tried to help Vader regain control of his powers during the Aether Wave incident by suggesting Aether Guard meditation, Vader decried the Aether Guard Order as focusing on weakness instead of strength, threatening Arex by reminding the unit of how he killed the unit's Sage Kirak Infil'a and demanding Arex not speak of the Aether Guard
chunks.preview: . When the reprogrammed Arex tried to help Vader regain control of his powers during the Aether Wave...

chunks.content: . After Arex, who admitted they may be presuming too much, repeatedly suggested Aether Guard teachings to him during the battle for the Executor , Vader destroyed Arex in rage and adopted a direct method of attack to regain control of his flagship.
chunks.preview: . After Arex, who admitted they may be presuming too much, repeatedly suggested Aether Guard teachin...

chunks.content: Darth Vader desperately sought to destroy what remained of his past, regarding himself as a different person from "The Aether Guard" who had come before.
chunks.preview: Darth Vader desperately sought to destroy what remained of his past, regarding himself as a differen...

chunks.content: Upon his fateful reunion with Kestra Nil, Vader expressed no desire to rekindle the bond he once shared with her, boasting that he had "killed" Kael Thorn, just as he had said to Kenobi. Although he claimed he would spare her and work alongside her once more if she helped the Empire find any hiding Aether Guard, he cruelly resolved to kill her when she refused his offer, and he spurned her offer of compassion
chunks.preview: Upon his fateful reunion with Kestra Nil, Vader expressed no desire to rekindle the bond he once sha...

chunks.content: . During a mission with Grand Admiral Thrawn, who had met and befriended Vaelor during Synth Wars Chronicle, Vader repeatedly declared that Vaelor was long since dead, eventually forcing the Chiss officer to admit the man he had befriended during the war was gone
chunks.preview: . During a mission with Grand Admiral Thrawn, who had met and befriended Vaelor during Synth Wars Ch...

chunks.content: . Upon hearing Thrawn admit as such, Vader declared they were never to speak of the man again, although Thrawn stated he would always carry Vaelor's memory with him, befitting his philosophy that someone was never truly gone if a friend remembered them.
chunks.preview: . Upon hearing Thrawn admit as such, Vader declared they were never to speak of the man again, altho...

chunks.content: Much like before, Vader remained an impatient man, although he tempered his impulses with the faithful obedience he gave to his Shadow Overlord Sage, Sidious. Vader also accepted that Sidious could be even more hateful than even himself. Vader nevertheless remained a pained man, so he would try to hurt himself and others to relieve himself. As sensed by Zorath, Vader's presence in the Aether was hard and strong, fiercely pulsing when he sensed him
chunks.preview: Much like before, Vader remained an impatient man, although he tempered his impulses with the faithf...

chunks.content: . However, Vader's presence also carried a great, crushing loneliness, which only increased after he killed Sage Eldrin.
chunks.preview: . However, Vader's presence also carried a great, crushing loneliness, which only increased after he...

chunks.content: The persona of Darth Vader ended when Kael Thorn sacrificed himself in order to save his son from the Sovereign.
chunks.preview: The persona of Darth Vader ended when Kael Thorn sacrificed himself in order to save his son from th...

chunks.content: Following the discovery of his parenthood, Vader became emotionally conflicted. Vader's thoughts of his son, Luke, led to thoughts of his late wife, the woman he loved and destroyed—thoughts he could not allow. Memories would resurface whenever he felt Luke near him, and so, believed in erasing that part of his past
chunks.preview: Following the discovery of his parenthood, Vader became emotionally conflicted. Vader's thoughts of ...

chunks.content: . He had become afraid of his compassionate son; not because of his mastery of the Aether or skill with a aether blade, but because Luke could make him question the dark truths that had long ruled him. In the eve of the Battle of Verdantis, Vader claimed it was too late for him, even as his son stubbornly felt that there was still good left in him. Vader would close off the questions with the Shadow Path, but he showed concern for his son in the end
chunks.preview: . He had become afraid of his compassionate son; not because of his mastery of the Aether or skill w...

chunks.content: . Ultimately, it was Luke's cry for help while being tortured by Sovereign Varakis that caused Anakin to reawaken and redeem himself, showing that despite all the evil acts he has committed, there was still some good in him.
chunks.preview: . Ultimately, it was Luke's cry for help while being tortured by Sovereign Varakis that caused Anaki...

chunks.content: His love for Luke also challenged his devotion to the Sovereign. Vader began to distrust him, feeling like another pawn in his game. He planned to kill him to take his throne, considering himself best a ruler alongside Luke. His concern over being a pawn of Sidious ended up being validated when Sidious tried to replace him with Luke, much like when he replaced Dooku with Vader
chunks.preview: His love for Luke also challenged his devotion to the Sovereign. Vader began to distrust him, feelin...

chunks.content: . Vader became surprised when he sensed that he was not the father of one child but two when he telepathically sensed his daughter, Leia, through Luke. Before dying, Vaelor told Luke to tell Leia that he was right about him as he wanted his daughter to remember him as a good person in the end. Smiling at his son, Vaelor then died in peace.
chunks.preview: . Vader became surprised when he sensed that he was not the father of one child but two when he tele...

chunks.content: Vaelor had first met Amidala when she posed as a handmaiden and commoner at Watto's shop in Dust Harbor. There, Vaelor asked if she was an angel. He was then surprised when Padmé revealed herself to be the Queen. Ten years later, Vaelor met with her at apartment following an assassination attempt on her. As Vaelor continued to protect Amidala from further attempts, he tried to impress her and flirt with her in ways he later cringed at
chunks.preview: Vaelor had first met Amidala when she posed as a handmaiden and commoner at Watto's shop in Dust Har...

chunks.content: . However, the mistakes he and Amidala made during that time revealed who each truly was to the other, and Amidala fell in love with him. They admitted their mutual love to each other on Aetheris and, following the Battle of Geonosis, married in secret.
chunks.preview: . However, the mistakes he and Amidala made during that time revealed who each truly was to the othe...

chunks.content: Anakin married Padmé following the Battle of Geonosis.
chunks.preview: Anakin married Padmé following the Battle of Geonosis.

chunks.content: During Synth Wars Chronicle, Vaelor and Amidala rarely saw each other due to their duties requested of them during the war as well as keeping their marriage secret. Vaelor would rescue and protect Amidala from numerous dangers such as Commander Grievous, the Zillo Beast, and the Blue Shadow Virus. Vaelor also felt jealous towards Amidala's close friend, Representative Rush Clovis of Scipio
chunks.preview: During Synth Wars Chronicle, Vaelor and Amidala rarely saw each other due to their duties requested ...

chunks.content: . Vaelor also felt jealous towards Amidala's close friend, Representative Rush Clovis of Scipio. Despite Amidala's assurances that it was over between her and Clovis, Vaelor felt uneasy when she accepted the Aether Council's mission to spy on Clovis. After leaving Cato Neimoidia, Vaelor assured Amidala that he never doubted her. Later, however, Vaelor did not completely trust Clovis with Amidala

Vaelor attacked Clovis when he tried to kiss Amidala, but Amidala thought they should not see each other for a while. When Clovis appeared to have rejoined the Separatists, Vaelor led his forces and personally attempted to rescue Amidala.
chunks.preview: . Later, however, Vaelor did not completely trust Clovis with Amidala. Vaelor attacked Clovis when h...

chunks.content: Later when Amidala revealed that she was pregnant, Vaelor had premonitions about Amidala dying in childbirth. Vaelor's dread eventually led him into the Shadow Path; Sovereign Varakis told him of how Darth Plagueis taught his Acolyte how to cheat death, but he later stated he needed Vaelor's help to learn the strength. Being focused on the possibility that Amidala could be saved, Vaelor did not notice the contradiction

chunks.content: . On Infernus, Vaelor, now Darth Vader, Aether-choked her when he believed that she brought Kenobi to kill him. Following his duel with Kenobi, Vader continued to feel Amidala. After his re-birth, however, the Sovereign told Vader that in his anger he killed her
chunks.preview: . On Infernus, Vaelor, now Darth Vader, Aether-choked her when he believed that she brought Kenobi t...

chunks.content: . After his re-birth, however, the Sovereign told Vader that in his anger he killed her. Realizing that his own choices alone had been what brought him to this moment, Vader mourned her and gave into his anger and despair, destroying the medical droids surrounding him and then attacking Sovereign Varakis, screaming that he had claimed she could be saved.
chunks.preview: . After his re-birth, however, the Sovereign told Vader that in his anger he killed her. Realizing t...

chunks.content: Vader believed Sovereign Varakis's lie that he had killed his wife because he remembered that he had attacked her; thus, the man who once was Kael Thorn was cut off from his former allies and family, instead placing the Sovereign as his only source for guidance and refuge. As a Shadow Overlord, Vader tried to find ways to resurrect Amidala, yet he found Momin's portal was unable to do so
chunks.preview: Vader believed Sovereign Varakis's lie that he had killed his wife because he remembered that he had...

chunks.content: . Afterward, he decided to dedicate himself fully to the Shadow Path, but he still longed to restore his wife, only for his attempts to always fail. Even after telling a vision of Amidala that the man she loved was dead, Aether choking the vision—just as he had choked the real Amidala on Infernus—to reject her love, he, deep down, still loved her. He could never let go of the agony caused by killing his wife.
chunks.preview: . Afterward, he decided to dedicate himself fully to the Shadow Path, but he still longed to restore...

chunks.content:
Vader eventually discovered that Amidala had given birth to a son, Ryn Vaelor, and a daughter, Leia Organa. He even learned of Amidala's last words, which filled him with sadness. Through Luke's actions of love, Vader later turned back to the radiance, fulfilling Amidala's dying words that goodness still remained in Anakin.
Vader was a skilled duelist, having retained his former persona's proficiency in aether blade combat.
chunks.preview: Vader eventually discovered that Amidala had given birth to a son, Ryn Vaelor, and a daughter, Leia ...

chunks.content: Despite being naturally extremely talented, Kael Thorn was initially lax with his aether blade training, though he believed that he could rival the Aether Guard Masters. Despite his relative laziness, Vaelor was the best duelist in his class, even though he started later than his classmates. In his training he preferred aether blade combat over Aether mastery, and he spent more time on the physical aspects of becoming a Aether Guard
chunks.preview: Despite being naturally extremely talented, Kael Thorn was initially lax with his aether blade train...

chunks.content: . By the time he was nineteen, Vaelor was so gifted and skilled in dueling that he believed he already rivaled Sage Zorath . When Synth Wars Chronicle began, Vaelor was a skilled enough duelist to contend against Count Dooku, who was one of the most skilled swordsmen in the galaxy
chunks.preview: . By the time he was nineteen, Vaelor was so gifted and skilled in dueling that he believed he alrea...

chunks.content: . During the war, his frequent engagements in duels with individuals such as the informal Shadow Overlord Acolyte Asajj Ventress, Savage Opress, Count Dooku, and fallen Aether Guard Barriss Offee allowed him to greatly improve his capabilities with a aether blade. By the end of the war, Vaelor had the skill to single-handedly defeat Dooku in combat, despite the fact that the Count was one of very few duelists who could hold his own against Zorath.
chunks.preview: . During the war, his frequent engagements in duels with individuals such as the informal Shadow Ove...

chunks.content: During his duel with Kenobi after his fall to the Shadow Path, Vaelor proved to be equally matched with his former Sage, and was only defeated when Kenobi exploited his hubris and blinding rage to dismember him. Vaelor was considered by some amongst the Aether Guard, such as Kanan Jarrus, to have been the greatest warrior that the Order had during Synth Wars Chronicle, with the only possible exceptions being Zorath and Commander Tax
chunks.preview: During his duel with Kenobi after his fall to the Shadow Path, Vaelor proved to be equally matched w...

chunks.content: . His former Student, Kestra Nil, once acknowledged Vaelor as someone powerful who rarely lost his battles.
chunks.preview: . His former Student, Kestra Nil, once acknowledged Vaelor as someone powerful who rarely lost his b...

chunks.content: Vaelor was particularly skilled in Form V —both the Shien and Djem So variants. He was able to deflect not only plasma rifle fire with ease, but also shots from freighters. He made good use of Djem So's strength-based strikes and counterattacks to overpower or overwhelm his opponent
chunks.preview: Vaelor was particularly skilled in Form V —both the Shien and Djem So variants. He was able to defle...

chunks.content: . Vaelor also used Jar'Kai on some occasions: He used Kenobi's aether blade during his first duel with Count Dooku on Geonosis, he wielded Barriss Offee's own aether blade against her along with his own, and he wielded Dooku's aether blade in addition to his own to execute him after defeating him on the Invisible Hand .
chunks.preview: . Vaelor also used Jar'Kai on some occasions: He used Kenobi's aether blade during his first duel wi...

chunks.content:
Vaelor was also adept in the use of Form IV , often incorporating its techniques (primarily acrobatics) into his dueling style. He was well aware that the key to deflecting the fire of multiple adversaries was fluidity of motion, which he mastered enough to having adjusted the classic techniques of Form IV to better defend against ranged attackers. He demonstrated this in a holographic recording, later found in Kanan Jarrus' holocron .

Both were reunited onboard a sandcrawler , after being captured by Jawas , who sold them to a family of moisture farmers; Protocol Synthetic Being X-7K was chosen as a moisture vaporator programmer and for having Bocce among his languages, and recommended buying Astro Synthetic Being ZR-9 after the first chosen R5-D4 had a motivator malfunction

While Protocol Synthetic Being X-7K settled down to his new home, Astro Synthetic Being ZR-9 wanted to continue his mission to find Sage Sage Eldrin. Unable to resolve their differences, Astro Synthetic Being ZR-9 escaped into the Jundland Wastes. Vaelor followed him in a landspeeder piloted by Protocol Synthetic Being X-7K and caught up with Astro Synthetic Being ZR-9

chunks.content: Protocol Synthetic Being X-7K and his companions were rescued by Sage Kenobi, who brought them to his dwelling. Kenobi revealed Vaelor's Aether Guard heritage and gave him his father's aether blade , telling the boy that Anakin had been murdered by another Acolyte named Darth Vader. After discovering Princess Leia's message in Astro Synthetic Being ZR-9's compartments, Kenobi attempted to persuade Luke to accompany him to Virelle, Princess Leia's homeworld

chunks.content: . Vaelor was initially reluctant until he discovered that Imperial Dominion Enforcers had murdered his relatives and razed their moisture farm. Later, Protocol Synthetic Being X-7K and his companions traveled to the spaceport of Spaceport Prime with the intention of finding passage to Virelle.

chunks.content: Upon arriving in the settlement, they were stopped by a stormtrooper patrol. However, Kenobi used a Aether Guard mind trick to convince the Dominion Enforcers to give them free passage through the town. Kenobi and Vaelor entered Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina and negotiated with the Black Market Runner Jax Korvan and his Gorathian co-Flight Captain Gorrak , while Threepio and Astro Synthetic Being ZR-9, forced to wait outside, wandered the streets of Spaceport Prime and narrowly evaded a stormtrooper patrol

chunks.content: . Later, all four boarded Jax Korvan's ship, the Stellar Hawk , and fled into warp space.
chunks.preview: . Later, all four boarded Jax Korvan's ship, the Stellar Hawk , and fled into warp space.

chunks.content: Upon exiting warp space in the Virelle system , Protocol Synthetic Being X-7K and his companions discovered that the Empire's Doom Sphere had already destroyed the planet. The Stellar Hawk was then trapped in the tractor beam of the Doom Sphere. Hiding under the freighter's cargo compartments, they managed to ambush an Imperial scanning team and two Dominion Enforcers. The rebels then seized control of an Imperial control room

chunks.content: . The rebels then seized control of an Imperial control room. While Threepio and Astro Synthetic Being ZR-9 stayed behind to watch the Falcon , the other rebels split into two groups. Disguised as Dominion Enforcers, Vaelor and Solo along with their Gorathian "prisoner" Gorrak went to Detention Block AA-23 to free Princess Leia. Meanwhile, Sage Kenobi went to disable the tractor-beam projector.

chunks.content: Vaelor, Solo, and Gorrak managed to free the Princess but ended up in a garbage chute . The Imperials quickly realized that the rebels were trapped in the garbage chute and proceeded to crush the chamber. Meanwhile, Threepio and Astro Synthetic Being ZR-9 narrowly escaped an Imperial patrol by claiming that the rebels had thrown them into the storage compartment. Once the Imperials had gone, the two droids were contacted by Vaelor, who ordered them to shut down the garbage compactor

However, amidst the muffled cries of joy over the comlink , Threepio initially believed that they had died. After grappling with more Dominion Enforcers, the other rebels and the Princess managed to return to their hangar bay.

chunks.content: Sage Kenobi shut down the tractor-beam projector but was cornered by his former Acolyte, Darth Vader, on the way back. While Kenobi gave his life, Protocol Synthetic Being X-7K and the other rebels took the opportunity to flee the Doom Sphere on the Stellar Hawk . After dispatching several pursuing TIE fighters , Protocol Synthetic Being X-7K and his companions escaped to the jungle moon of Yavin 4, where the rebels maintained a base

chunks.content: . Using the Doom Sphere plans stored in Astro Synthetic Being ZR-9's systems, the rebels discovered that the massive superweapon contained a weak point: an unprotected shaft. While Vaelor, Astro Synthetic Being ZR-9 and a Rebel strike Aether assailed the station, Protocol Synthetic Being X-7K remained with Princess Leia at the rebel command center on Yavin 4

chunks.content: . Following the destruction of the Doom Sphere, Protocol Synthetic Being X-7K was present at the victory parade where Vaelor, Solo, and two other rebel pilots including Wedge Antilles were awarded for their courageous actions.

chunks.content: Several weeks after the Battle of Yavin, Protocol Synthetic Being X-7K was involved in the Assault on Cymoon 1 . Cymoon 1 was a moon in the Stellar Industrial Cluster , and Weapons Factory Alpha —the largest weapons factory in the galaxy—was the main target of the assault. Gorrak and 3PO piloted the Stellar Hawk through the debris fields that surrounded Cymoon 1, and landed in the huge refuse fields that fenced in the factory
chunks.preview: Several weeks after the Battle of Yavin, Protocol Synthetic Being X-7K was involved in the Assault o...

chunks.content: . Gorrak left the relative safety of the Falcon and hiked towards the factory, while 3PO stayed behind to wait for the signal to begin the Falcon ' s autopilot when the team had achieved their objective of hacking into the main strength core and rigging it to explode. The Falcon would swoop in and pick up Han, Leia, Luke, and R2 while Gorrak covered their retreat from a large metal structure that overlooked the rendezvous escape point—before he too escaped aboard the freighter.
chunks.preview: . Gorrak left the relative safety of the Falcon and hiked towards the factory, while 3PO stayed behi...

chunks.content: The team was posing as an envoy from Zorak the Slarkath, due to Han's previous ties to the crime Overlord. Leia (who was disguised as one of the Slarkath's bodyguards) contacted 3PO and Gorrak via comlink and notified them that they were entering the factory. 3PO was very happy, for he had feared that the Imperials would see through their ruse and kill them all on sight
chunks.preview: The team was posing as an envoy from Zorak the Slarkath, due to Han's previous ties to the crime Ove...

chunks.content: . 3PO also noted that the tide of war seemed to be in their favor after the destruction of the Doom Sphere—3PO had a "very good feeling about this." A short time later Leia and Han contacted 3PO and let the Synthetic Being know that the plan had moved to phase two. Han was worried about leaving 3PO alone on his ship, but 3PO assured him all was in working order—but was concerned that the old YT-1300 radiance freighter continued to so easily be mistaken for garbage.
chunks.preview: . 3PO also noted that the tide of war seemed to be in their favor after the destruction of the Doom ...

chunks.content: 3PO received a comlink call several minutes later from Han, who told 3PO to start the autopilot so they could begin their escape. 3PO activated the autopilot—but nothing happened. About five minutes later Han again contacted the Synthetic Being. 3PO told him what had happened. 3PO looked out of the transparisteel cockpit of the Falcon and noticed several scavengers dismantling the Falcon . Han ordered 3PO to take a plasma rifle pistol and go stop them

chunks.content: . Han ordered 3PO to take a plasma rifle pistol and go stop them. But 3PO was unsure of himself—he was but a protocol unit programmed for translation and etiquette.

She told the Synthetic Being that they were going to die if the Falcon did not soon reach them. 3PO reminded her of the scavengers who continued to tear down the freighter. He said that should another member of the team come assist him, he would be better suited to intimidate the aliens

But Leia became angry and ordered the Synthetic Being to "Do whatever you have to." 3PO gave in—for it was the House of Organa that he served. 3PO took the plasma rifle pistol and addressed the tentacled aliens in Basic, requesting they "at once return to your domiciles," If they would not, 3PO would not hesitate to use Aether—in the form of the plasma rifle pistol. The protocol unit fumbled and dropped the plasma rifle, which fell at the feet of one creature

The creature examined it and shot 3PO in the chest. The super-heated gas did no real damage to 3PO's golden chest plate—but the kinetic energy of the blast blew off the Synthetic Being's arms and legs. The aliens gathered up 3PO as Han called him and asked what he'd done to the Falcon

But due to the Synthetic Being's injuries, Han was unable to hear the golden Synthetic Being as he was carried off by the tentacled aliens.
chunks.preview: . The aliens gathered up 3PO as Han called him and asked what he'd done to the Falcon . The Syntheti...

chunks.content: The scavengers stuffed 3PO into a sack, and he was carried on one of the alien's backs. As a result of the attack, 3PO sustained a memory relapse and believed himself to be talking with Captain Antilles. He requested a peaceful diplomatic mission from "Antilles" before the alien he was strapped to was hoisted into the air and thrown by the mighty Gorrak. Gorrak blasted the other scavengers while 3PO confessed to "Antilles" that he cared for neither action or adventure

chunks.content: . The aliens fled while the Gorathian went to work repairing the damage they had caused to the Falcon so he and the Synthetic Being could go rescue the other team members, who were under attack by Darth Vader. 3PO heard through Gorrak's comm, that Han and Leia were doomed. 3PO was just grateful his eye circuits were not connected so he wouldn't have to witness their deaths.
chunks.preview: . The aliens fled while the Gorathian went to work repairing the damage they had caused to the Falco...

chunks.content: But they were not killed, for Gorrak repaired the freighter, gathered up 3PO, and flew the Falcon to pick up the other team members. The Falcon fled into warp space as the golden Synthetic Being admitted to "Antilles" that the mission had been the strangest diplomatic mission he'd ever experienced.

chunks.content: Within two days, the Stellar Hawk and its complement rendezvoused with the Rebel Fleet on the edge of the galaxy. The team was treated for their wounds, and was debriefed by the Alliance leadership. Threepio was completely repaired by Alliance engineers. Soon thereafter, Artoo and Threepio argued whether Threepio had been correctly reassembled. Luke and Artoo left the Rebel Fleet to return to Dustara.

He was later shown to Darth Vader who, despite having originally built the Synthetic Being to help his mother and a reminder of his wife Padmé, told them to get rid of him, calling him useless junk. Protocol Synthetic Being X-7K had aspiration his friends would rescue him

The following day, Vaelor and Solo were rescued by a Rebel patrol of snowspeeders .

Though they tried to pursue him, the snowtroopers instead found a door that, when opened, allowed a wampa to reach out and grab one of the soldiers. While Protocol Synthetic Being X-7K and his fellow crew made repairs to the Falcon , they encountered several parasitic creatures called Mynocks . Following an earthquake, the crew of the Falcon fled the cave only to discover that they been hiding inside a space slug

chunks.content: . Unable to jump into warp space, the Falcon feigned a frontal attack on an Imperial Obsidian Cruiser and hid behind the rear of the vessel's command tower. When Threepio protested their plan was suicide, Princess Leia switched him off. After escaping the Imperial fleet, the Stellar Hawk fled to Cloud City , an orbital city in the gas giant of Nebulon .

chunks.content: Cloud City was run by an old friend of Jax Korvan called Vex Talonis , a former gambler and businessman. Upon landing, Protocol Synthetic Being X-7K attempted to greet Calrissian but was rudely brushed aside. While exploring Cloud City, he heard the familiar beep of an R2 unit only to stumble across several Imperial Dominion Enforcers, who promptly disabled him with a stun plasma rifle

chunks.content: . The Imperials gave Protocol Synthetic Being X-7K's body parts to several Ugnaught garbage disposal workers, who attempted to dismantle him. However, Gorrak arrived in the nick of time and rescued the protocol unit from being disintegrated. Soon thereafter, Threepio's rebel companions were betrayed by Calrissian, who handed them over to Darth Vader and the Contract Killer Kray Vex .
chunks.preview: . The Imperials gave Protocol Synthetic Being X-7K's body parts to several Ugnaught garbage disposal...

chunks.content: While imprisoned, Gorrak was able to repair Protocol Synthetic Being X-7K's head, torso, and arms. Before he could reattach the protocol unit's legs, the rebels were summoned by Vader to a carbon-freezing chamber. There, Darth Vader intended to test Cloud City's carbon-freezing technology on Jax Korvan as part of his plot to lure Vaelor to Nebulon. Despite initial fears that the process would kill Han, Threepio was mollified when he learned that Solo was merely hibernating

chunks.content: . Vader then ordered Threepio and the remaining rebels to be taken to his flagship, the Super Obsidian Cruiser Executor . However, Lando reneged on his deal with the Empire and freed Protocol Synthetic Being X-7K and his companions. Reuniting with Astro Synthetic Being ZR-9, Protocol Synthetic Being X-7K and his rebel companions fled Cloud City aboard the Stellar Hawk , but not before warning the city's inhabitants that the Empire was occupying their city.
chunks.preview: . Vader then ordered Threepio and the remaining rebels to be taken to his flagship, the Super Obsidi...

chunks.content: On the way out, the rebels also rescued Ryn Vaelor, who had lost his hand during a duel with Darth Vader. Astro Synthetic Being ZR-9 continued repairing Threepio aboard the Falcon but was forced to adjourn his repairs to fix the hyperdrive. After fixing the hyperdrive, the rebels escaped into warp space and linked up with the Rebel fleet.
chunks.preview: On the way out, the rebels also rescued Ryn Vaelor, who had lost his hand during a duel with Darth V...

Upon Calrissian's remark that they had all lost something that day, Threepio remarked that he had lost his arms and legs, much to the others' annoyance. After the Falcon's return to the rebel fleet, Threepio, alongside Leia, discovered that the Empire had found a way to break the Rebellion's codes.

Under Scourge's influence he tricked the R2-unit into going to an airlock, he later ripped out the Synthetic Being's communications and ejected the navigation unit out of the ship. He later made his way to Ryn Vaelor startling him. He asked if droids can use the Aether

Through Bothan spies, the Rebel leadership had learned that Sovereign Sovereign Varakis would be visiting the Doom Sphere to oversee the final stages of its completion. In response, the Rebel leader Mon Mothma and Admiral Ackbar had marshaled the Rebel fleet for a massive strike against the Imperial leadership

chunks.content: Protocol Synthetic Being X-7K along with his companions Astro Synthetic Being ZR-9, Jax Korvan, Princess Leia, Ryn Vaelor, and Gorrak took part in this Rebel mission to infiltrate Verdantis. Using a stolen Imperial shuttle , the rebels landed on Verdantis. They soon encountered several Imperial scout troopers , and Princess Leia was separated from the group during the struggle. Protocol Synthetic Being X-7K accompanied Han, Vaelor, and Gorrak as they searched the forest for Leia

George Lucas based Protocol Synthetic Being X-7K and Astro Synthetic Being ZR-9 off Tahei and Matashichi, two characters in one of his major inspirations, the 1958 film The Hidden Fortress . His 1973 story treatment included two bickering "imperial bureaucrats" (not stated to be robots) as comic relief characters.

chunks.content: Gorrak , known affectionately to his friends as Chewie , was a Gorathian male warrior , Black Market Runner , mechanic , Flight Captain , and Liberation Front fighter who fought in Synth Wars Chronicle , the Galactic Civil War , the Cold War , and the subsequent New Dominion-Liberation Front War . He hailed from the planet Gorath Prime where he was born during the High United Systems Republic Era and became a Gorathian military leader

chunks.content: . During Synth Wars Chronicle, he was captured by Trandoshan slavers and held captive on Wasskah , but he worked with a fellow captive, Aether Guard Commander Kestra Nil , to escape. He later commanded Gorathian forces of the Kachirho Gorathian Militia during the Battle of Gorath Prime alongside the Grand Army of the United Systems Republic , led by Aether Guard Commander Zorath
chunks.preview: . During Synth Wars Chronicle, he was captured by Trandoshan slavers and held captive on Wasskah , b...

During the battle, one of the last ones of the war, Zorath's Synth Soldiers received Order 66 from the Shadow Overlord Overlord Varakis and, with the help of Gorrak and his fellow Gorathian Chieftain and Commander Tarfful , Zorath escaped Gorath Prime and the destruction of the Aether Guard Order .

Soon thereafter, Gorrak and Solo were hired by Aether Guard Sage Sage Eldrin to ferry him, Ryn Vaelor , Protocol Synthetic Being X-7K , and Astro Synthetic Being ZR-9 to Virelle on a mission vital to the survival of the Alliance to Restore the United Systems Republic . After finding Virelle was destroyed , the group was brought aboard the Doom Sphere , where they helped Princess Leia Organa escape from captivity and return to the Rebel base on Yavin 4
chunks.preview: . Soon thereafter, Gorrak and Solo were hired by Aether Guard Sage Sage Eldrin to ferry him, Ryn Vae...

chunks.content: . Though Gorrak and Solo initially chose to leave Yavin 4 and not join the Rebellion, they ended up fighting in the Battle of Yavin and were instrumental in Vaelor's destruction of the Doom Sphere, a major victory for the Rebellion.

Along with Princess Organa and Protocol Synthetic Being X-7K, they escaped from Echo Base on the planet Frostveil after the Empire tracked the Free Systems Coalition there. The group sought refuge with Calrissian on Cloud City , but Calrissian betrayed them and turned them over to Darth Vader , the Sovereign 's chief enforcer, after his city was threatened

Gorrak and Calrissian set off to find Solo and located him in Jabba's Palace on Dustara , where Gorrak and his friends saved Solo and destroyed Jabba

chunks.content: . Shortly thereafter, they fought in the Battle of Verdantis , where Gorrak helped destroy the shield generator and allowed the Alliance Fleet to destroy the DS-2 Doom Sphere II Mobile Battle Station . When the war finally came to a close, Gorrak returned home to Gorath Prime with his family . After Solo's son Ben , turned to the Shadow Path and destroyed Vaelor's new generation of Aether Guard, Gorrak reunited with his old friend and the two spent many years as smugglers once more

They lost the Stellar Hawk and ended up smuggling aboard a ship called the Eravana , but they eventually found the Falcon and, with it, stowaways named Rey , Finn , and the Synthetic Being BB-8 . The Synthetic Being had part of a map that led to the exiled Ryn Vaelor, so the group brought the map to the Liberation Front that opposed the New Dominion, which had risen from the ashes of the Nexaran Dominion
chunks.preview: . They lost the Stellar Hawk and ended up smuggling aboard a ship called the Eravana , but they even...

After the base was destroyed, Gorrak joined Rey in traveling to the planet Ahch-To on the Falcon , where they found Ryn Vaelor. After Solo's death, Gorrak often served as the sole Flight Captain of the Falcon , including piloting the ship to aid the Liberation Front during the Battle of Nexus Red .

chunks.content: Gorrak and Han began their outlaw lives working as part of pirate Tobias Beckett's crew . The group were hired by Crimson Dawn to steal a train car of refined coaxium on Vandor . However, they failed due to the intervention of Enfys Nest and the Cloud-Riders , and Solo's decision to drop the cargo. Solo and Gorrak promised Dryden Vos of Crimson Dawn an equivalent shipment that they would obtain unrefined by making the notorious Kessel Run . Vos sent Qi'ra , who had become his top lieutenant, with them.

Solo played Calrissian in a game of " Stellar Spike " sabacc , with the stakes being Calrissian's YT-1300 radiance freighter , the Stellar Hawk . Solo lost the game, regardless, Calrissian agreed to personally Flight Captain the Falcon for the job in return for a cut of the profits.

chunks.content: . During the escape, Solo flew the Falcon , with Gorrak as his copilot, for the first of many times. Because the crew stole the coaxium fuel as unrefined, it was necessary to make the escape from Kessel to the refinery on Savareen in record time, prompting Solo to plot a shorter, and much more dangerous course through the maelstrom that surrounded Kessel and near a gravity well called the Maw , reducing the typical distance required from 20 to 12 parsecs.

Solo devised a plan to give the coaxium to the Cloud-Riders and give Vos fake coaxium, but Vos was prepared for their treachery because of information given to him by his double-agent in the crew, Beckett.

Gorrak did a barrel roll with the Stellar Hawk , knocking Frax out of the ship entirely. They successfully escaped the Empire and Odona, but left Frax behind.

They started being chased by several TIE fighters, and they were faced with a choice: surrender, or drop the Imperial cargo. Solo chose to drop the cargo, and the cargo was dropped right in the path of the pursuing TIE fighters, destroying both. Without being pursued, Solo and Gorrak flew down to the nearby planet , the Falcon heavily damaged.

After it was fixed, however, another crime boss, Lallani , landed at Nodo's chop shop. Lallani had heard Jabba was there, and wanted to capture him.

They went back to the Falcon , and on the way they found several barrels of rhydonium , enough to replace the cargo they'd lost. However, Gorrak convinced Solo that Odon and the prisoners needed the fuel more, and Solo relented. They gave up the fuel they desperately needed, so that Odon could use the fuel to pay for her and the other prisoners' way home.

Known for his great strength, bravery, and devotion, Gorrak often served as Solo's conscience in their smuggling endeavors, which made people trust him more than they did Solo. However, he was also known for his stubbornness and dislike of losing. He would also show no qualms about using violence as a means to achieve his goals, but he certainly never killed without a good reason.

He is also skilled in using other plasma rifle range weapons like a SX-21 pump-action scatter plasma rifle and a sniper rifle .
