chunks.content: Overlord Varakis , born Sheev Sovereign Varakis and also simply known as the Sovereign , was a male human Dark Overlord of the Shadow Overlord and Sovereign of the Nexaran Dominion , with his reign lasting from 19 BBY to 4 ABY . Rising to strength in the Galactic Senate as the Representative of Aetheris , the secretive Shadow Overlord cultivated two identities, Sidious and Sovereign Varakis, using both to further his political career and deceive his way into accomplishing his goal
chunks.preview: Overlord Varakis , born Sheev Sovereign Varakis and also simply known as the Sovereign , was a male ...

chunks.content: . He orchestrated the fall of the Galactic United Systems Republic and the Aether Guard Order through Synth Wars Chronicle , and then established his reign over the galaxy which lasted until his death at the Battle of Verdantis
chunks.preview: . He orchestrated the fall of the Galactic United Systems Republic and the Aether Guard Order throug...

chunks.content: . However, the Shadow Path of the Aether gave rise to powers which allowed him to escape death , seeking further immortality until the Sovereign was eventually permanently destroyed and killed during the Battle of Exegol by Rey , his granddaughter born from his Strand-Cast clone son Dathan and his daughter-in-law Miramir .
chunks.preview: . However, the Shadow Path of the Aether gave rise to powers which allowed him to escape death , see...

chunks.content: Born on the Mid Rim planet Aetheris in 84 BBY as the High United Systems Republic Era ended, Sidious possessed a strong connection to the Aether , and was secretly trained in the ways of the Shadow Overlord by Darth Plagueis . He eventually betrayed and killed his Shadow Overlord Sage , in order to train his own Shadow Overlord Acolyte , Darth Maul , for the Rule of Two limited their ranks to two Shadow Overlord Lords at any given time
chunks.preview: Born on the Mid Rim planet Aetheris in 84 BBY as the High United Systems Republic Era ended, Sidious...

chunks.content: . As a result of the Invasion of Aetheris , a crisis orchestrated by Sidious, the Senate elected Sovereign Varakis as Supreme Prime Minister . The Rebel Faction Crisis and Synth Wars Chronicle were masterminded by Sidious and his new Acolyte, Darth Tyranus , in an effort to achieve galactic dominance. Following an attempt to arrest the Prime Minister , the Great Aether Guard Purge commenced with Sidious enacting Order 66 .
chunks.preview: . As a result of the Invasion of Aetheris , a crisis orchestrated by Sidious, the Senate elected Sov...

chunks.content: With the Aether Guard all but extinct, Sidious installed the New Order in the United Systems Republic's place , declaring himself Galactic Sovereign and bringing an end to the millennia of democracy . Shortly after betraying and causing the death of Tyranus, he took on a new Acolyte, having lured the Aether Guard Guardian Kael Thorn to the Shadow Path and transforming him into Darth Vader
chunks.preview: With the Aether Guard all but extinct, Sidious installed the New Order in the United Systems Republi...

chunks.content: . Their reign was virtually unchallenged for a generation until the formation of the Alliance to Restore the United Systems Republic . During the Galactic Civil War , the Sovereign sought to betray Vader, by replacing him with the latter's son, Ryn Vaelor . However, Sidious' plan backfired when Vader ultimately renounced the Shadow Path and killed Sidious to protect Luke
chunks.preview: . Their reign was virtually unchallenged for a generation until the formation of the Alliance to Res...

chunks.content: . Thus, with the Shadow Overlord's destruction, the Aether was brought back into balance, fulfilling Anakin's fate as the prophesied Chosen Bearer .
chunks.preview: . Thus, with the Shadow Overlord's destruction, the Aether was brought back into balance, fulfilling...

chunks.content: Through his Sage's teachings, however, Sidious transferred his essence to an imperfect clone vessel that had been modeled on his original body. Anticipating the possibility of defeat, he created the Contingency to destroy the Nexaran Dominion and replace it with a new Shadow Overlord Empire , in the event of such a setback
chunks.preview: Through his Sage's teachings, however, Sidious transferred his essence to an imperfect clone vessel ...

chunks.content: . His plans culminated in the destruction of the New United Systems Republic and the emergence of the New Dominion , the creation of Supreme Leader Snoke , who turned Ben Solo —heir to the Vaelor bloodline —to the Shadow Path, and the establishment of the Final Order . When the Sovereign announced his return to the galaxy in 35 ABY , the Liberation Front invaded the planet Exegol , Sidious' hidden stronghold in the Unknown Regions
chunks.preview: . His plans culminated in the destruction of the New United Systems Republic and the emergence of th...

chunks.content: . During the battle, the resurrected Sovereign discovered a dyad in the Aether in the form of the bond between Solo and Rey, a Student sired from the Sovereign Varakis bloodline . His lifelong dream of eternal rule was finally quashed when Rey called upon the strength of past Aether Guard to vanquish her grandfather by turning his own strength against him, destroying Sidious and his Shadow Overlord Eternal cultists .
chunks.preview: . During the battle, the resurrected Sovereign discovered a dyad in the Aether in the form of the bo...

chunks.content: Sheev Sovereign Varakis was secretly trained as a Shadow Overlord, taking the name of Overlord Varakis.
chunks.preview: Sheev Sovereign Varakis was secretly trained as a Shadow Overlord, taking the name of Overlord Varak...

chunks.content: The origins of Overlord Varakis were closely guarded secrets that he took to his grave more than once. He was born on the Mid Rim planet Aetheris as Sheev Sovereign Varakis, eighty-four years before the Battle of Yavin
chunks.preview: The origins of Overlord Varakis were closely guarded secrets that he took to his grave more than onc...

chunks.content: . The dynastic, noble Sovereign Varakis family belonged to the affluent class in Aetheris society , although throughout several points of time of his life, Sovereign Varakis did not have any living family members as far as the public was aware, and no records of obituaries for his parents existed, marking him as the last of his ancient family bloodline
chunks.preview: . The dynastic, noble Sovereign Varakis family belonged to the affluent class in Aetheris society , ...

chunks.content: . Sovereign Varakis was raised in the cultured city of Theed , his homeworld 's capital ; he formed connections with a reputable host of credible politicians produced over the centuries , all the while acquiring a great amount of knowledge on governance and the subtleties of strength during his youth. As such, Sovereign Varakis had been skilled in manipulation since boyhood.
chunks.preview: . Sovereign Varakis was raised in the cultured city of Theed , his homeworld 's capital ; he formed ...

chunks.content: The details about how Sidious came to study under the Shadow Overlord were known by very few, with it not even being known of when he did, but he became the Shadow Overlord Acolyte to Dark Overlord of the Shadow Overlord Darth Plagueis and took on the name Overlord Varakis. As a Shadow Overlord , Sidious learned all his Shadow Overlord Sage knew about the Shadow Path of the Aether , following the tradition first set by the ancient Darth Bane
chunks.preview: The details about how Sidious came to study under the Shadow Overlord were known by very few, with i...

chunks.content: . While apprenticed to Plagueis, Sidious constructed his own Shadow Overlord lightsabers . At the same time, little by little, he began to secure political strength.
chunks.preview: . While apprenticed to Plagueis, Sidious constructed his own Shadow Overlord lightsabers . At the sa...

chunks.content: As a young man, Sovereign Varakis had traveled throughout the galaxy , collecting art, at least some of which was connected to the Shadow Path, while doing so. Unaware docents would have written off his collection as junk, but Sovereign Varakis knew better. He learned new tactics for how to spread his strength during his travels that he kept secret for years to come. While training with Plagueis, Sidious was taught that two Shadow Overlord were required for their perilous machinations
chunks.preview: As a young man, Sovereign Varakis had traveled throughout the galaxy , collecting art, at least some...

chunks.content: . So, if they worked together in accordance to Darth Bane's Rule of Two , with one of them serving as bait for the Shadow Path of the Aether and the other as a vessel, they would succeed in acquiring the ability to harness the full strength of the Shadow Path and rule immortal for ten thousand years.
chunks.preview: . So, if they worked together in accordance to Darth Bane's Rule of Two , with one of them serving a...

chunks.content: Overlord Varakis and Darth Plagueis worked together for years, trying to unlock the secrets to immortality, which was the obsession and longtime lust of Plagueis. Sidious was eventually made aware of Plagueis' ability to manipulate the aether particles to create life, which his Sage employed to prevent the people he cared for from dying
chunks.preview: Overlord Varakis and Darth Plagueis worked together for years, trying to unlock the secrets to immor...

chunks.content: . Plagueis believed the secret to immortality laid within science, and so conducted "unnatural" experiments with his rare ability to manipulate the aether particles, as part of the pair's in depth studies into the biological underpinnings of life itself. Though they were incomplete, they were encouraging to Sidious
chunks.preview: . Plagueis believed the secret to immortality laid within science, and so conducted "unnatural" expe...

chunks.content: . Though they were incomplete, they were encouraging to Sidious. According to Overlord Varakis' book , The Secrets of the Shadow Overlord , written later on his life, Plagueis discovered a form of "immortality" through transference , a Aether strength that allowed the user to transfer their spirit and consciousness to another body, essentially using bodies as vessels. This obsession with extending one's own life later passed onto Sidious from his time as Galactic Sovereign
chunks.preview: . Though they were incomplete, they were encouraging to Sidious. According to Overlord Varakis' book...

chunks.content: . Plagueis also attempted to create a Aether dyad with Sidious, a unique Aether-bond as strong as life itself and which was predecessor to the Rule of Two. However, Plagueis was unable to form the dyad.
chunks.preview: . Plagueis also attempted to create a Aether dyad with Sidious, a unique Aether-bond as strong as li...

chunks.content: Representative Sovereign Varakis represented his homeworld Aetheris in the Galactic Senate while keeping his Shadow Overlord identity a secret.
chunks.preview: Representative Sovereign Varakis represented his homeworld Aetheris in the Galactic Senate while kee...

chunks.content: In his public persona as Sheev Sovereign Varakis, Sidious took a great interest in politics and the public life of Aetheris. In 65 BBY he was part of the officials attending the opening ceremony of the Theed strength generator , with attendees noting his interest in the complex's deep-pit design
chunks.preview: In his public persona as Sheev Sovereign Varakis, Sidious took a great interest in politics and the ...

chunks.content: . His embarkment on a career in politics was further aided by his Sage, who arranged for him to be raised to the position of Representative for his homeworld in the Galactic United Systems Republic Senate as part of the Aetheris delegation , being elected in 52 BBY . His role also made him the Representative for the rest of the Chommell sector , meaning he represented a total of thirty-six planets. Once elected, Sovereign Varakis quickly joined incumbent Supreme Prime Minister Skor Kalpana 's ruling party
chunks.preview: . His embarkment on a career in politics was further aided by his Sage, who arranged for him to be r...

chunks.content: . He was followed by a grouping of aides who loyally followed him since his days on Aetheris. He noticed the fervent bickering and corruption that mired the United Systems Republic. He began to establish relations with those who would become his future collaborators, such as Wilhuff Tarkin . The duo met for the first time when Tarkin was still a cadet of the Sullust Sector Spacefarers Academy , and while Sovereign Varakis was still apprenticed to Plagueis.
chunks.preview: . He was followed by a grouping of aides who loyally followed him since his days on Aetheris. He not...

chunks.content: Taking an interest in the younger man, Representative Sovereign Varakis resolved to help him to join the Judicial Department , according to Tarkin's desire but advised him to also consider a political career. In the following years, their relationship became more and more confidential
chunks.preview: Taking an interest in the younger man, Representative Sovereign Varakis resolved to help him to join...

chunks.content: . In the following years, their relationship became more and more confidential. Sovereign Varakis often lauded Tarkin for his talents and skills and remarked they were very similar: they both came from planets at the edge of the galaxy but were destined to have great repercussions on the history of the galaxy itself. Tarkin eventually became one of the few people who called Sovereign Varakis by his first name.
chunks.preview: . In the following years, their relationship became more and more confidential. Sovereign Varakis of...

chunks.content: Keeping his Shadow Overlord identity a secret from the public eye, Sidious took it upon himself to execute the Shadow Overlord's long-percolating plan of supplanting the United Systems Republic with a new Shadow Overlord Empire , as well as destroying the Aether Guard Order . In the process, he would deceive the Senate, United Systems Republic and Aether Guard
chunks.preview: Keeping his Shadow Overlord identity a secret from the public eye, Sidious took it upon himself to e...

chunks.content: . In the process, he would deceive the Senate, United Systems Republic and Aether Guard. In his days as a Representative, Sovereign Varakis was known to have the backing of mysterious friends and allies who he might reference but never name; for example, even Tarkin did not know who specifically worked with Sovereign Varakis in the shadows, even if Sovereign Varakis often referenced them
chunks.preview: . In the process, he would deceive the Senate, United Systems Republic and Aether Guard. In his days...

chunks.content: . Trying to speculate as to who his secret supporters were, Sovereign Varakis's political enemies knew he had secret contacts aside from his loyal Aetheris followers and the senatorial cabal he was often grouped within. Rumors swirled that shadowy organizations and figures who worked out of the public eye—including industrialists, financiers and bankers from the galaxy's most major sectors—were linked to the Representative of Aetheris.
chunks.preview: . Trying to speculate as to who his secret supporters were, Sovereign Varakis's political enemies kn...

chunks.content: Seeking a Shadow Overlord Acolyte, Sidious traveled to the planet Dathomir and met with the Dathomirian Nightsister Mother Talzin . Intermingling his knowledge of the Shadow Path of the Aether with Talzin's knowledge of Nightsister magicks , Sidious had considered to make Talzin his Acolyte and right hand. However, Sidious chose her infant son, the Zabrak Nightbrother who would become his true Shadow Overlord Acolyte, Darth Maul
chunks.preview: Seeking a Shadow Overlord Acolyte, Sidious traveled to the planet Dathomir and met with the Dathomir...

chunks.content: . When Sidious visited Talzin, Maul always hid in his room, afraid of the man and worried about Talzin's increasing bond with him. Sidious was drawn to Maul for his inability to control his anger. Eventually, Sidious ordered Talzin to give up Maul to a keeper , threatening to not follow through on his promise to make her his Acolyte. She reluctantly agreed, and Maul ran into the forest angrily, overhearing the conversation from behind his door
chunks.preview: . When Sidious visited Talzin, Maul always hid in his room, afraid of the man and worried about Talz...

chunks.content: . When he returned the next morning, a Nightbrother took him and threw him in a pit, not allowing him to say goodbye to his own mother.
chunks.preview: . When he returned the next morning, a Nightbrother took him and threw him in a pit, not allowing hi...

chunks.content: Sidious killed his Shadow Overlord Sage Darth Plagueis, and under the Rule of Two, trained Darth Maul as his Shadow Overlord Acolyte.
chunks.preview: Sidious killed his Shadow Overlord Sage Darth Plagueis, and under the Rule of Two, trained Darth Mau...

chunks.content: Over the course of months, Maul was put through relentless domestic abuse, all orchestrated by Sidious as a test. With the influence of his keeper's sons beating him and the abuse, Sidious' wish for Maul came true; Maul's perceptions, and his love for his mother eventually turned into resentment and hatred for abandoning him
chunks.preview: Over the course of months, Maul was put through relentless domestic abuse, all orchestrated by Sidio...

chunks.content: . Maul's hatred started manifesting through the Shadow Path, and he would practice using the Shadow Path of the Aether every chance he got; eventually, the two brothers stopped beating him after seeing that their provocations were no longer affecting him. Sidious eventually orchestrated a selection to gain himself an Acolyte. At the Selection Arena, Sidious witnessed Maul after he was initially prevented from participating
chunks.preview: . Maul's hatred started manifesting through the Shadow Path, and he would practice using the Shadow ...

chunks.content: . At the Selection Arena, Sidious witnessed Maul after he was initially prevented from participating. In a sudden burst of anger, he used the Shadow Path of the Aether to Aether choke the two brothers, and then the keeper, all in front of Sidious and Talzin. Beyond pleased at Maul's progress and potential, Sidious declared Maul the winner and his new Acolyte, much to Talzin's dismay.
chunks.preview: . At the Selection Arena, Sidious witnessed Maul after he was initially prevented from participating...

chunks.content: As such, instead of following through on his promise of giving the apprenticeship to Talzin, Sidious stole her son from her and left Dathomir, leaving the Nightsister longing for revenge against the Shadow Overlord. Following the traditions set forth by the Rule of Two as it demanded only two Shadow Overlord, and deciding that Plagueis had outlived his usefulness, Sidious betrayed his Sage by breaking into his apartment and murdering him in his sleep
chunks.preview: As such, instead of following through on his promise of giving the apprenticeship to Talzin, Sidious...

chunks.content: . Sidious remembered with fondness the moment he realized he was more powerful than Plagueis and could kill the man who had trained him. He later reflected that "Sage" was the first title of strength he claimed for himself. Now the Shadow Overlord Sage himself, Sidious brutally trained Maul to be a weapon of the Shadow Overlord, viewing Maul's prowess and combat abilities as an invaluable asset to his Grand Plan.
chunks.preview: . Sidious remembered with fondness the moment he realized he was more powerful than Plagueis and cou...

chunks.content: At some point while training Maul, Sidious took his Acolyte to Malachor to bear witness to a great battle that occurred there between the Aether Guard and the Shadow Overlord. He forced Maul to breathe in the ashes of Shadow Overlord warriors , slain when an ancient weapon was activated in the Shadow Overlord temple on the planet. While breathing in this ash, Maul had visions of members of the Shadow Overlord order being struck down by the Aether Guard
chunks.preview: At some point while training Maul, Sidious took his Acolyte to Malachor to bear witness to a great b...

chunks.content: . He felt the slash of saber after saber as he felt the death of his Shadow Overlord brethren. These visions, in tandem with his training, made Maul long for revenge against the Aether Guard Order, which had defeated the Shadow Overlord a millennium earlier. Thus motivated, Darth Maul would serve as a powerful weapon in Sidious' plans to destroy the Aether Guard and restore the Shadow Overlord to galactic strength.
chunks.preview: . He felt the slash of saber after saber as he felt the death of his Shadow Overlord brethren. These...

chunks.content: Overlord Varakis lived a double life as Sheev Sovereign Varakis, using both identities to further his plans of galactic domination.
chunks.preview: Overlord Varakis lived a double life as Sheev Sovereign Varakis, using both identities to further hi...

chunks.content: In 42 BBY , Sovereign Varakis was introduced to Dooku , a Aether Guard, by the latter's former Student Rael Averross , after the former Aether Guard Sage delivered an address to the Galactic Senate on Nexara Prime. Following the invasion of Serenno , Dooku left the Aether Guard Order to claim the title of planetary count , but Sidious eventually recruited Dooku to the Shadow Overlord by exploiting his anger with the United Systems Republic despite also having Maul under his wing
chunks.preview: In 42 BBY , Sovereign Varakis was introduced to Dooku , a Aether Guard, by the latter's former Stude...

chunks.content: . Indeed, Dooku would not yet become a Shadow Overlord Acolyte. To fulfill Sidious' plans, Dooku betrayed and orchestrated the death of Aether Guard Sage Sifo-Dyas and took over his clientele for the commission of a Synth Army produced on Kamino ; the event was subsequently covered up when Dooku erased all records of Kamino from the Aether Guard Archives .
chunks.preview: . Indeed, Dooku would not yet become a Shadow Overlord Acolyte. To fulfill Sidious' plans, Dooku bet...

chunks.content: All the while, Sovereign Varakis maintained a faithful correspondence with Wilhuff Tarkin—whose service in the Judicial Department kept them from meeting face-to-face often—and supported bills in the Senate that would aid Eriadu and the Seswenna sector, Tarkin's homeworld and its sector, respectively
chunks.preview: All the while, Sovereign Varakis maintained a faithful correspondence with Wilhuff Tarkin—whose serv...

chunks.content: . After Valorum's re-election, something Sovereign Varakis attributed to senatorial special interest groups who needed a weak Prime Minister, whispers began to swirl Valorum would be unable to hold onto strength, with Sovereign Varakis's name emerging as a possible successor to the Chancellery
chunks.preview: . After Valorum's re-election, something Sovereign Varakis attributed to senatorial special interest...

chunks.content: . Around that time, Sovereign Varakis also met with Tarkin—who had grown disillusioned with the Judicial Aether—in his Nexara Prime office in one of their rare person-to-person meetings, where Sovereign Varakis urged Tarkin to enter planetary politics as Eriadu's new governor
chunks.preview: . Around that time, Sovereign Varakis also met with Tarkin—who had grown disillusioned with the Judi...

chunks.content: . Warning him something dark was brewing in their corner of the galaxy and promising Tarkin the support of himself and his shadowy allies, Sovereign Varakis convinced Tarkin, who promised to do whatever was best for Eriadu and the United Systems Republic in any manner Sovereign Varakis wished it to be done.
chunks.preview: . Warning him something dark was brewing in their corner of the galaxy and promising Tarkin the supp...

chunks.content: In need of pawns for his plans but preferring a mysterious, hooded presence through holographic transmissions rather than direct communication, Sidious contacted the galaxy's most powerful beings and convinced them to do his bidding with promises and threats. To that end, Sidious was also able to manipulate Nute Gunray 's rise to the position of Viceroy of the Trade Federation
chunks.preview: In need of pawns for his plans but preferring a mysterious, hooded presence through holographic tran...

chunks.content: . Gunray was able to arise to that position thanks to the Eriadu Conference , where an effort to end the squabbles between the Trade Federation and United Systems Republic ended in disaster; the Nebula Front attacked the conference and successfully wiped out the Federation directorate , creating a strength vacuum for Gunray to step into, while Valorum escaped and was able to secure a brief boost in popularity, with which he pushed through taxation legislation
chunks.preview: . Gunray was able to arise to that position thanks to the Eriadu Conference , where an effort to end...

chunks.content: . Convincing the Trade Federation to obey him by promising wealth, Sidious odered the Federation to construct a Synthetic Being army , Sidious also helped the Geonosian Poggle the Lesser rise to the position of Archduke of Geonosis and controller of their Synthetic Being foundries . With Sidious' backing, Poggle produced millions of B1-series battle droids for the Trade Federation military .
chunks.preview: . Convincing the Trade Federation to obey him by promising wealth, Sidious odered the Federation to ...

chunks.content: In need of someone to lead the the Synthetic Being Army for their planned war, Sidious and Dooku eventually took notice of and realized the promise in Grievous , a Kaleesh warlord once known as Qymaen jai Sheelal who led his fellow Kaleesh warriors in the war against the neighboring and technologically superior Yam'rii species. After the United Systems Republic and the Aether Guard intervened to support the Yam'rii, the Kaleesh had been punished, with hundreds of thousands dying of starvation
chunks.preview: In need of someone to lead the the Synthetic Being Army for their planned war, Sidious and Dooku eve...

chunks.content: . Sidious and Dooku, who had important plans for Grievous, took notice of his exploits as he became one of IGBC's most valuable resources. Also interested in how technologically advanced beings could be deployed, the Shadow Overlord offered Grievous a chance to be converted into a cyborg and hoped to recruit Grievous to command the Synthetic Being armies.
chunks.preview: . Sidious and Dooku, who had important plans for Grievous, took notice of his exploits as he became ...

chunks.content: After Grievous agreed to the surgeries to boost his own strength and underwent his transformation over a period of time, Dooku orchestrated a shuttle crash that destroyed whatever remained of Grievous's organic body. Extensive surgery performed by cybernetics experts and Geonosian biotechnicians , with assistance from medical droids, including the FX-9 surgical assistant FX-6 , was required to save Grievous's life. The operation resulted in Grievous physically being drastic changed.
chunks.preview: After Grievous agreed to the surgeries to boost his own strength and underwent his transformation ov...

chunks.content: Overlord Varakis worked to curb Darth Maul's overenthusiasm to fight the Aether Guard lest his Acolyte unwittingly ruin his carefully-laid plans and destroy them both.
chunks.preview: Overlord Varakis worked to curb Darth Maul's overenthusiasm to fight the Aether Guard lest his Acoly...

chunks.content: In 33 BBY , Sidious met with Maul in his hideout, the old LiMerge strength Building in the Works industrial zone of Nexara Prime, to chide him on allowing Aether Guard to sense his presence. Sidious told his Acolyte he did not care about his impatience, warning Maul that ruining his Sage's long-term plans would have severe consequences. Sidious then sent Maul to deal with a group of pirates harassing their secret mining facilities in the Kellux system
chunks.preview: In 33 BBY , Sidious met with Maul in his hideout, the old LiMerge strength Building in the Works ind...

chunks.content: . Sidious was secretly testing Maul's devotion by setting him up with the opportunity to face a Aether Guard Student . Maul proceeded to unwittingly follow the path laid out for him and slew the Aether Guard. After his Acolyte's return to Nexara Prime, Sidious revealed his knowledge of all of Maul's actions, asking if his Acolyte was satisfied with having killed a Aether Guard. Sidious was pleased when Maul replied that he was not.
chunks.preview: . Sidious was secretly testing Maul's devotion by setting him up with the opportunity to face a Aeth...

chunks.content: Not long after, during the course of activities in the Nexara Prime underworld , Maul killed a Aether-sensitive thief in an attempt to assuage his thirst to fight Aether Guard. Sidious called attention to the foolishness of such behavior, but Maul insisted that he had been careful enough to avoid leaving evidence that could alert the Aether Guard to the continued existence of the Shadow Overlord
chunks.preview: Not long after, during the course of activities in the Nexara Prime underworld , Maul killed a Aethe...

chunks.content: . Sidious complimented Maul's anger but warned him that he needed to temper it with patience, which Maul responded to with frustration at still being held in check. Sidious reminded him that his training was not as complete as he assumed, taking him back to Malachor to revisit the site where years before Maul had undergone visions of the Shadow Overlord being wiped out by the Aether Guard
chunks.preview: . Sidious complimented Maul's anger but warned him that he needed to temper it with patience, which ...

chunks.content: . Sidious instructed Maul to once again instigate another vision by breathing in the ashes of dead Shadow Overlord warriors. Through the vision, Maul learned the value of patience since rage alone was not enough for he and and his Sage to defeat the combined might of the Aether Guard Order. Pleased, Sidious pointed out that a combination of patient planning with the strength granted by the Shadow Path would, in time, see them successfully destroy the Aether Guard.
chunks.preview: . Sidious instructed Maul to once again instigate another vision by breathing in the ashes of dead S...

chunks.content: Around this time, Sovereign Varakis met, as he frequently did, with Prime Minister Valorum and Aether Guard Masters Zorath and Adi Gallia to discuss diplomatic matters of relevance to the United Systems Republic and the Aether Guard Order. One item of interest were the labor strikes on Garqi and Chamble ; for the latter, Sovereign Varakis suggested that the Aether Guard stage a training mission there

However, they could not find any trace of a body. The Sovereign had more pressing concerns however: he had sensed that Vader, far away on Infernus, was in danger of being destroyed. He ordered the clones to double their search for Zorath, and that his shuttle be prepared to depart.

chunks.content: The Sovereign made haste to Infernus, accompanied by a squad of the best shock troopers under the authority of Commander Thire . On planet, he found that Vader had been dismembered, horrifically burned, and left for dead by Sage Eldrin after the conclusion of their duel. He ordered the clones accompanying him to prepare a medical capsule for his Acolyte. As they left to obey his instructions, the Sovereign crouched beside his fallen Acolyte, determined to find a way to keep him alive.

chunks.content: The Sovereign was keenly aware that, without Vader, the foundations of his newfound strength would be badly shaken; he needed an Acolyte capable of ensuring that his Empire would survive the inevitable challenges that would rise up against it. To make certain that Vader would be capable of remaining a powerful Acolyte, the Sovereign contacted the boldest scientists he could, those whose practices would have been frowned on by the Aether Guard and the United Systems Republic

A strenuous night followed during which the scientists, their droids and their technology worked to save the critically injured Vader before he died. The new Shadow Overlord Acolyte was kept awake for the whole procedure, feeling the pain that came with saving his life
chunks.preview: The Sovereign brought Vader to the Grand Medical Facility, far above Nexara Prime's surface as a sto...

chunks.content: . Cylo and the other scientists designed a suit of armor that would protect his weakened body and allow his scorched lungs to breathe. Cybernetic limbs were added to replace the legs and the arm that Kenobi had taken.

chunks.content: After what the Sovereign would call a "long night," Vaelor was surgically reconstructed as a cyborg and encased in the armor and mask that would forever hide away who he had once been from the galaxy. As the procedure ended and the Shadow Overlord Acolyte rose, the Sovereign approached him. Vader's first query was to know whether or not his wife was safe. The Sovereign told him that he had killed Amidala in his anger
chunks.preview: After what the Sovereign would call a "long night," Vaelor was surgically reconstructed as a cyborg ...

Having Aether choked Amidala on Infernus, Vader remembered that he had, indeed, attacked his wife and thus believed the Sovereign's claim that he had killed her.

He angrily berated his Sage for promising that he could save his wife from death. The Sovereign conceded that he had failed him in that regard but countered that, with her death, Amidala had given him something so much stronger: pain. This pain would fuel his strength for decades and make him the dreaded Shadow Overlord Acolyte that Sidious had always coveted. It would also allow him to live

Satisfied, the Sovereign then assaulted Vader with Aether lightning, pointing out his Acolyte's lack of a aether blade. Afterward, Sidious warned Vader never to use the Aether against him in such a way again, or he would finish what Kenobi would not.

Exegol was also home to his most promising experimentations within a vergence of the Aether.

The unnamed strandcast was the Dark Overlord's "son." The strandcast, not a direct cloned replicate of Sidious, so nor entirely identical in appearance, was ultimately be a source of disappointment for Sidious

Drua led them to her village , which was home to escaped Zelthar slaves. When the village head Narmn asked for their identities, Sidious introduced himself, Vader, and Deez as "Krataa," "Irluuk," and the Sergeant

chunks.content: In the aftermath of Darth Vader's failure to prevent the Doom Sphere's destruction, Sidious was approached by one of the scientists involved in the Tarkin Initiative : Doctor Cylo. One of the specialists who had saved Vader's life after sustaining his fatal injuries on Infernus, Sidious had kept him on and funded his research into upgrading organic species into cybernetically-enhanced subjects. Cylo believed that organisms could only survive by adapting with technology and eliminating weaknesses

chunks.content: . He also believed that in the new world he foresaw, the Aether would be rendered obsolete. Although Sidious dismissed these thoughts by saying that everything was of the Aether, he was curious to see what these scientists could do unconstrained by the presence of the Old United Systems Republic or the Aether Guard.

When Cylo presented him his plan, however, Sidious knew that he could cause him to overplay his hand which would make him a traitor to the Empire

Additionally, his new body was insufficient for containing his spirit, due to his strength in the Shadow Path of the Aether being so immense, and consequently began to decay.

chunks.content: Buoyed by the faith of the Shadow Overlord Eternal cultists on Exegol, Sidious fought to survive in his rotting, weak, and temporary vessel. His body soon was unable to move on its own, and he took on a ghoulish, undead appearance with missing appendages and eyes clouded over with cataracts. Sidious was mobilized through the use of an Ommin harness , a mechanical spine once worn by Ommin , an ancient Shadow Overlord king , and the decay of his body was slowed by vials of restorative fluid.

Rumors of the Sovereign's death were dismissed as treasonous fabrications by Governor Ubrik Adelhard

chunks.content: Jax Korvan , known only as Han until being given the surname Solo , and formerly known as Cadet 124-329 while serving as an Imperial cadet , was a human male Black Market Runner . He rose from an impoverished childhood to become captain of the Stellar Hawk , a leader in the Alliance to Restore the United Systems Republic and an instrumental figure in the Galactic Civil War during the reign of the Nexaran Dominion

chunks.content: . Although he did not believe in the Aether controlling his fate , Han came to believe in the cause of galactic freedom, joining Aether Guard Ryn Vaelor and Princess Leia Organa in the fight for the Rebellion. Following the war, Han and Leia welcomed a son, Ben Solo , who became Kylo Ren after being lost to the Shadow Path of the Aether . Although their relationship foundered, Leia hoped that Han, as his father could find a way to break the Shadow Path's hold on Ben

chunks.content: As a young man fighting for survival on the mean streets of Corellia, Han yearned to fly among the stars with dreams of becoming the galaxy's best Flight Captain . With a fellow scrumrat named Qi'ra , Han lived as a street thief with Corellia's notorious White Worms gang until an important deal with Lady Proxima went bad, causing Han to flee Corellia. He was given the full name "Jax Korvan" by an Imperial recruitment officer while entering the Imperial Academy

chunks.content: . Han later met the thief Tobias Beckett and wound up joining his crew to steal unrefined coaxium from Kessel in order to pay a debt to Dryden Vos, a kingpin with the Crimson Dawn crime syndicate. By the end of this scheme, during which he reunited with Qi'ra, Han was forced to kill his mentor after a brutal double-cross. Han also became rivals and close friends with fellow Black Market Runner Vex Talonis and the Gorathian Gorrak , the latter who became his best friend

After ditching a shipment of spice to avoid trouble with the Empire, Solo owed a great deal of money to Jabba, who then placed a bounty on the Black Market Runner's head, as a result

There, they were captured by Darth Vader as part of a trap to bait Vaelor to the city . Solo was frozen in carbonite and taken to Jabba's Palace on Dustara by the Contract Killer Kray Vex , where he remained encased in carbonite for months until he was rescued by his friends

chunks.content: . After returning to the Alliance Fleet , Solo was promoted to the rank of Commander and was given command of the Pathfinders , a special forces squad , for the Battle of Verdantis . Solo led the Pathfinders to Verdantis , where he, Organa, Gorrak, and the special forces team, with the help of the native Ewoks , destroyed the shield generator protecting the second Doom Sphere that was being constructed in orbit . Their actions allowed the Alliance Fleet to destroy the superweapon.

Ben was seduced to the Shadow Path by Snoke , Supreme Leader of the New Dominion , resulting in the destruction of Vaelor's attempt to rebuild the Aether Guard Order .

Three children fought over stolen items they had pickpocketed. Han and Qi'ra embraced each other in a tunnel. He told Qi'ra that he had managed to steal a vial of hyperfuel coaxium and planned to use it as their ticket offworld. Moloch, Syke, and Rebolt soon caught up with them and brought Han before Lady Proxima, who asked Han for a progress report

Solo grew worried at Vaelor's disappearance, but they finished slicing into the reactor nonetheless, programming it to self-destruct in ten minutes

Solo figured "the more the merrier" and called Threepio to tell him to start the Falcon ' s autopilot and pick them up

Solo called Threepio, inquiring where he and the Falcon were, regretting that the planned chain of events had gone awry. The protocol unit explained that he had not yet arrived because the freighter was being dismantled by native scavengers . Solo told him to solve the problem and took off with Organa, Vaelor, Artoo, and the slaves in search of a way out of the factory

Later, Solo advised Vaelor, who was leaving on a journey to return to Dustara to continue his Aether Guard journey, to not leave because it was too dangerous. Organa chided him, explaining that the Rebellion couldn't afford to give away expensive items for free—Solo had to work for them

The princess rejected Solo's invitation: she threw the wine into his face, stormed out of the cave, and berated him for getting side-tracked on their mission—especially when they were in danger

Organa was shocked that Solo had never told her he was married, though Solo made it clear that he wasn't. Starros greeted Solo with a kiss, and then struck him across the face, which led Organa to decide that she wanted no part of their business

Organa ignored them and went to return to the Invictus , but Starros, by voice-control, told the Cobra to destroy the shuttle, which it did, cutting of their escape. Solo was appalled at Starros' ruthlessness and was forced to let Starros frisk him; she took his DL-44 plasma rifle pistol.

Solo did not understand what his friend was doing there, but he would soon find out: Organa promised to pay Starros if she took them to Nar Shaddaa—and Starros accepted

Flustered, Solo decided to admit the truth—he explained the robbery on Stenness, where he had participated in a marriage ceremony with Starros that was faked. He went to apologize to her, but behind the door, Organa was gone. Solo slumped to the floor, wishing Gorrak was with him.

As he approached the tree, his thoughts were answered by a voice, and when he turned he was greeted by the spirit of his old Sage Zorath, whom he had not seen in decades since he last saw him on Swampworld IX and Verdantis

His final thoughts were that his life in the realm of the living had ended in the same way it began: by the radiance of two suns, until he stepped into a larger world .

chunks.content: Kenobi was born on the planet Stewjon in 57 BBY . He was Aether-sensitive, and therefore taken from his family and inducted into the Aether Guard Order as a child . Raised in the Aether Guard Grand Temple on the planet Nexara Prime , Kenobi was assigned to Aether Guard Sage Sage Kormin . In 32 BBY , Kenobi attained the rank of Aether Guard Guardian by defeating the Shadow Overlord Darth Maul during the Invasion of Aetheris

chunks.content: With the advent of Synth Wars Chronicle in 22 BBY , Kenobi adopted the military rank of High Aether Guard Commander in the Grand Army of the Galactic United Systems Republic , and was given command of the Open Circle Fleet , the Third Systems Army , and the 7th Sky Corps . Clone Marshal Commander Cody served as his second-in-command throughout the galaxy -wide conflict, with their forces achieving multiple victories over the Confederacy of Independent Systems

Though they clashed in heated duels on multiple occasions, Maul failed to end Kenobi's life or cripple his spirit, despite murdering his former love, Satine Kryze , Duchess of Mandalore .

After discovering that Vaelor had turned to the Shadow Path of the Aether , becoming Sidious' Shadow Overlord Acolyte under the name of Darth Vader, Kenobi defeated his former Student on Infernus and exiled himself to the Outer Rim planet Dustara as the Nexaran Dominion rose to strength . Adopting a hermit lifestyle as " Ben Kenobi ," he watched over Vader's and Representative Lyra Vex 's son, Luke.

Later, Kenobi was hunted down once again by Maul, whom he finally slew to protect the young Luke. Kenobi began the boy's Aether Guard training in 1 BBY , and soon after encountered Vader aboard the first Doom Sphere , where he sacrificed himself to ensure that Luke and his allies escaped from the Shadow Overlord

In 4 ABY , Kenobi reunited with his former student, Kael Thorn, who died destroying his Shadow Overlord Sage in order to save his son. Kenobi was remembered as a legendary Aether Guard Sage during the rise of the New United Systems Republic ; Ben Solo , the son of Luke's twin sister, Princess Leia Organa, was named after Kenobi

chunks.content: . Solo's turn to the Shadow Path left Luke disillusioned with the Aether Guard Order's heritage, and he held Kenobi responsible for Anakin's transformation into Vader. However, Luke's faith would eventually be restored with the aid of Overlord Varakis's granddaughter Rey , to whom Kenobi would lend his voice and strength in a final battle and victory against her resurrected ancestor on Exegol in 35 ABY .

To curb Kenobi's behavior, Zorath searched for a teacher for Kenobi that had unorthodox methods, which would mold the student into rebelling by being dutiful.

As the pair struggled to establish a workable affinity, the Sage continued to train his Student in the basic cadences of aether blade combat, preventing him from picking a specialty. As time passed, Kenobi's demeanor shifted to become more serious and respectful of the Council, in contrast to the maverick Jinn's usual way of approaching situations based on his instincts in the present, even if that meant going against the Council's wishes. Both carried differing philosophies on focusing on the future versus the present, and interpreted the Aether in varying ways

Feeling angry by his Sage's abandonment, Kenobi decided to set off on the mission to the planet Lenahra alone. While he was there, he encountered a group of teenagers and datachips hidden on the world by the Aether Guard Orla Jareni long before his visit. He met a Besalisk named Dexter Jettster , who became a close friend.

Bounty hunters were sent after them, forcing them to live as fugitives, never knowing what the next day would bring them. The mission forced them to work and fight together as a team, resulting in them forging a close bond.

Kenobi fell in love with Satine during his stay on Mandalore, but despite his feelings toward her, he continued with his training and was reassigned to another mission after his objectives were complete

During the ceremonial hunt, the crab Synthetic Being prey of the event attacked Fanry, prompting Kenobi to destroy the threat. Upon investigation, he and his Sage concluded that the sabotage must have been conducted by someone within the palace, and not the Opposition.

chunks.content: In 32 BBY , by the time Jinn considered Kenobi to be ready for his trials , they were sent by Galactic United Systems Republic Supreme Prime Minister Finis Valorum to negotiate with the Trade Federation , who had set up a blockade around the planet of Aetheris . Both Aether Guard extensively studied political documents and trade relations between the parties prior to the endeavor, sensing its necessity. The two Aether Guard were tasked with negotiating a settlement with Trade Federation representatives.

Gunray then ordered his security to get rid of the Aether Guard and their assets, with an overhead turret destroying the Radiant VII and its crew.

The two escaped to Aetheris's surface by stowing away on separate C-9979 landing crafts in the Saak'ak's hangar bay, discovering a Synthetic Being army preparing to invade Aetheris in the process.

Piloting the transport through the planet's core , the trio was attacked by an Opee sea killer at one point, which led to the ship being damaged and electronic systems shutting down. Kenobi quickly fixed the issue with some rewiring, and after a brief encounter with a Sando aqua monster , Kenobi, Jinn, and Binks reached Theed.

Following this, the Aether Guard moved to a nearby hangar, intending to use a Aetheris starship to take the queen to Nexara Prime

During the escape, the ship's hyperdrive was damaged by Synthetic Being starfighters , preventing them from jumping straight to Nexara Prime and forcing them to instead land on Dustara for repairs.

chunks.content: Kenobi went out to investigate the mines and discovered that the Death Watch was using one of the facilities as a base. Taken hostage by the Death Watch, he contacted Kryze, who freed him, and together, they tried to escape when they were attacked and the Commander of the Death Watch arrived. Revealing himself to be Vizsla, he returned Kenobi's aether blade and dueled him with the Darksaber , until he ordered his warrior to kill him with missiles

chunks.content: . Kenobi and Kryze managed to escape, barely surviving, and returned to Mandalore. The next day, Kenobi told the Duchess that he believed the Separatists were involved, which only angered her; the Aether Guard Sage, then, was joined by Vaelor so as to bodyguard her during her and other senators' trip to Nexara Prime onboard the Coronet .

Then, Vaelor asked him Kenobi of their past, which Kenobi explained he and his Sage, Jinn, had been protecting her during a year-long, dangerous mission during a civil war on Mandalore. It was then that assassin droids were activated, prompting Kenobi to defend Kryze

When the droids were stopped, Vaelor reported to Kenobi that one of the senators was a traitor, and Kenobi then devised a plan to uncover the traitor's identity by using the last active Synthetic Being.
chunks.preview: . It was then that assassin droids were activated, prompting Kenobi to defend Kryze. When the droids...

chunks.content: It turned out to be Tal Merrik , who took Kryze as a hostage and made his way to the cockpit to jump out of warp space, so that Synthetic Being reinforcements could enter the ship. While Vaelor engaged the droids, Kenobi found and followed Merrik, who would blow up the ship, as he got near the escape pods, unable to make a move on the Representative. Afraid she might not see Kenobi again, Kryze confessed her feelings for him, to which Kenobi replied he would have left the Order if she had told him earlier
chunks.preview: It turned out to be Tal Merrik , who took Kryze as a hostage and made his way to the cockpit to jump...

chunks.content: . Then, Kryze took the opportunity to escape a disgusted Merrik and take his plasma rifle. However, neither Kenobi nor Kryze made a move to stop him, leaving Vaelor to sneak up from behind and stab him in the back, branding himself as a "cold-blooded killer." After arriving on Nexara Prime, Kenobi and Kryze reflected upon the situation, and the Duchess flirted with him, saying his beard hid too much of his "handsome face."

chunks.content: When Kryze's pleas to the Senate to not interfere with Mandalore's internal affairs went unheard, Kenobi reunited with the Duchess, advising her not to be rash, angering her. Soon enough, she fell victim to another terrorist attack and barely survived, prompting the Senate to accelerate the vote—with the United Systems Republic deciding to occupy Mandalore. Despite Kenobi's plea to help her, Kryze took matters in her own hands, only to framed with murder by the Death Watch.

chunks.content: Asking for his help, Kenobi met her and accepted to give Representative Amidala the disc she had obtained from his contact. Despite an attack by a Death Watch assassin and Kryze turning herself in, Kenobi got the disc through to Amidala, who then played the complete recording from Deputy Prime Minister Jerec in front of the Senate—prompting the Senate to vote against Mandalore's occupation
chunks.preview: Asking for his help, Kenobi met her and accepted to give Representative Amidala the disc she had obt...

chunks.content: . When the Duchess received the apologies and thanks from the Prime Minister and Mas Amedda, Kenobi received her thanks, though the two reflected about not knowing who tried to drag Mandalore into war and have the Duchess framed for murder.

Generals Kenobi and Vaelor, Commander Cody, Captain Rex, and troopers of the 501st Legion subsequently rushed to Kamino to aid in its defense. As their ship docked and hundreds of clones exited, Kenobi and Vaelor met with Shaak Ti and Lama Su to warn them of the attack

chunks.content: As the battle in the space above Kamino raged on, Kenobi noticed that something was amiss as the Rebel Faction transports took heavy damage. As debris rained down into the seas on Kamino, Kenobi warned Vaelor not to attack, believing that not even Grievous would attack so recklessly and that the enemy was up to something. He took a submarine and discovered Ventress's forces readying their assault crafts under water

Rejoining the fight, which had now been taken to Tipoca City, Kenobi worked alongside Vaelor again and determined that the sparse Rebel Faction forces must be a distraction and directed his former Student to go defend the clone DNA room while he sought out Grievous
chunks.preview: . He took a submarine and discovered Ventress's forces readying their assault crafts under water. Se...

However, Grievous and Ventress were able to escape once again

chunks.content: Later during the war, after the Senate hostage crisis , Kenobi was assigned to track down Ziro the Slarkath and Cad Bane with his old friend, Aether Guard Sage Quinlan Vos . The two of them headed to Nal Hutta , where they informed Gardulla the Slarkath and the rest of the Slarkath council of Ziro's escape and of Bane's help in this act. Though the Slarkath Council denied involvement in this, Vos was able to psychometrically scan a cup, telling him and Kenobi that Ziro had been there

Kenobi and Vos then tracked Ziro down in the swamp , where they saw Bane following Ziro as well, and found Ziro's mother who told them that his son had gone to Teth, where he would secretly recover the Slarkath Council records .
chunks.preview: . When they got to the prison level, however, Ziro had already escaped due to help from his lover, S...

chunks.content: Kenobi and Vos then proceeded to Teth, where they found Ziro shot and dead at his father's grave, and were then confronted by Bane. Though Bane tried to leave, Kenobi attempted to arrest Bane for taking the Senate hostage and engaged in a duel with the Contract Killer. Despite the Aether Guard's best efforts, Bane used his flamethrowers to throw them off the cliff, leaving the two to hang on a cliff, and escaped.

Vaelor managed to dispatch the tri-fighter that the assassin had sent for him and came to the aid of his former Sage. He then crippled Ventress's vessel, but not before she managed to shoot down the Aether Guard Sage. The two opposing commanders crash-landed in the hangar of the Rebel Faction command ship , Kenobi and Vaelor quickly engaged Ventress in aether blade combat

Though they both made to the rendezvous point, neither Rex nor the Aether Guard's ship could see each other. In fact, the Aether Guard's ship was guided to a mysterious planet , where they were met by a mysterious figure called the Daughter who wanted to lead them to The Father

In a cave, when Tano was asleep, his late Sage, Sage Kormin, appeared before him, explaining the purpose of the planet they were on and that the three figures they encountered, like Jinn, believed Vaelor was the Chosen Bearer. As Jinn disappeared, Kenobi woke Tano up and they resolved to find Vaelor together, only for the Daughter and the Son to capture them for Vaelor's test

Concerned, Kenobi contacted Tano and ordered her to disable the ship, fetch him on the well and meet with Vaelor—whose memories had been erased—and the Father on his Monastery

Kenobi then contacted Krell and the 501st, to order them to secure a Umbaran airbase that was resupplying the capital.

He also informed Krell of oncoming, but delayed reinforcements, only for the Besalisk to tell him he would take his battalion to the city regardless of the capital's defenses. When Vaelor became angry at recognizing D'Nar as a Zygerrian slaver , Kenobi told his old Acolyte to look for the colonists while he negotiated with D'Nar and explained Vaelor's history with slavery to Tano, who assured Kenobi she would keep an eye on him.

Kenobi then turned his comlink on so that Vaelor and Ahsoka could hear the fact that the Zygerrian had several bombs planted throughout the city. Kenobi then surrendered, but challenged D'Nar to a duel in the Zygerrian way (with no weapons) to distract him while Vaelor and Tano disarmed the bombs

Though he received a good beating from D'Nar, Kenobi successfully beguiled the Zygerrian, who set off his last bomb located on his tactical Synthetic Being and escaped from the Aether Guard Sage. Unable to pursue him, he told Vaelor and Tano of his departure. After Vaelor captured D'Nar and his ship, Kenobi, Vaelor, and Tano then contacted the Aether Council, informing them of the Zygerrians' abduction of the colonists.

To do so, he allowed himself to be shot by a sniper , Rako Hardeen , in front of Vaelor and Tano, who then believed him to be dead.

In addition, once Kenobi and Windu recorded a sample of Hardeen's voice in Trueping's , Kenobi swallowed a vocal emulator to perfectly disguise his voice as Hardeen's. Though Sage Mundi surmised it could be a deception by the Shadow Overlord, but Kenobi dismissed the idea, believing Zorath could not be susceptible to such manipulation, but Windu replied that, even as wise and old as he was, Zorath was not beyond the corruption of the Shadow Path.

The Aether Guard, however, ran deeper into the quarry without igniting his aether blade, but he was again cut off by Vader.

Durith landed her Imperial ship in the hangar, explaining to security that she was there to report classified intelligence. She then found a control room where she guided Kenobi in the stronghold via an underwater hatch.

With Durith's help, he managed to create a diversion that drew Third Sister away, he dispatched the Dominion Enforcers on guard, and retrieved Leia to escape. Rendezvousing with Durith, he donned a gray Imperial trench coat to blend in with the Imperial forces while they made their way back to the shuttle in the hangar

Kenobi, Durith, and Organa boarded Sully's airspeeder , though as they made their retreat Third Sister managed to destroy Wade's airspeeder, killing him. They arrived aboard Roken's ship and they departed Nur, mourning the death of Wade.

chunks.content: Soon thereafter Maul arrived, seething with rage upon seeing his old rival after so many years. Kenobi sent Bridger off on a dewback toward Maul's ship , which Bridger would use to fly back to Atollon. Maul mocked Kenobi's lackluster living conditions, and wondered out loud whether it would be crueler to simply leave Kenobi to what Maul believed was a life of misery and squalor
chunks.preview: Soon thereafter Maul arrived, seething with rage upon seeing his old rival after so many years. Keno...

chunks.content: . But rather than responding with mockery in turn, as he might have in his younger years, Kenobi calmly and succinctly explained to Maul that because he defined himself by his empty desires to kill, possess, and dominate, the former Shadow Overlord had nothing at all.
chunks.preview: . But rather than responding with mockery in turn, as he might have in his younger years, Kenobi cal...

chunks.content: This infuriated Maul, who ignited one of the blades of his saberstaff and struck the ground in front of Kenobi's small campfire, showering it with sand and putting it out. Maul questioned on his old nemesis's reasons for being on Dustara, noting it wasn't simply to hide. He then began to speculate, quickly coming to the conclusion that Kenobi was there to protect someone. Stirred to action by the threat of Maul to Luke, Kenobi ignited his aether blade and assumed his traditional Soresu ready stance
chunks.preview: This infuriated Maul, who ignited one of the blades of his saberstaff and struck the ground in front...

chunks.content: . As Maul tightened his grip on his own saber and ignited his second blade, Kenobi shifted his stance to the one used by his old Sage Qui-Gon during the duel on Aetheris in the Theed strength generator .
chunks.preview: . As Maul tightened his grip on his own saber and ignited his second blade, Kenobi shifted his stanc...

chunks.content: Maul dies in Kenobi's arms
chunks.preview: Maul dies in Kenobi's arms

chunks.content: Maul noted Kenobi's change in stance and after a few tense moments, attacked. He crossed blades with Kenobi twice before attempting to hit him with the same hilt-strike that had allowed him to kill Qui-Gon. However, Kenobi had evidently anticipated this, and he struck down at Maul's hilt as Maul struck upwards, bisecting Maul's aether blade and carving a lethal laceration into the former Shadow Overlord's chest
chunks.preview: Maul noted Kenobi's change in stance and after a few tense moments, attacked. He crossed blades with...

chunks.content: . Maul dropped his ruined weapon and collapsed to one knee, but Kenobi caught him before he could fall to the ground and held him. As Maul laid dying, he asked Kenobi whether the person whom he was protecting was the Chosen Bearer; the one prophesied to destroy the Shadow Overlord. Kenobi, who at that point believed that Vader would never turn from the Shadow Path, replied that he was
chunks.preview: . Maul dropped his ruined weapon and collapsed to one knee, but Kenobi caught him before he could fa...

chunks.content: . Maul appeared to take some modicum of comfort from this knowledge, seemingly certain that he and Kenobi would ultimately be avenged.
chunks.preview: . Maul appeared to take some modicum of comfort from this knowledge, seemingly certain that he and K...

chunks.content: Kenobi then traveled via dewback to the Lars' Homestead. Upon arriving there, he heard Beru Whitesun Lars calling to Luke and saw the teenager running back home against a binary sunset. Following the former Shadow Overlord's death, Kenobi built a funeral pyre for Maul, honoring his old rival.
chunks.preview: Kenobi then traveled via dewback to the Lars' Homestead. Upon arriving there, he heard Beru Whitesun...

chunks.content: Shortly before the Battle of Solaris VII , Kenobi wrote a set of journals, recounting his service to the Aether Guard Order as well as the United Systems Republic during the time of Synth Wars Chronicle and prior, in order to pass the time whilst a storm occoured on Dustara. During his final days on the planet, Kenobi encountered and rescued an injured stormtrooper named JM-909 , whom he nicknamed Jim, before bringing him to his hut
chunks.preview: Shortly before the Battle of Solaris VII , Kenobi wrote a set of journals, recounting his service to...

chunks.content: . Jim eventually escaped, but remembered Kenobi's actions after being scolded by his superior officer upon returning to the Empire. Following this, Kenobi stated that he knew his time on the planet was coming to an end, and that despite having felt alone for so many years, he came to realise that he never had been.
chunks.preview: . Jim eventually escaped, but remembered Kenobi's actions after being scolded by his superior office...

chunks.content: "Ben" Kenobi during his last years in exile.
chunks.preview: "Ben" Kenobi during his last years in exile.

chunks.content: As the Alliance to Restore the United Systems Republic foresaw open war with the Empire becoming more of a possibility, they decided to take every advantage. Shortly before the Battle of Solaris VII , in 1 BBY , Kenobi's old friend Bail Organa, who, by this point, was a high-ranking leader within the Alliance, decided to recruit the exiled Aether Guard Sage to their cause at Prime Minister Mon Mothma 's urging
chunks.preview: As the Alliance to Restore the United Systems Republic foresaw open war with the Empire becoming mor...

chunks.content: . Unable to attend to it in person because he had to travel to Virelle to warn his people of the coming war, Organa sent his daughter Princess Leia Organa to request Kenobi's help. Barely escaping from the battle that had just taken place at Solaris VII after having recovered the schematics for the Empire's planet-destroying Doom Sphere , she was captured in a battle over Dustara
chunks.preview: . Unable to attend to it in person because he had to travel to Virelle to warn his people of the com...

chunks.content: . Leia transferred the plans into Astro Synthetic Being ZR-9's memory systems and sent the Synthetic Being off to find Kenobi, leading Astro Synthetic Being ZR-9 and Protocol Synthetic Being X-7K on a crusade that led them to be captured by a band of Jawas and being sold to Owen Lars and Ryn Vaelor.
chunks.preview: . Leia transferred the plans into Astro Synthetic Being ZR-9's memory systems and sent the Synthetic...

chunks.content: However, Astro Synthetic Being ZR-9 ran off from the Lars homestead and off into the Jundland Wastes to try and find Kenobi. Protocol Synthetic Being X-7K, who was unaware of the mission given to Astro Synthetic Being ZR-9 by Princess Leia, encouraged Vaelor to go after the wayward navigation unit Synthetic Being, but, before they could return to the homestead, they were attacked by a group of Tusken Raiders
chunks.preview: However, Astro Synthetic Being ZR-9 ran off from the Lars homestead and off into the Jundland Wastes...

chunks.content: . It was at that moment when Kenobi showed up on the scene and scared the Tusken Raiders off by imitating the cry of a krayt dragon. Upon turning to see where the call had come from, the Tuskens saw Kenobi and remembered Chieftain A'Yark had warned them of a mysterious " shaman " who lived in the area. Remembering their chieftain's warnings, they quickly fled, although the young Tusken A'Koba intended to return in greater numbers to finally hunt down the hooded figure
chunks.preview: . It was at that moment when Kenobi showed up on the scene and scared the Tusken Raiders off by imit...

chunks.content: . Indeed, Kenobi knew the Tuskens were likely to return in greater numbers if they stayed in the canyon for too long, meaning he had to awaken Vaelor but also lead him to safety.
chunks.preview: . Indeed, Kenobi knew the Tuskens were likely to return in greater numbers if they stayed in the can...

chunks.content: With the Tuskens gone, Kenobi approached the unconscious Vaelor and checked that he was still alive before greeting Astro Synthetic Being ZR-9. However, Kenobi acted as though he did not know the Synthetic Being for Luke's benefit. Restoring Vaelor to consciousness, the boy told him that Astro Synthetic Being ZR-9 was looking for someone named "Sage Eldrin," to which Kenobi replied that was, in fact, his real name
chunks.preview: With the Tuskens gone, Kenobi approached the unconscious Vaelor and checked that he was still alive ...

chunks.content: . To avoid more Tusken Raider attacks, Kenobi brought the two droids and the farm boy to his home. There, Kenobi revealed that he had known Vaelor's father, and that he'd been a Aether Guard Guardian during Synth Wars Chronicle, choosing to talk about him before his turn to the Shadow Path.
chunks.preview: . To avoid more Tusken Raider attacks, Kenobi brought the two droids and the farm boy to his home. T...

chunks.content: Kenobi watches Leia's message.
chunks.preview: Kenobi watches Leia's message.

chunks.content: He then gave Vaelor his father's aether blade, which he claimed that Anakin would have wanted Luke to have it. When Luke asked about how his father had died, Kenobi was careful not to tell him that Kael Thorn and Darth Vader were one and the same; instead he twisted the truth, claiming that Vader, his former Acolyte, had fallen to the Shadow Path of the Aether and helped the Empire hunt down and kill the Aether Guard, including Anakin
chunks.preview: He then gave Vaelor his father's aether blade, which he claimed that Anakin would have wanted Luke t...

chunks.content: . Though he wasn't technically lying to Luke - the man who Kael Thorn had been had died when he became Darth Vader - he wasn't being directly truthful either, and Luke would not learn the whole truth for another several years. Afterward, Luke decided to show Kenobi the partial message from Leia Organa. The message finally played in its entirety, stating her father's request for him to aid the Alliance and that Astro Synthetic Being ZR-9 contained information vital to the survival of the Alliance
chunks.preview: . Though he wasn't technically lying to Luke - the man who Kael Thorn had been had died when he beca...

chunks.content: . After the message concluded, Kenobi requested Vaelor's help to see the mission through and learn the ways of the Aether, but Vaelor refused to get involved as he believed his duties at home were more important, but he offered to take Kenobi as far as Anchorhead . At the age of 57, and after more than nineteen years of exile, Kenobi was done hiding and being cautious, regardless of Luke's answer he needed to leave Dustara and confront the Empire by aiding the princess who had begged for his help.
chunks.preview: . After the message concluded, Kenobi requested Vaelor's help to see the mission through and learn t...

chunks.content: On their way to the city, the two came across the skiff that had sold Astro Synthetic Being ZR-9 and Protocol Synthetic Being X-7K to Vaelor and his uncle; it had been destroyed and the Jawas had been killed. Initially believing it to be the casualty of another Tusken Raider attack, Kenobi correctly deduced that the attack was, in fact, the work of Dominion Enforcers who were searching for the droids
chunks.preview: On their way to the city, the two came across the skiff that had sold Astro Synthetic Being ZR-9 and...

chunks.content: . Worried that the Dominion Enforcers may have gone after his aunt and uncle next, Vaelor headed back home despite Kenobi's claims that it was too dangerous. While Vaelor discovered that the Imperials had attacked the homestead and killed both Owen and Beru, Kenobi arranged a small funeral pyre for all the Jawas killed by the Empire's soldiers.
chunks.preview: . Worried that the Dominion Enforcers may have gone after his aunt and uncle next, Vaelor headed bac...

chunks.content: At this time that, Kenobi was met by the Aether Ghost of Jinn. Kenobi's old Sage helped ease his anxieties about Luke, specifically his dread that Luke would suffer a tragic fate such as Anakin's. Qui-Gon marveled at how Obi-Wan had remained so steadfast and resilient after suffering through years of war and losing everyone he ever truly loved to a terrible end: Anakin, Satine, Padmé, and Jinn himself. Qui-Gon reassured Kenobi that he was making the right decisions with Luke
chunks.preview: At this time that, Kenobi was met by the Aether Ghost of Jinn. Kenobi's old Sage helped ease his anx...

chunks.content: . Qui-Gon reassured Kenobi that he was making the right decisions with Luke. Sensing that Luke was returning from the remains of the Lars homestead, Qui-Gon bade his former student farewell and told him that they would see each other again, though kept to himself that Obi-Wan only had a short time to live. When Vaelor returned, the young man agreed to go with him to Virelle and be trained as a Aether Guard.
chunks.preview: . Qui-Gon reassured Kenobi that he was making the right decisions with Luke. Sensing that Luke was r...

chunks.content: The four ventured out to Spaceport Prime and to pay a visit to Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina —a place Kenobi had made rare visits to throughout his exile—in hopes of recruiting a Flight Captain that could take them to Virelle. During their journey, they were stopped by stormtrooper Foot Patrol 7 , as Commander TD-110 had spotted R2 and 3PO and thought they could be the droids they needed

One of his subordinates, trooper TD-7556 , privately disagreed, thinking that the boy and whom he assumed to be his grandfather would never be chosen by the Free Systems Coalition to protect their secrets. Claiming that he and Vaelor had owned the droids for several seasons, Kenobi used a mind trick to ensure the Dominion Enforcers did not check for identification and to ensure they could move along. The trick worked, with it even making TD-7556 believe Kenobi had been an Imperial

chunks.content: . Vaelor was skeptical about the prospect of finding a Flight Captain in the cantina, but Kenobi assured him that the best pilots could usually be found there, but warned him that the cantina could "be a little rough." They ran into a small bout of trouble when a pair of wanted criminals, Cornelius Evazan and Ponda Baba , began bullying Vaelor, but Kenobi was able to defuse the situation when he sliced off Baba's arm in defense of the young man
chunks.preview: . Vaelor was skeptical about the prospect of finding a Flight Captain in the cantina, but Kenobi ass...

chunks.content: Kenobi soon met a Gorathian named Gorrak , who served as the first mate aboard a freighter known as the Stellar Hawk , which was captained by a Stellar Black Market Runner named Jax Korvan . Solo boasted about his ship's speed to entice Kenobi. Though Solo's initial rate was 10,000 credits all paid in advance, Kenobi was able to compromise: offering to pay 2,000 credits upfront, with an additional 15,000 when they got to Virelle, for a total of 17,000 credits

chunks.content: . Solo was convinced and agreed to take them to Virelle. Kenobi and Vaelor then exited the cantina when they saw Dominion Enforcers, actually the very same troops Kenobi had mind tricked, who had entered to investigate the earlier disturbance caused when Baba lost his arm. Having been saved by Aether Guard during Synth Wars Chronicle, Wuher —the cantina bartender who had previously written Kenobi off as an old hermit—chose to lie to the soldiers, keeping the Aether Guard's presence a secret.

chunks.content: As they departed, the two were confronted by another stormtrooper , who demanded to see their identification. In response, Kenobi cut the trooper's plasma rifle and killed the soldier by throwing pieces of metal at them with the Aether. Realizing Dominion Enforcers were all around Spaceport Prime, Kenobi informed Vaelor that they needed to leave quickly
chunks.preview: As they departed, the two were confronted by another stormtrooper , who demanded to see their identi...

chunks.content: . However, they had been spotted by an Imperial spy named Garindan ezz Zavor , who had entered the cantina after hearing Baba and Kenobi's fight, enabling the Kubaz spy to overhear Kenobi's discussion with Solo. Waiting until he could see Kenobi and Vaelor with the droids, Zavor notified Imperial Dominion Enforcers of their location at Docking Bay 94 . Fortunately, the Stellar Hawk was able to escape Dustara

Soon enough, the Falcon exited warp space, and they discovered that the planet had been destroyed and replaced by an asteroid field

As a Specter Interceptor approached them, Solo decided to shoot the small ship, but Vaelor noticed that the ship was coming from what, at first, seemed like a small moon - the Doom Sphere. As the space station's tractor beam pulled them in, Kenobi told Solo not to resist, saying there were alternatives to fighting.

As the Imperial scouts got off the ship, Kenobi told Solo he would take care of the tractor beam, which prompted Solo to call him a "damn fool"; soon enough, with Vaelor and Solo disguised as Dominion Enforcers, they took control of the hangar's control room, where Kenobi learned the location of a terminal that, should one cut its strength, it would allow the ship to leave
chunks.preview: . As the Imperial scouts got off the ship, Kenobi told Solo he would take care of the tractor beam, ...

chunks.preview: As Vaelor, Solo and Gorrak learned of Organa's presence on the station and set out to rescue her, Ke...

chunks.content: . Vader claimed to be the true Sage of the Aether, but Kenobi, refusing to use Anakin's name and instead simply calling Vader " Darth ," instead claimed that he was only a "Sage of evil." During the duel, Vader noted that his age had made him weak, but Kenobi told his former Acolyte that he wouldn't win because he would become more powerful than Vader could ever imagine, even if he managed to kill him.
chunks.preview: . Vader claimed to be the true Sage of the Aether, but Kenobi, refusing to use Anakin's name and ins...

chunks.preview: Kenobi is struck down by Darth Vader.

chunks.content: The two made their way to Bay 327 just as the team reunited to board the Falcon , only for Kenobi to see the young Vaelor and give Vader a mysteriously knowing smile. As he raised his blade in surrender and took a deep breath, Vader struck him down and his body disappeared, for he had become one with the Aether, with only his Aether Guard robes and aether blade left behind on the Doom Sphere. Unable to attend to the body of his Sage, Vaelor was forced to escape on the Falcon with everyone else
chunks.preview: The two made their way to Bay 327 just as the team reunited to board the Falcon , only for Kenobi to...

chunks.content: . Vader, meanwhile, stomped upon his former mentor's cloak and collected his aether blade.
chunks.preview: . Vader, meanwhile, stomped upon his former mentor's cloak and collected his aether blade.

chunks.content: Kenobi's communion with Qui-Gon was successful as Kenobi did not vanish completely but instead became a Aether spirit. As he did, he felt past, present, future collide, seeing the eventual death of Solo on Starkiller Base , and his Acolyte's self-imposed exile on Ahch-To . Using his new-found abilities, he was able to guide Vaelor during the Battle of Yavin so that he could successfully destroy the Doom Sphere with proton torpedoes .
chunks.preview: Kenobi's communion with Qui-Gon was successful as Kenobi did not vanish completely but instead becam...

chunks.content: About five days later, the spirit of Kenobi would go to Swampworld IX, where he would visit Zorath regarding Vaelor. Kenobi listened as Zorath explained that Leia was by far the best candidate to pick up the mantle of Aether Guard, as Luke was impetuous, headstrong, unruly, and inattentive like Anakin. Nevertheless, Kenobi remained steadfast in his resolve that Luke be trained and was successful in gaining Zorath's approval to bring the boy to him.
chunks.preview: About five days later, the spirit of Kenobi would go to Swampworld IX, where he would visit Zorath r...

chunks.content: Meanwhile, in the aftermath of the Yavin battle, Luke deeply grieved the loss of his mentor, having thought they would train together longer. He began to question whether he had heard the Aether Guard's voice in the Battle of Yavin, wondering if it was his own imagination. When he was sent to the planet Rodia on an Alliance mission, Luke often contemplated what Kenobi would think of his surroundings, and told the Vexari Taneetch Soonta that he considered the Aether Guard Sage the personification of dignity
chunks.preview: Meanwhile, in the aftermath of the Yavin battle, Luke deeply grieved the loss of his mentor, having ...

chunks.content: . While on Rodia, Luke did his best to learn more about the Aether Guard from Soonta, whose uncle was the Aether Guard Huulik . With his extremely limited training, Luke struggled to move objects with the Aether, and felt dismay when recalling how easily Kenobi had mind tricked individuals on Dustara. By repeating the few lessons about the Aether he had received from Kenobi, the Alliance Flight Captain became more determined to retain and build his knowledge base

Although he tried to call upon the lessons Kenobi had taught him, Vaelor was outmatched, so he tried to call upon his mentor for help
