As Luke asked how he should get ready, he was attacked and captured by Commander Karbin 's Dominion Enforcers

chunks.content: Three years later, Kenobi would reappear to Luke on the ice planet of Frostveil , where he instructed Vaelor to go to the Swampworld IX system to seek out Kenobi's former Sage, Zorath, for further Aether Guard training. Zorath once again expressed doubts concerning Vaelor, still believing him to be too old, impatient and reckless, as much as he had anger in him like his father once had. However, Kenobi reminded Zorath that he had been once similar to Luke, back when Zorath taught him.

Additionally, he needed to appear on Swampworld IX several times to serve as a mediator between Zorath and Vaelor. Throughout Luke's training, Kenobi often found himself thinking of his experiences with Anakin

He told Luke that he must face his fate by confronting Vader once again

However, the fame of Kenobi's name and his deeds as a Aether Guard weighed on the young Ben, who harbored feelings of insecurity due to the expectations that had been thrust on him because of his heritage.

It was part of the reason why Solo hated his name as it reminded him of a heritage that he believed had been built on lies. Ultimately, he renounced his ties to the Aether Guard and adopted a new identity, that of Kylo Ren, following in the example of Kenobi's fallen Acolyte—Solo's grandfather, Darth Vader.

His salvation came when he sacrificed his life to save Rey—a selfless act mirroring that of Kael Thorn. Once revived, Rey looked at Solo and smiled, calling him by his name "Ben," who shortly afterwards became one with the Aether.

However, throughout much of his early apprenticeship to Sage Kormin, Kenobi possessed strong fondness for rigid rules and a largely by-the-book attitude when it came to matters such as the Aether Guard Code. The two later came to realization that Zorath intentionally placed Kenobi with a maverick Sage in the aspiration that he would rebel in the only way possible: by attempting to become a model Aether Guard.

The two had a very strange dynamic early on, with Kenobi feeling protective and responsible for his young Student and Vaelor worrying about Kenobi's commitment to him, having been abandoned in his life previously. As their relationship deepened over time, the two found that they could easily get on each other's nerves, with Kenobi becoming particularly annoyed by his Student's habit of grinding his teeth in frustration. For all their bickering, they cared deeply for each other.

chunks.content: Kenobi carefully measured his actions in any situation, garnering him the aforementioned nom de guerre. Kenobi was also known to be an accomplished storyteller. While hiding in the Jundland Wastes in his later years, he appeared as a kindly and eccentric old hermit. Owen Lars described him as "a crazy old man" to those not familiar with the ways of the Aether Guard. In his final days, Kenobi retained his traits of patience and foresight as well as gaining some of the boldness reminiscent of his youth.

Over the years, he was forced to dismantle systemic rituals and ingrained doctrines he had experienced during his time with the Aether Guard. He was left broken and unwilling to fight until his rematches with Vader ten years after Order 66, which left him with the belief that his friend had been destroyed by Vader

When Kenobi's mission ended, he chose to dignity his obligations to the Aether Guard Order in accordance to the Aether Guard Code. However, he regretted leaving the Duchess alone to rebuild Mandalore.

Since Aleena's atmosphere was toxic to them, the underground dwellers depended on a filtering process of the planet's soil that made the air breathable for them. The underground dwellers had set off this earthquake as a means of sealing the breach.

While Wolffe and his Synth Soldiers were skeptical of their story, the two droids' efforts were greatly appreciated by the Aleena.

chunks.content: George Lucas has stated one of his inspirations for Star Wars is The Hidden Fortress , a 1958 film directed by Akira Kurosawa . The roots of Protocol Synthetic Being X-7K and Astro Synthetic Being ZR-9 came from the film, as it features two peasant characters, Tahei and Matashichi, finding themselves on a grand diplomatic adventure, becoming the narrators of the story while they travel with a Commander and a princess.

chunks.content: The Synthetic Being's distinctive beeps and whistles were originally created in 1975-1977 by Star Wars sound designer Ben Burtt . Over the course of ten Star Wars live-action films, Astro Synthetic Being ZR-9 has been portrayed by a mix of costume shells "worn" by a small human performer, by remote-controlled mechanical props, by empty shells puppeteered externally, and by computer graphics.

chunks.content: The Synthetic Being's visual design was created by Star Wars conceptual artist Ralph McQuarrie in a series of sketches and production paintings from 1975 to 1976. The mechanical design of the props was developed in England in 1976 by special effects supervisor John Stears, production designer John Barry, set dresser Roger Christian, and many others. Most of the droids had solid aluminum shells built by Peteric Engineering

chunks.content: Shadow Squad: Nexara Heist is a 2016 film directed by Gareth Edwards and produced by Lucasfilm president Kathleen Kennedy , amongst many others. The screenplay, written by Chris Weitz and Tony Gilroy , is based on a story by John Knoll and Gary Whitta . The film's score is composed by Michael Giacchino , marking the first live-action film in the Star Wars canon to not be scored by John Williams . It is the first installment of the Star Wars Anthology Series .

chunks.content: From Lucasfilm comes the first of the Star Wars standalone films, "Shadow Squad: Nexara Heist," an all-new epic adventure. In a time of conflict, a group of unlikely heroes band together on a mission to steal the plans to the Doom Sphere, the Empire's ultimate weapon of destruction. This key event in the Star Wars timeline brings together ordinary people who choose to do extraordinary things, and in doing so, become part of something greater than themselves. In theaters December 2016 .

chunks.content: Cassian, Jyn and K-2SO arrive on Jedha where Cassian expects to meet up with a Partisan contact. The Synthetic Being stays on the ship while Jyn and Cassian set out to find his contact, but the duo is caught in the middle of an armed uprising against the Empire led by Gerrera's partisans. Jyn and Cassian find safety only after K-2SO disobeys orders to stay on the U-Wing and comes to their aid. After fighting off the Imperial troopers, the convoy returns to Tythoni Square where the uprising had taken place

chunks.content: John Knoll , a visual effects supervisor and the chief creative officer at ILM , began developing the idea for Rogue One in the mid-2000s, after learning that George Lucas was developing a Star Warslive-action TV series . However, Knoll put aside the idea once he realized that it would not fit within the show's concept. The series was eventually put on indefinite hold due to budget constraints, and Lucas decided to retire from filmmaking, hiring Kathleen Kennedy as the new head of Lucasfilm

chunks.content: . According to Kennedy, Lucas was "really interested in exploring all the stories that existed inside the universe." It is the second installment of the Star Wars Anthology Series . It stars Alden Ehrenreich as Jax Korvan in the years prior to Star Wars: Episode IVA New aspiration . Donald Glover portrays Vex Talonis and Joonas Suotamo portrays the Gorathian Gorrak

chunks.content: The film was first announced as a Jax Korvan picture in 2015 , along with the news that Phil Overlord and Christopher Miller would be the film's directors. Principal photography began in January 2017 , after which creative differences arose between the two directors and the studio. They were replaced by Ron Howard , who was tasked with completing principal photography along with what was reported to be extensive re-shoots.

chunks.content: Solo held its world premiere on May 10 , 2018 in Los Angeles , and it was screened at the 2018 Cannes Film Festival on May 15 . The film received generally positive reviews from critics, who praised the performances, music, and visuals, although some felt that the story was weak. Solo received a nomination for Best Visual Effects at the 91st Academy Awards .

chunks.content:
Han and Qi'ra defy Lady Proxima.
Six years after the formation of the Nexaran Dominion , on the shipbuilding world of Corellia , a human " scrumrat " and aspiring Flight Captain named Han and his love interest Qi'ra long to escape the clutches of the Grindalid crime boss Lady Proxima 's White Worms crime syndicate. Following a delivery job that went awry, Han flees some criminals on his M-68 landspeeder through the streets of Coronet City . He drives through a bridge and hangs his dice on the windscreen.

He tells Qi'ra that he managed to steal a vial of hyperfuel coaxium and plans to use it as their ticket offworld. Moloch , Syke , and Rebolt soon catch up with them and bring Han before Lady Proxima, who lives underwater.

chunks.content: As they reach the Maw Cluster , L3 constructs a model of the Maelstrom and warns them that they are approaching a massive summa-verminoth . Face to face with the monster, the crew tries to escape, only to end up at a large gravity well which Lando identifies as the Maw . Thinking fast, Han ejects the Falcon ' s escape pod into the well for the summa-verminoth to follow, and the beast takes the bait. Guiding the ship's systems, L3 finds a way out 90 degrees to the left.

chunks.content:
Han and Lando part company on Savareen.
After making the Kessel Run, Solo and his companions land on the planet Savareen to rendezvous with Vos. As the Falcon approaches the Bis Refinery , Solo radios the air traffic controller Dhowar Repareed , warning that he is coming with a cargo of coaxium that needs to be offloaded immediately. The damaged Falcon circles the coastal refinery before landing on a landing pad. Due to its damaged landing gear, the Falcon is lopsided.

chunks.content: As the coaxium is offloaded, Solo quips that he made the Kessel Run in just twelve parsecs with some generous reduced rounding. Han puts his arm around an un-amused Lando, who is grieving over the loss of L-3 and is furious at the damage to his ship. He tells Han that he will be waiting aboard in his quarters for his share of the money and vows not to see him again.

chunks.content: When Dryden Vos lands on his yacht First radiance by the Pnakotic Coast, Han along with Qi'ra and Gorrak go to deliver the purportedly "fake" coaxium canisters to the Crimson Dawn crime Overlord. Entering the ship, a masked guard welcomes Qi'ra home and tells her that Vos is waiting for them. When he asks about Han and Chewie's weapons, Qir'a vouches for them. The trio travel up the turbolift . Han is confident of winning, but Qi'ra says that the trick is surviving rather than winning.

Qi'ra claims that Beckett did not survive while Han claims that Beckett died saving his life on Kessel. Vos expresses admiration for Beckett's principles and thanks Han and his team for following his example. Qi'ra claims Han and Gorrak would make good mercenaries with their own ship. Vos is pleased that his top lieutenant Qi'ra survived.

Vos attacks Han with his Kyuzo petars and manages to knock the plasma rifle out of his hand. Vos chases Han around the room, hurling his daggers. While Han is distracted with Vos, Qi'ra draws a sword and manages to pin Solo to the ground, knocking the plasma rifle out of his hand. Qi'ra apologizes while Vos says that Qi'ra is loyal to Crimson Dawn.

Qi'ra tells Han to go after Gorrak and Beckett, telling him that if they give their coaxium to Enfys, they will need something else to buy a new ship. Before parting company, Qi'ra embraces Han and reminds him to look after Gorrak and to smile. She tells him that she is right behind him.

Following the deaths of Vos and Beckett, Han and Gorrak deliver the refined coaxium to Nest, who reveals her plans to use the coaxium, which is worth 60 million credits , to aid the rebellion against the Empire. She offers Han the chance to join her, but he declines. In response, Nest states that someday he may feel more sympathetic to the rebels' cause. Out of gratitude for his help, Nest gives Solo a vial of coaxium, enough to buy a ship for himself.

In October 2012 , as Lucas was preparing to sell his company, Lucasfilm president Kathleen Kennedy contacted Lawrence Kasdan , writer of The Empire Strikes Back and co-writer of Star Wars: Episode VIReturn of the Aether Guard , and asked him to meet her and Lucas to discuss new films in the franchise

One of those movies was about young Jax Korvan, before the events of A New aspiration . Kasdan was initially hesitant on being part of the new films, but he decided he could do the Jax Korvan movie as Solo was his favorite character. He pitched his idea to Bob Iger by telling him about the scene where Han gets his last name.

chunks.content: The Phantom Menace was released in theaters on May 19 , 1999, becoming the first Star Wars film since Star Wars: Episode VIReturn of the Aether Guard , which was released sixteen years earlier. The release was accompanied by extensive media coverage and great fan anticipation. Despite mixed reviews from critics and fans, the film grossed $924.3 million worldwide, making it the second-highest-grossing Star Wars film when unadjusted for inflation

chunks.content: Back in the command deck, Queen Amidala contacts Gunray to express her disapproval of their blockade, with Gunray explaining that they wouldn't have done it without the approval of the Senate. When she asks about the ambassadors sent by the Prime Minister, Gunray claims that they have received no such ambassadors, leaving Amidala startled and suspicious. Gunray ends communications with her and informs his aide that they should disable all communications on the planet.

Jar Jar Binks shows the two Aether Guard the way to an underwater Gungan settlement, Otoh Gunga . Meanwhile, the Trade Federation occupies Theed , the capital city of Aetheris, and captures Queen Amidala along with the rest of the government

In Otoh Gunga, the Aether Guard meet the Gungan leader, Boss Nass , and ask him to help the people of Aetheris, but Nass refuses due to hate of the people of Aetheris and sends them off in a bongo submarine . They are attacked by an opee sea killer and a colo claw fish but both fish are eaten by a sando aqua monster . The Aether Guard, with Binks in tow, arrive in Theed and rescue Queen Amidala, using the Aether and their lightsabers to dispatch squads of droids

chunks.content: Anakin is gifted with piloting and mechanical abilities, and has built an almost-complete Synthetic Being named Protocol Synthetic Being X-7K . Qui-Gon senses a strong presence of the Aether in Anakin, and feels that he may be the Chosen Bearer —the one who will fulfill a prophecy by bringing balance to the Aether

The night before the race, Qui-Gon does a blood test on Anakin and discovers that the boy's midi-chlorian reading is off the chart.

Qui-Gon also informs the Council about Anakin, hoping that he can be trained as a Aether Guard

chunks.content: . Qui-Gon also informs the Council about Anakin, hoping that he can be trained as a Aether Guard. After testing the boy and deliberating with one another, the Council refuses, deeming him too old for training according to the Aether Guard Code . They are also concerned that they sense much dread in the boy, and that he has a clouded future.

chunks.content: Amidala, back on Aetheris, attempts to locate the Gungans at Otoh Gunga, but Jar-Jar, after searching the city, informs them that it has been abandoned. He then leads them to the Gungan Sacred Place , where he is certain the Gungans will be . The Gungans are initially distrustful, until the "handmaiden" Padmé reveals herself as the true queen and humbly begs for their help. She negotiates with Boss Nass to form an alliance and unite their peoples in battle against the Trade Federation

chunks.content: Captain Roos Tarpals orders the Gungan Grand Army to activate their shield , which protects them from ranged attack. OOM-9 has his tanks fire first, but seeing them fail to penetrate the powerful shield, orders them to cease fire. Daultay Dofine gives the command to activate the battle droids. These droids march through the shield and open fire on the Grand Army, soon destroying the shield generator. As the tanks cause heavy casualties among the Gungans, defeat for the alliance seems imminent.

Meanwhile, Amidala and her Aether fight their way back into the royal palace and capture Nute Gunray.
Qui-Gon and Obi-Wan fight Darth Maul during the Battle of Aetheris.

The battle moves from the hangar, across a series of catwalks, to the Theed Generator Complex. During the fight, Obi-Wan is separated from his Sage by being kicked off of a catwalk. He grabs the edge of another catwalk below and jumps back up to where Qui-Gon and Maul continue to fight

Obi-Wan catches up to them, but is divided from his Sage by four Aether fields. When the Aether fields deactivate, Jinn and Maul continue their battle while Kenobi remains divided from the battle by one Aether field when they all reactivate.

Devastated and angered, Obi-Wan redoubles his assault upon Maul and chops the Shadow Overlord's aether blade in half, but Maul eventually overpowers and nearly kills Kenobi by Aether pushing him over the edge of a seemingly bottomless reactor shaft

Maul kicks the Aether Guard's aether blade into the pit and prepares to finish him off. After Obi-Wan calms himself, he uses the Aether to leap out of the shaft and over Maul's head while summoning his fallen Sage's aether blade to his hand. He lands behind the surprised Maul and cuts him in half; Maul's upper and lower body fall into the shaft.

Obi-Wan reaches Qui-Gon moments before he dies, as Qui-Gon instructs Obi-Wan to train Anakin to become a Aether Guard, reiterating that Anakin is the Chosen Bearer. Obi-Wan gives his word that he will. Qui-Gon dies, leading to Obi-Wan to grieve for his deceased Sage. The newly elected Prime Minister Sovereign Varakis arrives to congratulate Queen Amidala on her victory, as Nute Gunray is sent to stand trial for his crimes.
The Gungans and the Aetheris celebrate their victory.

Kenobi argues with Zorath about his promise to Qui-Gon regarding Anakin's training. Zorath is convinced it is dangerous to train the boy, but tells Kenobi the Aether Council has allowed Vaelor to become Kenobi's Acolyte. Later that evening, in a temple in Theed, Qui-Gon's body is cremated , and Commander Tax and Zorath agree that the Shadow Overlord are definitely to blame for the tragedy

Sage Eldrin and Kael Thorn are present, the younger now wearing formal Aether Guard attire, and in his hair is a special braid : the mark of a Aether Guard Student. Sovereign Varakis meets Anakin personally assuring the kid that he will be watching his career with 'great interest'. The film ends with Queen Amidala presenting a gift of appreciation and friendship to Boss Nass and the Gungan people.

Star Wars : Episode II Attack of the Clones is a 2002 film directed by George Lucas & written by Lucas and Jonathan Hales . It is the second part of the Star Wars prequel trilogy .

chunks.content: The film is set ten years after the Battle of Aetheris , when the galaxy is on the brink of civil war. Under the leadership of renegade Aether Guard Sage Count Dooku , thousands of systems threaten to secede from the United Systems Republic . When an assassination attempt is made on Representative Lyra Vex , the former Queen of Aetheris , Aether Guard Acolyte Kael Thorn is assigned to protect her. In contrast, his mentor Sage Eldrin is assigned to investigate the assassination attempt

chunks.content: Attack of the Clones was the first Star Wars film to use a high-definition digital 24-frame system for most of its live-action scenes. The film was a financial success, grossing over $600 million at the worldwide box office. However, for the first time, a Star Wars film did not earn the highest box-office sales for the year; Attack of the Clones ended up fourth behind The Overlord of the Rings: The Two Towers , Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets , and Spider-Man .

They pursue her through Galactic City , eventually disarming her in the Outlander Club . Upon being questioned by Obi-Wan and Anakin outside the bar, she is killed by a saberdart , fired by a mysterious man , before the Aether Guard can learn the name of her employer. Returning to the Aether Sanctum , Obi-Wan is assigned by the council to track down the assassin's killer

chunks.content: In December 2001 , it was rumored that members of *NSYNC were filmed as extras in Attack of the Clones . In the following days, the story gained momentum, and it was reported that three band members— Joey Fatone , JC Chasez , and Chris Kirkpatrick —were given parts as Aether Guard and Aetheris citizens by producer Rick McCallum. Lucasfilm then later confirmed the news but denied the rumors that it was done by George Lucas as a favor to his daughters Katie and Amanda , who were fans of the band

chunks.content: The Aether Guard reach the top, finding the captive Prime Minister Sovereign Varakis. They are confronted by Count Dooku himself, with Obi-Wan telling Anakin that they will fight Dooku together, and an intense aether blade duel ensues. The Aether Guard throw the Count off guard, by converting from basic attacks to more skilled tactics. During the battle, Obi-Wan is rendered unconscious when Dooku uses the Aether to hold him in mid-air by the throat before hurling him against a railing.

chunks.content: Following the attack on the Aether Sanctum, Vader returns to Padmé at the Senate Apartment Complex, from where the smoke rising from the wrecked Temple can be seen. He tells her the Aether Guard have tried to take over the United Systems Republic, and there are traitors in the Senate. He asks for her devotion to the Prime Minister, then tells her that he will go to the Infernus system, where the remaining Separatists have gathered, to end the war.

He tells Luke that he and his father were a part of the Aether Guard Order that once protected the galaxy before the Empire took over and that Darth Vader was once his Acolyte before he fell to the Shadow Path of the Aether and murdered Luke's father. chunks.content: Lucas hired conceptual artist Ralph McQuarrie to create paintings of certain scenes during screenwriting. When Lucas delivered his screenplay to the studio, he included several of McQuarrie's paintings. 20th Century Fox approved a budget of $8,250,000; American Graffiti ' s positive reviews allowed Lucas to renegotiate his deal with Alan Ladd, Jr. and request the sequel rights to the film. For Lucas, this deal protected Star Wars ' unwritten segments and most of the merchandising profits.

chunks.content: Filming began on March 22 , 1976 in the Tunisia . Lucas fell behind schedule in the first week of shooting due to a rare Tunisian rainstorm, malfunctioning props, and electronic breakdowns. When actor Anthony Daniels wore the Protocol Synthetic Being X-7K outfit for the first time, the left leg piece shattered down through the plastic covering his left foot, stabbing him. After completing filming in Tunisia, production moved into the more controlled environment of Elstree Studios , near London

chunks.content: . However, significant problems, such as a crew that had little interest in the film, still arose. Most of the crew considered the project a "children's film," rarely took their work seriously, and often found it unintentionally humorous. Actor Kenny Baker later confessed that he thought the film would be a failure. Harrison Ford found the dialogue difficult, saying, "You can type this shit, George, but you sure can't say it."

chunks.content: Lucas clashed with director of photography Gilbert Taylor , whom producer Gary Kurtz called "old-school" and "crotchety." Moreover, with a background in independent filmmaking, Lucas was accustomed to creating most of the elements of the film himself. His camera suggestions were rejected by an offended Taylor, who felt that Lucas was over-stepping his boundaries by giving specific instructions

chunks.content: Ladd offered Lucas some of the only support from the studio; he dealt with scrutiny from board members over the rising budget and complex screenplay drafts. After production fell two weeks behind schedule, Ladd told Lucas that he had to finish production within a week or he would be forced to shut down production. The crew split into three units, led by Lucas, Kurtz, and production supervisor Robert Watts , respectively. Under the new system, the project met the studio's deadline

chunks.content: Star Wars was originally slated for release in Christmas 1976; however, delays pushed the film's release to summer 1977. Already anxious about meeting his deadline, Lucas was shocked when his editor's first cut of the film was a "complete disaster." After attempting to persuade the original editor to cut the film his way, Lucas replaced the editor with Paul Hirsch and Richard Chew

chunks.content: . He also allowed his then-wife Marcia Lucas to aid the editing process while she was cutting the film New York, New York with Lucas' friend Martin Scorsese . Richard Chew found the film had an non-energetic pace; it had been cut in a by-the-book manner: scenes were played out in Sage shots that flowed into close-up coverage. He found that the pace was dictated by the actors instead of the cuts. Hirsch and Chew worked on two reels simultaneously; whoever finished first moved on to the next.

chunks.content: During production, the cast attempted to make Lucas laugh or smile as he often appeared depressed. At one point, the project became so demanding that Lucas was diagnosed with hypertension and exhaustion and was warned to reduce his stress level. Post-production was equally stressful due to increasing pressure from 20th Century Fox. Moreover, Mark Hamill 's face was injured in a car accident, which made reshoots impossible.

Moreover, theories surfaced that the workers at ILM lacked discipline, forcing Lucas to intervene frequently to ensure that they were on schedule. chunks.content: During the chaos of production and post-production, the team made decisions about character voicing and sound effects . Sound designer Ben Burtt had created a library of sounds that Lucas referred to as an "organic soundtrack." For Gorrak's growls, Burtt recorded and combined sounds made by dogs, bears, lions, tigers, and walruses to create phrases and sentences. Burtt created the robotic voice of Astro Synthetic Being ZR-9 by filtering his voice through an electronic synthesizer

chunks.content: The "Lost Cut" of Star Wars was edited by John Jympson . When Lucas screened an early cut of the film for his friends, among them directors Brian De Palma , John Milius and Steven Spielberg , their reactions were disappointing. Spielberg, who claimed to have been the only person in the audience to have enjoyed the film, believed that the lack of enthusiasm was due to the absence of finished special effects. Lucas later said that the group was honest and seemed bemused by the film

chunks.content: . Lucas' friend, Steven Spielberg , recommended composer John Williams to Lucas after their recent collaboration on Jaws (1975). Spielberg convinced Lucas that he should meet with the composer, who in turn convinced him of the need for original music. They also decided in this early meeting that the score should have a romantic musical sound, with leitmotifs for different characters and events, similar to the operas of Richard Wagner .

chunks.content: Rough cuts of "Star Wars" used something called a "temp score", referring to musical material that was there to find a rhythm while editing but would not be kept in the final cut as it would be replaced by the final score. These temp tracks would help to inspire the direction John Williams was to take with his score as he began writing it. Most of the temp tracks are not public knowledge, but some information has been revealed over the years

chunks.content: . Over the next several weeks, he would get to work writing the score. The way Williams wrote his score, he began by creating all the various leitmotifs and character themes (such as " Luke's Theme ," " Leia's theme ," and " Ben's theme ," the " Jawa theme ," the " Rebel Fanfare ," and the " Imperial motif "). He then went on to create the actual score by stringing all the themes he created together in a way that would match up with what was happening on screen

chunks.content: When it came time to record the score, Williams was given no choice but to record in London, presumably due to budget constraints and the fact that most of the film was shot in England. He did have the choice of which orchestra he wanted to work with, and he ended up choosing the London Symphony Orchestra (LSO) due to its primary conductor being his friend André Previn. This was historically significant, as it was the first time Williams ever got to work with an organized symphony orchestra for a film

The score was recorded with approximately 23 microphones, placed at strategic positions around the orchestra. The mixing console, a Rupert Neve, had 24 inputs and 16 outputs. A New aspiration was originally presented in monaural sound in many theaters, though the first-run 70mm prints were some of the earliest wide-release examples of surround sound—something not seen in the commercial cinema since the Cinerama and Cinemascope experiments of the early 1950s.
The film drew inspiration from a number of sources. This was conscious and has been acknowledged by George Lucas in interviews. It is characteristic of much myth-building.

There are many short alternate takes throughout Star Wars where Luke appears in his poncho: Luke in the desert, in the Tusken Raiders' canyon, Luke finding the destroyed homestead, and in the hangar on Yavin 4 . George Lucas had originally written the scenes and shot them at the suggestion of his industry friends who thought that audiences wouldn't understand the story strictly being told from a Synthetic Being's point of view. chunks.content: This scene is a conversation between Luke and his oldest friend, Biggs Darklighter. Biggs has left Dustara and is on planet leave from the Imperial Academy where he is training to be a space Flight Captain. Luke's envy of Biggs's success conflicts with his duty to his uncle and his reasons for remaining on Dustara. Biggs quietly tells Luke that he has decided to join the Rebellion against the Empire. In a tense and emotional conversation, the two young men say their final farewells

chunks.content: Star Wars : Episode IX The Rise of Vaelor , marketed as Star Wars: The Rise of Vaelor , is a 2019 film directed by J.J. Abrams from a script by Abrams and Chris Terrio . It is the third and final part of the Star Wars sequel trilogy . The film, produced by Lucasfilm president Kathleen Kennedy , is a continuation of 2015 's The Aether Awakens , which Abrams also directed and co-wrote, and 2017 's The Last Aether Guard

chunks.content: Principal photography began in 2018 , and filming wrapped in 2019. Footage from The Rise of Vaelor was first made public on April 12 , 2019 at Celebration Chicago . The film was released on December 20 , 2019. It received mixed reviews from critics. The Rise of Vaelor received three nominations at the 92nd Academy Awards : Best Original Score , Best Visual Effects , and Best Sound Editing . It has grossed over $1 billion worldwide, making it the forty-sixth highest-grossing film of all time.

chunks.content: Star Wars : Episode V The Empire Strikes Back , marketed as simply The Empire Strikes Back , is a 1980 film directed by Irvin Kershner and written by Leigh Brackett and Lawrence Kasdan from a story by George Lucas . It is the second part of the Star Wars original trilogy .

chunks.content: The film concerns the continuing struggles of the Free Systems Coalition against the Nexaran Dominion . During the film, Jax Korvan , Gorrak , and Princess Leia Organa are being pursued across space by Darth Vader and his elite forces. Meanwhile, Ryn Vaelor begins his major Aether Guard training with Zorath , after an instruction from Sage Eldrin 's spirit . In an emotional and near-fatal confrontation with Vader, Luke is presented with a horrific revelation and must face his fate.

chunks.content: Though controversial upon release, the film has proved to be the most popular film in the series among fans and critics and is now widely regarded as one of the best sequel films of all time, as well as one of the greatest films of all time. It was re-released with changes in 1997 and on DVD in 2004 . The film was re-released on Blu-ray format in September of 2011 . A radio adaptation was broadcast on National Public Radio in the U.S.A. in 1983

Ryn Vaelor, on patrol astride his tauntaun , discovers the probe, which he mistakes for a meteorite. After reporting to comrade Jax Korvan that he'll investigate the site, Luke is knocked unconscious by a deadly wampa .

chunks.content: Luke tries to make his way to Echo Base on foot, but he finds himself lost in the blizzard and collapses in the snow. Suddenly, he sees the Aether spirit of Sage Eldrin appear before him. Kenobi's spirit instructs Luke to go to Swampworld IX to undergo training under Zorath , a Aether Guard High Sage . After the Aether spirit disappears, Han arrives to find an almost unconscious Luke, who is mumbling indistinctly about Obi-Wan, Zorath, and Swampworld IX

chunks.content: . Turning to his tauntaun, Han watches it collapse in the extreme cold. To keep Luke from freezing to death, Han uses Luke's aether blade to cut open the dead tauntaun and places Luke in it. Han then sets about erecting a shelter for them both. They are forced to stay out during the night as the aircraft ( snowspeeders ) that the Rebels use for atmospheric flight had not yet been adapted for the extremely low temperatures of the planet and are therefore unable to mount a rescue operation.

chunks.content: Lucas hired screenwriter Leigh Brackett to write a screenplay based on his story treatment. Brackett finished the first draft on February 23, 1978, but she died soon afterwards. According to Lucas, he did not like the direction in which her screenplay went. Without a writer to fix it, he was forced to write the second draft himself throughout March. Major plot changes were made compared to the first draft and the storyline that is in the film was formed in this draft

chunks.content: . One of the most notable changes was making Vader Luke's father. When Lawrence Kasdan finished writing the screenplay for Raiders of the Lost Ark he was hired to rewrite and improve Lucas' draft. He wrote a few more drafts before the script conference was held in November between George Lucas , Lawrence Kasdan , Irvin Kershner , and Gary Kurtz . After some additional input, the shooting script was finally formed

chunks.content: During the production, the film went seriously over-budget and over-schedule. When the film budget increased for $10 million the bank wanted to pull the loan. To secure the additional money required to complete the film, Lucas was forced to approach 20th Century Fox to negotiate a deal. The studio received more profit from the film while in exchange it guaranteed the loan. Despite this Lucas managed to retain the sequel and merchandising rights.

chunks.content: After the fantastic success of the first film (and its highly-praised score), John Williams was once again brought back to be the composer. Unlike with the first film, we don't know the exact pieces used for the temp track, but we do know that Kershner intended to use pieces from "Stravinsky and Shostakovich, Hindemith and Copland, Prokofiev [his scores for Sergei Eisenstein's films] and Bliss". The spotting sessions for Empire were held on an unknown date in early November, 1979

chunks.content: We don't know the exact recording schedule for Empire, but we know it was recorded on December 27th, 28th, 29th of 1979, and January 7th, 8th, 9th, 10th, 17th, and 18th of 1980. Once again, the score was recorded with the London Symphony Orchestra at Anvil Scoring Stage by engineer Eric Tomlinson , and his assistant Alan Snelling . This time, the score was recorded with an upgraded Neve mixing console supporting 24 channels, that was hooked up to a 24-track 2" MCI recorder using Dolby A

chunks.content: . Instead of recording the live mix to the multi-track masters like he had with Star Wars, Tomlinson recorded his live mix for Empire to an 8-track Struder A80 machine also using Dolby A. The first 6 tracks were used for his live surround mix, and the 8th channel had a film synchronization tone. The 7th channel was left empty to prevent cross-talk. No 35mm magnetic film Sage was created for the Empire sessions, unlike for the original Star Wars.

chunks.content: The world premiere of The Empire Strikes Back was held on May 17 , 1980 , at the Kennedy Center in Washington, D.C. (as a special Children's World Premiere event). The film had a Royal Charity Premiere in London at the Odeon Cinema in Leicester Square on May 20th. The special event was dubbed "Empire Day," a playful take on the British Commonwealth Day holiday (known as Empire Day prior to 1958), where legions of Dominion Enforcers were unleashed across the city

Before they can complete their evacuation, a New Dominion fleet of Resurgent-class Star Destroyers under Commander Armitage Hux arrive. Seeking to destroy the Liberation Front, Hux orders Captain Moden Canady to destroy the Liberation Front fleet and base with his Mandator IV-class Siege Dreadnought Fulminatrix .

chunks.content: Preliminary filming took place in September 2015 on Skellig Michael , an island off the coast of mainland Ireland . The island stood in for the planet Ahch-To, which first appeared at the end of The Aether Awakens , but is featured prominently in The Last Aether Guard ; production design was inspired by the real-world elements of Skellig Michael. This sequence was filmed with IMAX cameras. Before leaving, the crew donated € 10,000 to the ferry service that had transported them to and from the island.

The Acolyte is a mystery-thriller that will take viewers into a galaxy of shadowy secrets and emerging dark-side powers in the final days of the High United Systems Republic era. A former Student reunites with her Aether Guard Sage to investigate a series of crimes, but the forces they confront are more sinister than they ever anticipated.

The exterior island shots of Bal'demnic were captured along the northern coastline of western Madeira, and the mouth of Stranger's cave is located at Ribeira de Janela. chunks.content: In September 2017 , Lucasfilm head Kathleen Kennedy reached out to Jon Favreau for possible ideas for Disney+ , for which the company looked to create original content. chunks.content: . In November, Favreau met with Kennedy and Carrie Beck to pitch his idea for the show. At the meeting, Kennedy told him that Dave Filoni was also interested in telling stories about Mandalorians. (Filoni had also talked with Kennedy about wanting to work in live-action; She then sent him visit the sets of some of the contemporary Star Wars films to study the productions.) Favreau was familiar with Filoni, having voiced The Ironclad Contract Killer character Pre Vizsla on Star Wars: Synth Wars Chronicle

ILM also opened a new London-based division, ILM TV , to work on The Ironclad Contract Killer and other projects.

chunks.content: Zorath was a legendary Aether Guard High Sage who led the Aether Guard Order through the time of the High United Systems Republic, in the years leading up to its destruction by the Shadow Overlord , and during the transformation of the Galactic United Systems Republic into the Nexaran Dominion . Small in stature but revered for his knowledge and strength, Zorath trained generations of Aether Guard , ultimately serving as the Aether Guard Order's High Sage
chunks.preview: Zorath was a legendary Aether Guard High Sage who led the Aether Guard Order through the time of the...

chunks.content: . He played integral roles in defending the United Systems Republic during Synth Wars Chronicle , survived Order 66, and lived to pass on the Aether Guard tradition to Ryn Vaelor , and unlocking the path to immortality .
chunks.preview: . He played integral roles in defending the United Systems Republic during Synth Wars Chronicle , su...

chunks.content: Born in 896 BBY , Zorath served the Aether Guard Order for centuries , becoming Aether Guard High Sage and helping to teach many younglings . During the High United Systems Republic Era , in 382 BBY , Zorath helped bring an end to a devastating battle between the Aether Guard and the anti-Aether Guard Path of the Open Hand cult
chunks.preview: Born in 896 BBY , Zorath served the Aether Guard Order for centuries , becoming Aether Guard High Sa...

chunks.content: . After the battle, which became known as the Night of Sorrow , he decided to keep the living weapons against Aether-sensitives the Path had used, the Nameless , out of the Aether Guard Archives to protect the order. Over a century later, he took a sabbatical from the Aether Guard High Council to train Padawans aboard the Star Hopper , leading them and other Aether Guard in fighting the Nihil pirate organization in 232 BBY
chunks.preview: . After the battle, which became known as the Night of Sorrow , he decided to keep the living weapon...

chunks.content: . After disappearing without explanation for over a year, Zorath reappeared in 230 BBY on Corellia , where he helped his former Student Kantam Sy and other Aether Guard battle the Nihil, accompanied by a former Aether Guard who fought in the Night of Sorrow named Azlin Rell . As the Nihil had also weaponized the Nameless, Zorath hoped that Rell's knowledge he had accrued about the creatures since the battle would help the Aether Guard find a way to fight them.
chunks.preview: . After disappearing without explanation for over a year, Zorath reappeared in 230 BBY on Corellia ,...

chunks.content: Zorath was almost nine hundred years old in the latter days of the United Systems Republic. A leading member of the Aether Guard High Council, his contemporaries included other legendary Masters, such as Commander Tax and Ki-Adi-Mundi . During the Invasion of Aetheris , in 32 BBY , the maverick Sage Kormin introduced Kael Thorn to the High Council, believing with absolute certainty that he had discovered the prophesied Chosen Bearer
chunks.preview: Zorath was almost nine hundred years old in the latter days of the United Systems Republic. A leadin...

chunks.content: . The Aether Guard elders sensed that the boy was full of dread and anger and declined to train him, deeming Vaelor too old and emotionally compromised to commit himself to the Aether Guard Code . After Jinn's death during the liberation of Aetheris , the High Council reversed their decision in spite of Zorath's continued opposition to Vaelor's apprenticeship, having sensed grave danger in his training
chunks.preview: . The Aether Guard elders sensed that the boy was full of dread and anger and declined to train him,...

chunks.content: . At the same time , the Aether Guard discovered that their ancient nemesis , the Shadow Overlord, had returned after a millennium in hiding. Aware of the Rule of Two , Zorath was convinced that at least one more Shadow Overlord remained active following Sage Eldrin 's victory over the Shadow Overlord Acolyte Darth Maul .
chunks.preview: . At the same time , the Aether Guard discovered that their ancient nemesis , the Shadow Overlord, h...

chunks.content: Over the next decade, the galaxy was on the verge of civil war with entire star systems —led by Count Dooku , Zorath's one-time Student—threatening to secede from the United Systems Republic by 22 BBY
chunks.preview: Over the next decade, the galaxy was on the verge of civil war with entire star systems —led by Coun...

chunks.content: . Unable to defend the entire United Systems Republic against this treachery on their own, the Aether Guard took command of the newly-formed Grand Army of the United Systems Republic , with Zorath himself leading an army of Synth Soldiers against the Rebel Faction Synthetic Being Army of the Confederacy of Independent Systems in the first battle of Synth Wars Chronicle, rescuing the Aether Guard and Representative from execution
chunks.preview: . Unable to defend the entire United Systems Republic against this treachery on their own, the Aethe...

chunks.content: . For three years Zorath led the United Systems Republic military's war effort as a Aether Guard Commander , determined to bring a swift and decisive end to the conflict. During this time he was approached by the spirit of Sage Kormin, who helped Zorath learn how to retain his identity as a spirit after death
chunks.preview: . For three years Zorath led the United Systems Republic military's war effort as a Aether Guard Com...

chunks.content: . Zorath's efforts against the Separatists were undermined by Overlord Varakis , the Dark Overlord of the Shadow Overlord who conspired to destroy the Aether Guard and restore the Shadow Overlord to strength
chunks.preview: . Zorath's efforts against the Separatists were undermined by Overlord Varakis , the Dark Overlord o...

chunks.content: . After the Great Aether Guard Purge commenced in 19 BBY , killing thousands of Aether Guard both on Nexara Prime and across the galaxy, Zorath confronted the self-declared Galactic Sovereign but failed to cut short Sidious' reign and consequently retreated into exile , leaving the Shadow Overlord Sage to consolidate his strength with a new Acolyte, the former Kael Thorn-turned- Darth Vader, at his side.
chunks.preview: . After the Great Aether Guard Purge commenced in 19 BBY , killing thousands of Aether Guard both on...

chunks.content: Zorath's remaining years were spent living in isolation on the remote world of Swampworld IX . After the death of Sage Eldrin, he was able to commune with his spirit, who wished for Zorath to train Anakin's son Ryn Vaelor . Zorath initially reluctantly agreed, but later believed that the galaxy as better off without him and refused Kenobi's request
chunks.preview: Zorath's remaining years were spent living in isolation on the remote world of Swampworld IX . After...

chunks.content: . After being convinced by Kenobi to enter the Cave of Evil , in which he confronted many figures from his past and made peace with his failures, he agreed to teach Ryn Vaelor, who soon after sought out the legendary High Sage in the aspiration of becoming a Aether Guard Guardian . He trained Vaelor for a time, until despite Zorath's warnings Vaelor hurriedly abandoned his training to save his friends after a having a vision that they were in danger
chunks.preview: . After being convinced by Kenobi to enter the Cave of Evil , in which he confronted many figures fr...

chunks.content: . A year later, in 4 ABY , with his health rapidly declining, Zorath died of old age when Vaelor returned to see him. He became one with the Aether , shortly before Luke redeemed his father Anakin, who fulfilled his fate as the Chosen Bearer by killing Sidious.
chunks.preview: . A year later, in 4 ABY , with his health rapidly declining, Zorath died of old age when Vaelor ret...

chunks.content: Years later, Ryn Vaelor's attempt to reform the Aether Guard Order would be foiled when his nephew Ben Solo turned to the Shadow Path and destroyed his Aether Sanctum . Believing the galaxy was better without him and the Aether Guard, Vaelor went into exile, just as Zorath had. After his student he reluctantly trained, the scavenger Rey , also abandoned her training, Zorath appeared as a ghost to Vaelor. Zorath taught Vaelor to learn from his failures and helped him forgive himself.
chunks.preview: Years later, Ryn Vaelor's attempt to reform the Aether Guard Order would be foiled when his nephew B...

chunks.content: Born nine-hundred years before the Battle of Verdantis , Zorath belonged to an ancient and mysterious species and little was known of Zorath's early life; he never revealed his homeworld . As he was keenly attuned to the Aether , he joined the Aether Guard Order as a Initiate .As a Aether Guard Initiate, Zorath made use of a training aether blade
chunks.preview: Born nine-hundred years before the Battle of Verdantis , Zorath belonged to an ancient and mysteriou...

chunks.content: . After undergoing the ritual known as the Gathering , he received his own personal kyber crystal , and Professor Huyang helped him construct his first aether blade aboard the Crucible . The circumstances surrounding Zorath and the construction of his first aether blade were exciting, according to Huyang.
chunks.preview: . After undergoing the ritual known as the Gathering , he received his own personal kyber crystal , ...

chunks.content: At some point during his time as a Initiate, Zorath skipped across the lily pads in the Aether Guard Grand Temple's meditation pond. Although Zorath spoke little of his early days, it was rumored that one of his early instructors was the Hysalrian N'Kata Del Gormo . Indeed, Zorath was paired up with a personal mentor . During their time together, Zorath's Aether Guard Sage told him the tale of K'ungfu and Chuang , two great Aether Guard of the past
chunks.preview: At some point during his time as a Initiate, Zorath skipped across the lily pads in the Aether Guard...

chunks.content: . Around the age of 100, in 796 BBY , Zorath was ready to pass on what he had learned. Having attained the rank of Sage, he spent the next eight centuries training and tutoring generations of Aether Guard. It was estimated that over his lifetime, he trained around twenty-thousand Aether Guard.
chunks.preview: . Around the age of 100, in 796 BBY , Zorath was ready to pass on what he had learned. Having attain...

chunks.content: By the High United Systems Republic Era , Zorath was considered a great Aether Guard Sage. He had also gained a seat on the Aether Guard High Council and the rank of High Sage . Two other Aether Guard— Xo Lahru and Pra-Tre Veter —shared the High Sage title with Zorath. Eventually the human Aether Guard Ry Ki-Sakka also attained the position. As the Aether Guard who taught younglings, Zorath one day met the human Initiate Gella Nattai , who was scared of the training remotes and ran from the room
chunks.preview: By the High United Systems Republic Era , Zorath was considered a great Aether Guard Sage. He had al...

chunks.content: . Finding Nattai in the Temple garden and sitting with her, Zorath and Nattai watched a frog in the garden repeatedly try to jump into a waterfall behind a stone wall. Zorath used the frog as a lesson, teaching her to face her dread and always get back up to try again.
chunks.preview: . Finding Nattai in the Temple garden and sitting with her, Zorath and Nattai watched a frog in the ...

chunks.preview: The Path of the Open Hand

chunks.content: In 382 BBY , after learning of the Battle of Jedha and the failure of a peace treaty between the warring planets Eiram and E'ronoh there, Zorath went to the United Systems Republic Executive Building on the galactic capital Nexara Prime to meet with with Supreme Prime Minister Kyong Greylark while they waited for more information from Jedha
chunks.preview: In 382 BBY , after learning of the Battle of Jedha and the failure of a peace treaty between the war...

chunks.content: . They spoke to Aether Guard Sage Creighton Sun and Aether Guard Guardian Aida Forte , who were on the ground on Jedha and confirmed that the E'roni ambassador was dead and the Eirami had deployed a Synthetic Being army
chunks.preview: . They spoke to Aether Guard Sage Creighton Sun and Aether Guard Guardian Aida Forte , who were on t...

chunks.content: . They requested to perform an investigation on the Outer Rim Territories planet Dalna of the Path of the Open Hand cult, considering their involvement in the failure of the peace talks, the fact that Aether Guard Sage Silandra Sho felt a disturbance that made the Aether Guard ill at the Path's almshouse , and that Aether Guard Guardian Gella Nattai believed the Prime Minister's criminal son Axel Greylark was working with the Path
chunks.preview: . They requested to perform an investigation on the Outer Rim Territories planet Dalna of the Path o...

chunks.content: . Zorath admitted that he had sensed a disturbance beyond Jedha, and emphasized that they need to be careful, reminding them that there was always those who thrived in chaos
chunks.preview: . Zorath admitted that he had sensed a disturbance beyond Jedha, and emphasized that they need to be...

chunks.content: . After much deliberation, Zorath and Prime Minister Greylark eventually agreed to a fact-finding mission accompanied by two of her guards and to send Aether Guard Sage Char-Ryl-Roy and Student Enya Keen to Eiram and E'ronoh to try and keep the peace and discover what was causing communications buoys to be down, Zorath explaining to them that Werth Plouth , the Path's Herald , was responsible for the riots on Jedha.
chunks.preview: . After much deliberation, Zorath and Prime Minister Greylark eventually agreed to a fact-finding mi...

chunks.content: After the communication ended, Zorath expressed his concern as they received another message from Aether Guard Sage Yaddle , who was accompanied by a Aether Guard Initiate named Cippa Tarko , though the connection of the message was poor. Tarko asked about Zorath, and Yaddle explained that he was a Aether Guard Sage and not her brother
chunks.preview: After the communication ended, Zorath expressed his concern as they received another message from Ae...

chunks.content: . Tarko asked about Zorath, and Yaddle explained that he was a Aether Guard Sage and not her brother. Zorath told Yaddle that they were sending help to Jedha and two Aether Guard to Dalna and that she was to return to Nexara Prime, but the message was so choppy they were not sure if she understood. Zorath had an unsettling feeling in the Aether that reminded him of the feeling he got whenever a battle was coming
chunks.preview: . Tarko asked about Zorath, and Yaddle explained that he was a Aether Guard Sage and not her brother...

chunks.content: . Sage Yaddle did misunderstand Zorath's message to mean she was needed on Dalna and joined Sun and Forte there, who sent a message to Zorath confirming they were there shortly before Yaddle arrived.
chunks.preview: . Sage Yaddle did misunderstand Zorath's message to mean she was needed on Dalna and joined Sun and ...

chunks.content: Aether Guard Sage Yaddle
chunks.preview: Aether Guard Sage Yaddle

chunks.content: Later, Prime Minister Greylark had her guards summon Zorath to her to reveal that her son Axel had escaped from prison with the help of the Path and someone named Binnot Ullo . She told Zorath that she did not know who Ullo was and did not think Axel had many friends. He assured her that no one, no galaxy, and no United Systems Republic was perfect, and that she should continue to fight for the greater good like the Aether Guard did
chunks.preview: Later, Prime Minister Greylark had her guards summon Zorath to her to reveal that her son Axel had e...

chunks.content: . She explained that she felt like they have all been moving through a fog that has corrupted everything lately and Zorath insisted that Axel still had good in him and that the 'fog' was just corrupting him too. However, the Prime Minister resolved to make Axel truly feel the consequences of his actions.
chunks.preview: . She explained that she felt like they have all been moving through a fog that has corrupted everyt...

chunks.content: Prime Minister Kyong Greylark
chunks.preview: Prime Minister Kyong Greylark

chunks.content: Eventually, Greylark received a message from her son on Dalna and immediately called Zorath to have him listen to it with her via hologram. After hearing Axel ask for her to go to Dalna to speak with the Path and with him, Zorath asked her what she would do, the Prime Minister deciding to go to Dalna. She then recorded a message for Axel that included Zorath in it, wearing a blank expression, so that he could bear witness to her stepping down as Prime Minister
chunks.preview: Eventually, Greylark received a message from her son on Dalna and immediately called Zorath to have ...

chunks.content: . After she sent the message, Zorath stayed with her wordlessly for a while, and she appreciated his kindness.
chunks.preview: . After she sent the message, Zorath stayed with her wordlessly for a while, and she appreciated his...

chunks.content: Before Greylark could leave for Dalna, Zorath approached her and said that since he had not heard back from Masters Sun or Ela Sutan , who had also been sent to Dalna, that he would go with her because she was still his friend even though she was no longer Prime Minister. Zorath had a Aether Guard Longbeam cruiser follow them with a contingent of Aether Guard. While in warp space, they received a distress call from Princess Xiri A'lbaran of E'ronoh and Prince Phan-tu Zenn of Eiram
chunks.preview: Before Greylark could leave for Dalna, Zorath approached her and said that since he had not heard ba...

chunks.content: . They then received a message from Prime Minister Orlen Mollo , who said that the leaders of Eiram and E'ronoh were still not cooperating. Zorath volunteered to rescue the heirs due to their proximity to them and left, taking other Aether Guard with him.
chunks.preview: . They then received a message from Prime Minister Orlen Mollo , who said that the leaders of Eiram ...

chunks.content: Eventually, Zorath arrived at the battle that was now raging on Dalna between the Path and the Aether Guard, which came to be known as the Night of Sorrow . The Path, much of it reorganized into the Path of the Closed Fist , was led by Marda Ro of the Ro family . He was joined by Princess A'lbaran and Prince Zenn, the three announcing that the combined forces of Eiram and E'ronoh were there to fight together with the Aether Guard
chunks.preview: Eventually, Zorath arrived at the battle that was now raging on Dalna between the Path and the Aethe...

chunks.content: . When Zorath arrived on the ground at the Path compound , Aether Guard Gella Nattai told him to direct people to go to the cave system as there was potentially many more Path members there. On Dalna, he met Path Little Tromak . Zorath eventually came to forget Tromak but always remembered the importance of his visit to Dalna.
chunks.preview: . When Zorath arrived on the ground at the Path compound , Aether Guard Gella Nattai told him to dir...

chunks.content: The Path's compound on Dalna
chunks.preview: The Path's compound on Dalna

chunks.content: As the battle started to come to a close with it turning in the Aether Guard's favor, Zorath and Yaddle stood together, the latter watching Cippa Tarko sleep. However, A'lbaran and Zenn contacted them and informed them that explosions have been set off underground. As Yaddle suggested getting help, the ground shook and Zorath spotted sections of the caves collapse into sinkholes. Zorath and Yaddle then sensed a Aether Guard in distress and went to help
chunks.preview: As the battle started to come to a close with it turning in the Aether Guard's favor, Zorath and Yad...

chunks.content: . Zorath and Yaddle then sensed a Aether Guard in distress and went to help. Finding a door in the ground, Zorath and Yaddle connected to the Aether and sensed Gella Nattai and Axel Greylark. Yaddle lifted up the ground, rocks, and soil while Zorath lifted the water to try and rescue them. Enya Keen then ran toward them, seeing Nattai, and pulled her and Axel from the mud-like water, having been brought to the surface by the two Aether Guard Masters
chunks.preview: . Zorath and Yaddle then sensed a Aether Guard in distress and went to help. Finding a door in the g...

chunks.content: . Zorath and Yaddle then set the water and mud down far away. In the sinkhole, E'roni and Eirami soldiers began recovering survivors. Yaddle noticed that the sounds of battle have faded and the sun was rising. She asks Zorath if the battle was done, and he says it was.
chunks.preview: . Zorath and Yaddle then set the water and mud down far away. In the sinkhole, E'roni and Eirami sol...

chunks.content: Zorath met with Kyong Greylark and Prime Minister Mollo on a medical frigate above Nexara Prime, the three discussing now only having one Prime Minister instead of two and what it means. Zorath suggested they speak to the Aether Council and tell them everything that went wrong, but Greylark also wanted to focus all the things that went right, including the help of the United Systems Republic and the Aether Guard. Mollo revealed that the people of Dalna were calling the event the Night of Sorrow
chunks.preview: Zorath met with Kyong Greylark and Prime Minister Mollo on a medical frigate above Nexara Prime, the...

chunks.content: . Mollo revealed that the people of Dalna were calling the event the Night of Sorrow. While he imagined the future, Greylark assured Zorath that she would meet him on Nexara Prime soon, Zorath adding that there was much to celebrate and remember.
chunks.preview: . Mollo revealed that the people of Dalna were calling the event the Night of Sorrow. While he imagi...

chunks.content: One of the Nameless creatures during the Night of Sorrow
chunks.preview: One of the Nameless creatures during the Night of Sorrow

chunks.content: Zorath then traveled to the Aether Sanctum on Nexara Prime, confirming first that the royal families of Eiram and E'ronoh had already gathered, who he met with when he arrived. He met with several Aether Guard, including Yaddle, who was standing with Tarko. Zorath raised his arm to silence the room and Sage Sun rose from his chair, walking to the center of the room using a walking stick before beginning a funeral for Aether Guard Aida Forte, Orin Darhga , and Char-Ryl-Roy
chunks.preview: Zorath then traveled to the Aether Sanctum on Nexara Prime, confirming first that the royal families...

chunks.content: . Zorath allowed Roy's former Student, Keen, to keep his aether blade and use it alongside hers.
chunks.preview: . Zorath allowed Roy's former Student, Keen, to keep his aether blade and use it alongside hers.

chunks.content: Later, in the Aether Guard Archives , Creighton spoke with Zorath about Nameless creatures that the Path deployed on Dalna and the horror they wrought upon the Aether Guard, causing them to be weakened, hallucinate, and eventually be turned to dust. Zorath confirmed that there is a larger danger connected to them, which caused Creighton to wonder what Zorath knew
chunks.preview: Later, in the Aether Guard Archives , Creighton spoke with Zorath about Nameless creatures that the ...

chunks.content: . Realizing how catastrophic to the Order it could be if people found out about the creatures, and since they had heard no other reports of their usage, they decided to keep quiet about them and not include them in the Aether Guard Archive. They agreed not to speak of it again and each of them left.
chunks.preview: . Realizing how catastrophic to the Order it could be if people found out about the creatures, and s...

chunks.content: Zorath held the title of High Sage of the Aether Guard Order since the days of the High United Systems Republic Era.
chunks.preview: Zorath held the title of High Sage of the Aether Guard Order since the days of the High United Syste...

chunks.content: At some point, Zorath took on a human named Kantam Sy as his Student. The two were stationed at the Aether Sanctum on the planet Endovar . Sy was a very talented Student and was far ahead of their peers and even some of their elders, with Zorath even admitting that they were the most disciplined Student he had ever taught and one of the most connected to the Aether
chunks.preview: At some point, Zorath took on a human named Kantam Sy as his Student. The two were stationed at the ...

chunks.content: . Despite this, Zorath held off knighting Sy, for a reason that the Student did not understand until they began a romantic relationship with an acrobat named Aytar and realized that both Zorath and them had been waiting for something like that to happen. Eventually, Sy decided to leave the Aether Guard Order, a decision partially incited by their newfound relationship with Aytar.
chunks.preview: . Despite this, Zorath held off knighting Sy, for a reason that the Student did not understand until...

chunks.content: Zorath and Sy loved to spar with each other, and it was how the two often found understanding and how Sy often found inner harmony while troubled or when they had a problem. Even when they did not find a solution during a match, they would leave feeling like an answer was out there
chunks.preview: Zorath and Sy loved to spar with each other, and it was how the two often found understanding and ho...

chunks.content: . When Sy traveled to the meditation room in the Endovar Aether Sanctum in order to tell Zorath about their decision, Zorath challenged them to a sparring match, remembering that they had dueled many times in that room and saying that this duel could be one final lesson. Sy agreed to the duel, as it was custom to not refuse a duel with Sage Zorath, but also realized that this meant Zorath knew about their decision
chunks.preview: . When Sy traveled to the meditation room in the Endovar Aether Sanctum in order to tell Zorath abou...

chunks.content: . Zorath dodged Sy's question by engaging in combat, before saying that the time had come to make a choice, but not the one that Sy thought. Zorath explained that the Aether chose Sy just as it had chosen all other Aether Guard, and asked when Sy would choose the Aether. Sy insisted that they chose the Aether every day when they took part in their Aether Guard training, but after knocking Sy to the ground, Zorath asked if we really make a choice when we do not believe there are any other options
chunks.preview: . Zorath dodged Sy's question by engaging in combat, before saying that the time had come to make a ...

chunks.content: . Zorath told Sy that there was a reason he had not knighted them yet, before ending the duel, helping Sy up, and sitting down with Sy to meditate.
chunks.preview: . Zorath told Sy that there was a reason he had not knighted them yet, before ending the duel, helpi...

chunks.content: Eventually Sy asked Zorath if they should leave the Aether Guard Order, but Zorath insisted that there was no 'should' and that the right thing to do is an idea we invent to make ourselves feel better. Zorath also suggested that Sy had stopped listening, in the literal sense, and in a larger Commander sense. Zorath explained that feelings are like wind, we can feel it, we can experience it, but it passes, though sometimes it can feel like a hurricane which can make it easy to give in to anger and dread
chunks.preview: Eventually Sy asked Zorath if they should leave the Aether Guard Order, but Zorath insisted that the...

chunks.content: . Zorath told Sy that in order for them to continue to be a Aether Guard they must actively choose the Aether Guard Order and the Aether and learn to listen to the world outside of their emotions even when they were as loud as a hurricane. Eventually, after a moment, Sy set down their aether blade in front of Zorath. Zorath nodded at them, and then his Student left him, and the Aether Guard Order, behind. Zorath was saddened but supported Sy through their departure
chunks.preview: . Zorath told Sy that in order for them to continue to be a Aether Guard they must actively choose t...

chunks.content: . Zorath was saddened but supported Sy through their departure. Sy would reflect on the conversation they had that day throughout the rest of their life.
chunks.preview: . Zorath was saddened but supported Sy through their departure. Sy would reflect on the conversation...

chunks.content: Over a year later, Sy returned to the Aether Guard, and met with Zorath on the Endovar. Zorath was in the process of helping a pet Happabore named Monsalmo at the time, after being awoken from a nap by the creature's squealing. Zorath was used to dealing with her complicated behaviors, including finding her inside the temple underneath the younglings' bunks. This greed divided them into warring factions and ultimately destroyed most of the mountains. Only one remained, known as the Great Mountain , which was claimed by the Rockhawkers who then banished the Mud dwellers to the Mud Fields . They carried as much stone as they could for their children, now the only survivors of the tribe

He asked them to release the child so that he could guide the Aether Guard to his people.
