chunks.content:
Kestra Nil speaks to the Aether Council
During the peak of the war, Barriss Offee with the help of Letta Turmond bombed the Aether Sanctum on Nexara Prime. Zorath then ordered Kael Thorn and his Student Kestra Nil to return from Cato Neimoidia to help investigate, refusing to trust anyone who was in the temple during the bombing. Zorath's judgement was clouded, but he still guided the Aether Guard as the leader of the Council.
chunks.preview:
Kestra Nil speaks to the Aether Council
During the peak of the war, Barriss Offee with the help of L...

chunks.content: Turmond was captured by Vaelor and Tano. In prison, she requested Tano speak with her, saying Tano was the only one she could trust. When Turmond was strangled to death by way of the Aether, Wilhuff Tarkin , who was serving as an admiral in the United Systems Republic Army, had Tano arrested, accusing her of being the mastermind responsible for the attack. Desperate to prove her innocence, Tano escaped the prison, resulting in a manhunt led by Kael Thorn and Captain Rex
chunks.preview: Turmond was captured by Vaelor and Tano. In prison, she requested Tano speak with her, saying Tano w...

chunks.content: . During the chase, Tano lost her Shoto aether blade .
chunks.preview: . During the chase, Tano lost her Shoto aether blade .

chunks.content: After Tano fled to the Underworld, Zorath ordered Vaelor and Plo Koon to track her down and bring her to the Temple, with some Liberation Front from Commander Tax, who felt that Vaelor's emotional connection to Tano would only make things worse. Tano was quickly captured by Asajj Ventress, who agreed to help the young Student in exchange for a pardon for Ventress' crimes as a Shadow Overlord. Tano contacted Barriss Offee at the Aether Sanctum
chunks.preview: After Tano fled to the Underworld, Zorath ordered Vaelor and Plo Koon to track her down and bring he...

chunks.content: . Tano contacted Barriss Offee at the Aether Sanctum. Offee led Tano into a trap by telling her she could find evidence to prove her innocence by going to a warehouse on Level 1315. There, Offee jumped Ventress, stealing her lightsabers and mask. She attacked Tano, knocking her out in front of crates of Nanodroids and effectively framing her for the bombing.
chunks.preview: . Tano contacted Barriss Offee at the Aether Sanctum. Offee led Tano into a trap by telling her she ...

chunks.content: Tano was then brought back to the Temple, where Zorath and the rest of the Aether Council reluctantly agreed to expel her from the Aether Guard Order and have her face a military tribunal before the Senate. Zorath, Sage Eldrin, Plo Koon and several other Council members were present in the court room, where Tano was prosecuted by Tarkin and defended by Lyra Vex
chunks.preview: Tano was then brought back to the Temple, where Zorath and the rest of the Aether Council reluctantl...

chunks.content: . However, before the jury could render its decision, Vaelor burst in with Barriss Offee, who confessed to being responsible for the bombings and the framing of Tano. In radiance of this revelation, Zorath, Vaelor and the Council personally invited Tano to rejoin the Order, but to their shock, she refused and left. Zorath would regret the Council's decision and began to question the doctrine of the war.
chunks.preview: . However, before the jury could render its decision, Vaelor burst in with Barriss Offee, who confes...

chunks.content: Zorath speaks with the Council about Tup.
chunks.preview: Zorath speaks with the Council about Tup.

chunks.content: Several years prior to the start of the war, Sovereign Varakis and his Acolyte, Count Dooku secretly created the Synth Army with the assistance of an unsuspecting Sifo-Dyas, who had seen visions of a conflict beforehand. When this was done, they had organic inhibitor chips implanted in their brains, which would cause the clones to do anything Sovereign Varakis told them to, in this case execute the Aether Guard
chunks.preview: Several years prior to the start of the war, Sovereign Varakis and his Acolyte, Count Dooku secretly...

chunks.content: . With one simple command, the clones would enter a trance-like state and perform whatever orders they were given.
chunks.preview: . With one simple command, the clones would enter a trance-like state and perform whatever orders th...

chunks.content: During the Battle of Ringo Vinda , Synth Soldier Tup murdered Aether Guard Sage Tiplar when his inhibitor chip was activated prematurely. Sidious ordered Dooku to apprehend Tup to prevent the Aether Guard from discovering the truth. Tup was eventually sent to Kamino after Kael Thorn, Captain Rex and ARC trooper Fives were able to recover Tup from a Rebel Faction Transport.
chunks.preview: During the Battle of Ringo Vinda , Synth Soldier Tup murdered Aether Guard Sage Tiplar when his inhi...

chunks.content: After escorting Tup to Kamino, Fives and Rex were greeted by Aether Guard Sage Shaak Ti , alongside the main developer of the clones, Kaminoan scientist Nala Se . Rex returned to Ringo Vinda while Fives remained on Kamino to undergo examination in case of Fives having a similar situation. Disputes over the tests led to a debate. While Shaak Ti advised a brain scan, Nala Se suggested terminating the clone and preforming an autopsy to isolate the case
chunks.preview: After escorting Tup to Kamino, Fives and Rex were greeted by Aether Guard Sage Shaak Ti , alongside ...

chunks.content: . Shaak Ti contacted the Aether Sanctum where Zorath, alongside Sage Eldrin, decided Tup should be brought to the temple to be examined through the Aether.
chunks.preview: . Shaak Ti contacted the Aether Sanctum where Zorath, alongside Sage Eldrin, decided Tup should be b...

chunks.content: What the Aether Guard were unaware of was that the Kaminoans knew of the inhibitor chips and were working with Count Dooku, who used his Shadow Overlord name, Tyranus, to prevent the Aether Guard from making the connection. Dooku ordered that Tup be terminated and that the chip be sent to him to be looked at.
chunks.preview: What the Aether Guard were unaware of was that the Kaminoans knew of the inhibitor chips and were wo...

chunks.content: Angry at Nala Se and Sage Ti for their treatment of Tup, Fives escaped the medical center and embarked on his own plan. Fives faked leaving the planet, but stayed to try and save Tup and discover the truth. He and the medical Synthetic Being AZI-3 were able to preform a brain scan on Tup, where they learned of the inhibitor chips. Fives had the Synthetic Being take the chip out of his and Tup's brains. Unfortunately, the already-weakened Tup died soon after the operation, whispering his last words to Fives
chunks.preview: Angry at Nala Se and Sage Ti for their treatment of Tup, Fives escaped the medical center and embark...

chunks.content: . Fives blamed Nala Se for what happened to Tup. Suspecting the Kaminoans of treachery, and with the support of Sage Ti, Fives insisted on presenting his evidence and the removed chips directly to Sovereign Varakis. Fives was eventually brought to Nexara Prime, at the request of Shaak Ti, where he was brought before the Prime Minister. As the ship landed, Nala Se drugged Fives, causing him to act strange.
chunks.preview: . Fives blamed Nala Se for what happened to Tup. Suspecting the Kaminoans of treachery, and with the...

chunks.content: When Fives attempted to assassinate Sovereign Varakis, Zorath was a part of the Aether Council that ordered Kael Thorn to investigate. Fives was killed in the end, and Zorath was ultimately told that the doctors had found another cause, and that a vaccination had been prepared in case of a future incident.
chunks.preview: When Fives attempted to assassinate Sovereign Varakis, Zorath was a part of the Aether Council that ...

chunks.content: Sometime later, the Aether Guard received a distress signal from a moon near Oba Diah . Sending Plo Koon and Commander Wolfe to investigate, they found the remains of a shuttle and the aether blade of Aether Guard Sage Sifo-Dyas, who was killed sometime around the Battle of Aetheris while dealing with a conflict on Felucia . Upon reviewing the temple archives, Jocasta Nu and the Aether Guard found that the information had been sealed by order of the Supreme Prime Minister
chunks.preview: Sometime later, the Aether Guard received a distress signal from a moon near Oba Diah . Sending Plo ...

chunks.content: . While sending Kael Thorn and his Sage, Sage Eldrin to Felucia, Zorath went to speak with Sovereign Varakis, not knowing he was the Shadow Overlord that orchestrated the murder and the creation of the Synth Army. Sovereign Varakis told Zorath to visit Prime Minister Valorum , as these events had happened before the vote of no confidence that led to Sovereign Varakis becoming Prime Minister
chunks.preview: . While sending Kael Thorn and his Sage, Sage Eldrin to Felucia, Zorath went to speak with Sovereign...

chunks.content: . Sovereign Varakis then contacted Count Dooku, telling him to destroy the last piece of the puzzle before the Aether Guard would be able to unravel the mystery.
chunks.preview: . Sovereign Varakis then contacted Count Dooku, telling him to destroy the last piece of the puzzle ...

chunks.content:
Zorath meets with former Supreme Prime Minister Finis Valorum on Nexara Prime.
Anakin and Obi-Wan attempted to communicate with the native tribe on the Felucia, but were unable to understand them. They did learn, however, that a second Aether Guard had shown up with Sifo-Dyas.
chunks.preview:
Zorath meets with former Supreme Prime Minister Finis Valorum on Nexara Prime.
Anakin and Obi-Wan at...

chunks.content: Valorum told Zorath that he had sent Sifo-Dyas to negotiate with the Pyke Syndicate to stop a booming drug trade underneath Nexara Prime. Valorum also revealed that he kept this secret, fearing his opponents in the bureaucracy. The talks were postponed after the Council sent Sifo-Dyas to intervene on Felucia. Valorum was unable to identify the second Aether Guard, but did say that his assistant, Silman , was with Sifo-Dyas when he was shot down.
chunks.preview: Valorum told Zorath that he had sent Sifo-Dyas to negotiate with the Pyke Syndicate to stop a boomin...

chunks.content: Eventually, Zorath dispatched Anakin and Obi-Wan to Oba Diah, where they learned the Pykes were paid to shoot down the ship carrying Sifo-Dyas, but had kept Silman captive as leverage and that Dooku was in fact the individual known as Tyranus, leading them to realize Dooku impersonated Sifo-Dyas to help push forward Synth Wars Chronicle. Zorath, not knowing how to stop the plot, suggested the Aether Guard keep the discovery a secret, and that they should keep playing the Shadow Overlord's game.
chunks.preview: Eventually, Zorath dispatched Anakin and Obi-Wan to Oba Diah, where they learned the Pykes were paid...

chunks.content: Zorath hears the voice of Sage Kormin.
chunks.preview: Zorath hears the voice of Sage Kormin.

chunks.content: While meditating during the end of the war, Zorath heard the voice of Sage Kormin, who demonstrated his presence by levitating Zorath. The encounter left Zorath distracted during the subsequent Council gathering, leaving them worried about whether the stresses of the war were finally taking its toll on him. While strolling through the Temple gardens, Zorath was greeted by Anakin
chunks.preview: While meditating during the end of the war, Zorath heard the voice of Sage Kormin, who demonstrated ...

chunks.content: . While strolling through the Temple gardens, Zorath was greeted by Anakin. Zorath asked him about his encounter with Qui-Gon's spirit on Mortis , which Anakin had dismissed as a trick, noting the Aether Guard belief that one could not retain their identity after becoming one with the Aether. Zorath responded that he now questioned this dogma.
chunks.preview: . While strolling through the Temple gardens, Zorath was greeted by Anakin. Zorath asked him about h...

chunks.content: Zorath confessed what happened to the Council, much to their disbelief. They agreed though to meditate with him, to verify his experience. Despite meditating together for an entire day, they were unable to hear anything. Ki-Adi-Mundi expressed worry that Zorath had become susceptible to Shadow Overlord manipulation, so Zorath underwent medical tests that revealed that he was still in good health
chunks.preview: Zorath confessed what happened to the Council, much to their disbelief. They agreed though to medita...

chunks.content: . Aether Guard Doctor Rig Nema suggested Zorath undergo a deprivation ritual that would allow him to meditate more strongly and find the source of the voice.
chunks.preview: . Aether Guard Doctor Rig Nema suggested Zorath undergo a deprivation ritual that would allow him to...

chunks.content: Agreeing, Zorath was suspended in a liquid tank with an oxygen mask to bring him as close as possible to death without actually becoming one with the Aether. While unconscious, Qui-Gon's voice requested Zorath go to Swampworld IX , and to tell no one about it. After, Obi-Wan broke open the tank due to his concern over Zorath's failing life signs.
chunks.preview: Agreeing, Zorath was suspended in a liquid tank with an oxygen mask to bring him as close as possibl...

chunks.content:
Put on bedrest and under guard, Zorath convinced Anakin to help him escape by posing as simply accompanying each other for a walk. Guided to the Aether Sanctum Hangar, Anakin lent Zorath his navigation unit Synthetic Being , Astro Synthetic Being ZR-9 to accompany him to his personal interceptor . Zorath and Astro Synthetic Being ZR-9 flew to Swampworld IX, where Zorath asked the Synthetic Being to stay with their ship while he found a clearing to meditate.
Zorath communes with Qui-Gon on Swampworld IX.
chunks.preview: Put on bedrest and under guard, Zorath convinced Anakin to help him escape by posing as simply accom...

chunks.content: Qui-Gon's voice greeted him. Zorath asked why he could not see him. Qui-Gon explained he had not been fully trained enough to do so. The Living Aether appeared to Zorath in the form of fireflies , guiding Zorath to a cave strong with the Shadow Path, it showed the Aether Guard Sage a vision of the future, where a hooded Shadow Overlord slaughtered the Aether Guard
chunks.preview: Qui-Gon's voice greeted him. Zorath asked why he could not see him. Qui-Gon explained he had not bee...

chunks.content: . Qui-Gon explained to a distraught Zorath that he would help him bring aspiration for the future, and directed him to the planet that spawned the aether particles .

chunks.preview: Zorath confronts his own Shadow Path.

First, Zorath confronted a manifestation of his own Shadow Path, conquering his hubris

chunks.content: . First, Zorath confronted a manifestation of his own Shadow Path, conquering his hubris. Next, he witnessed a vision of the Aether Guard massacred in the Temple, where an apparition of a dying Kestra Nil asked him if she would still become one with the Aether after being expelled from the Aether Guard Order; this vision was a manifestation of Zorath's guilt over having placed Tano on the path that led to her departure
chunks.preview: . First, Zorath confronted a manifestation of his own Shadow Path, conquering his hubris. Next, he w...

chunks.content: . An apparition of Katooni then invited Zorath to enter a peaceful courtyard to escape these painful events. Seeing Sage Kormin, Kenobi, Tano, and Dooku together, alive and full Aether Guard, Zorath eventually recognized the vision's falsehood, overcoming its seduction and his attachment to those that have fallen.
chunks.preview: . An apparition of Katooni then invited Zorath to enter a peaceful courtyard to escape these painful...

chunks.content: The specter of Darth Bane appeared to Zorath on Moraband.
chunks.preview: The specter of Darth Bane appeared to Zorath on Moraband.

chunks.content: Instructed to complete his tests on the Shadow Overlord homeworld of Moraband , Zorath and Astro Synthetic Being ZR-9 flew to the valley where the ancient Shadow Overlord Lords were buried. Recognizing the danger, Zorath instructed Astro Synthetic Being ZR-9 to return to the Aether Sanctum and inform the Council of what happened, if he did not come back after three nights. Specters of a serpent, undead Shadow Overlord warriors, and even Darth Bane himself confronted him, but Zorath brushed them off
chunks.preview: Instructed to complete his tests on the Shadow Overlord homeworld of Moraband , Zorath and Astro Syn...

chunks.content: . As he entered a temple execution chamber , the Aether Priestesses warned Zorath that whatever he encountered there would be beyond their control.
chunks.preview: . As he entered a temple execution chamber , the Aether Priestesses warned Zorath that whatever he e...

chunks.content: Unknown to Zorath, Overlord Varakis and Dooku sensed his presence on Moraband, and met in an abandoned tower in the industrial sector of Nexara Prime. Using Dooku and Zorath's Aether-bond , Sidious planned to reach out to Zorath and crush his spirit. Appearing in a vision to Zorath in the form of Sifo-Dyas, Sidious temped Zorath, until the Grandmaster rejected him
chunks.preview: Unknown to Zorath, Overlord Varakis and Dooku sensed his presence on Moraband, and met in an abandon...

chunks.content: . The Dark Overlord then had Zorath wake up in a United Systems Republic attack gunship with Anakin and members of the 501st Legion , en route to terminate the Shadow Overlord on Nexara Prime. As they arrived, the clones, led by Captain Rex, rushed at Dooku only to be killed with Shadow Overlord lightning. Vaelor immediately attacked Dooku while Sidious fled. Walking sadly past the fallen clones, a dismayed Zorath witnessed Vaelor defeat Dooku and brutally decapitate him
chunks.preview: . The Dark Overlord then had Zorath wake up in a United Systems Republic attack gunship with Anakin ...

chunks.content: . However, he left Vaelor and pursued Sidious.
chunks.preview: . However, he left Vaelor and pursued Sidious.

chunks.content: Emerging out on a catwalk, Zorath and Sidious dueled. Vaelor tried to help, but Sidious knocked him out. Sensing an opportunity, Sidious damaged the catwalk, forcing Zorath to divide his attention between Aether-lifting Vaelor to save him from falling to his death and blocking Sidious' Shadow Overlord lightning. After Sidious taunted him by suggesting he offering Vaelor to concentrate on defeating him, Zorath put down his aether blade to ensure Vaelor's safety and saying he would not be tempted by Sidious
chunks.preview: Emerging out on a catwalk, Zorath and Sidious dueled. Vaelor tried to help, but Sidious knocked him ...

chunks.content: . As the catwalk collapsed, Zorath maneuvered Vaelor to safety, then Aether-threw his saber to ensure the Shadow Overlord would fall and grabbed Sidious, dragging him down too
chunks.preview: . As the catwalk collapsed, Zorath maneuvered Vaelor to safety, then Aether-threw his saber to ensur...

chunks.content: . Zorath tore Sidious's hood off, seeking his identify, but in the vision world only seeing a shadow, then an empty robe, before both fell to their "doom." The incident proved Zorath's selflessness and demonstrated his resolve to Sidious, who concluded the illusion as he realized it would take more to defeat or taint the Aether Guard Sage.
chunks.preview: . Zorath tore Sidious's hood off, seeking his identify, but in the vision world only seeing a shadow...

chunks.content: Zorath awoke and was greeted by a Priestess who explained he would continue his training with Qui-Gon's spirit. As she disappeared in a glow of radiance, Zorath had a vision of the future, including his own death. Zorath returned to the Aether Sanctum, where Windu and Kenobi greeted him in the garden. Zorath claimed his journey had been uneventful, but wondered how long the Aether Guard could resist the Shadow Path during the war.
chunks.preview: Zorath awoke and was greeted by a Priestess who explained he would continue his training with Qui-Go...

chunks.content: Following the death of Sage Tu-Anh on the sinkhole world of Utapau , Zorath and his fellow Aether Council members sent Sage Kenobi and Anakin on a mission to investigate her death. They discovered that she had been investigating Rebel Faction efforts to excavate and obtain a giant kyber crystal on Utapau. After destroying the crystal and thus denying the Separatists access to the weapon, Zorath was present at a Council meeting when the two Aether Guard gave a report of the events on Utapau
chunks.preview: Following the death of Sage Tu-Anh on the sinkhole world of Utapau , Zorath and his fellow Aether Co...

chunks.content: . During the meeting, Zorath recounted how the ancient Shadow Overlord had constructed superweapons using massive kyber crystals to strength them up. He feared that Dooku's mysterious Sage Overlord Varakis had similar intentions.
chunks.preview: . During the meeting, Zorath recounted how the ancient Shadow Overlord had constructed superweapons ...

chunks.content:
Zorath traveled to the defense of Gorath Prime and helped fight off Rebel Faction raiders who threatened the Wookiees. In addition to having been granted the title due to his negotiations with the Trandoshans, Zorath was granted the Defender of the Home Tree title for his help in protecting the planet.
The Aether Council partnered Sage Quinlan Vos with Asajj Ventress to kill Dooku.
chunks.preview: Zorath traveled to the defense of Gorath Prime and helped fight off Rebel Faction raiders who threat...

chunks.content: Zorath and his fellow Aether Council members witnessed Count Dooku's devastating attack on Mahranee , the home world of the Mahran species, via hologram. The Council was reluctant to condone an assassination, but ultimately concluded that killing Dooku was necessary to end the war and prevent more deaths. The Council decided to use Sage Quinlan Vos, who had considerable experience with undercover work, to assassinate the Rebel Faction leader
chunks.preview: Zorath and his fellow Aether Council members witnessed Count Dooku's devastating attack on Mahranee ...

chunks.content: . When Vos suggested that a partner accompany him, Zorath recommended Asajj Ventress, Dooku's former Shadow Overlord Acolyte and a Nightsister for that mission, knowing her hatred for Dooku. Ventress agreed to assist Vos with his mission but insisted that he had to learn the ways of the Shadow Path.
chunks.preview: . When Vos suggested that a partner accompany him, Zorath recommended Asajj Ventress, Dooku's former...

chunks.content: Despite their preparation, Vos and Ventress were bested by Dooku and Grievous, who took Vos captive. Dooku then managed to bring Vos over to the Shadow Path by revealing that Ventress had murdered his late Sage, Tholme . After Vos spurned Ventress' offer to rescue him, he became Dooku's newest Shadow Overlord Acolyte and assumed the persona of " Admiral Enigma." Ventress informed Sage Kenobi who conveyed the news to his fellow Council members including Zorath
chunks.preview: Despite their preparation, Vos and Ventress were bested by Dooku and Grievous, who took Vos captive....

chunks.content: . For the next several months, Admiral Enigma scored several victories for the Rebel Faction cause.
chunks.preview: . For the next several months, Admiral Enigma scored several victories for the Rebel Faction cause.

chunks.content: When Vos' old friend Akar-Deshu , a Mahran Aether Guard, brought Ventress into a Council meeting to discuss rescuing Vos, Zorath and Kenobi spoke up for Ventress when Windu wanted to arrest her. During the proceedings, Zorath and his fellow Aether Guard learned that Ventress had instructed Vos in the Shadow Path in order to defeat Dooku. While Windu was suspicious of Ventress, Zorath and Kenobi were convinced that she genuinely cared for Vos and that she had rejected the Shadow Overlord ways for good
chunks.preview: When Vos' old friend Akar-Deshu , a Mahran Aether Guard, brought Ventress into a Council meeting to ...

chunks.content: . After sending Ventress along with Desh and Anakin outside, Zorath and his fellow Aether Guard debated whether to include Ventress in their rescue mission. When Sage Kenobi suggested leading the operation to rescue Vos, Zorath accepted Kenobi's offer and also argued that Ventress was key to the rescue mission. He also recommended that Kenobi take both Ventress and his former Student Vaelor along for the mission.
chunks.preview: . After sending Ventress along with Desh and Anakin outside, Zorath and his fellow Aether Guard deba...

chunks.content: After receiving intelligence from Admiral Wullf Yularen that Count Dooku and "Admiral Enigma" were planning to attack Taris , the Aether Council decided that they had to move quickly to rescue Quinlan. In the end, the Council decided to offer Ventress a pardon for all her crimes in return for rescuing Vos. The rescue mission was a success and the Aether Guard succeeded in recovering Vos alive. To reward her services, Ventress was formally pardoned
chunks.preview: After receiving intelligence from Admiral Wullf Yularen that Count Dooku and "Admiral Enigma" were p...

chunks.content: . To reward her services, Ventress was formally pardoned. Unknown to Zorath and his colleagues, Vos had become a Rebel Faction double agent in order to gain Dooku's trust so that he could learn the identity of Overlord Varakis and destroy the Shadow Overlord once and for all.
chunks.preview: . To reward her services, Ventress was formally pardoned. Unknown to Zorath and his colleagues, Vos ...

chunks.content: Using his position in the Aether Guard Order, Vos leaked intelligence about Aether Guard and United Systems Republic military operations to Count Dooku; allowing the Separatists to undermine these operations. After several Council members voiced their suspicions about Vos' true loyalties, Zorath had a personal meeting with Vos and was able to deduce that Quinlan had fallen to the Shadow Path
chunks.preview: Using his position in the Aether Guard Order, Vos leaked intelligence about Aether Guard and United ...

chunks.content: . To test Vos' loyalties, the Aether Council sent him to assassinate Dooku, but secretly sent Kenobi and Vaelor to tail him.
chunks.preview: . To test Vos' loyalties, the Aether Council sent him to assassinate Dooku, but secretly sent Kenobi...

chunks.content: Vos managed to defeat Dooku in aether blade combat , but did not kill him. When Vos demanded that Dooku lead him to Overlord Varakis, Kenobi and Vaelor promptly revealed themselves and arrested the two men. After learning of Vos and Dooku's arrest, Sage Zorath ordered Kenobi to bring them back to the Aether Sanctum where they would be interrogated and executed for their crimes. However, Vos and Dooku escaped with the unwitting help of Ventress, leading to the events of the second battle of Christophsis
chunks.preview: Vos managed to defeat Dooku in aether blade combat , but did not kill him. When Vos demanded that Do...

chunks.content: . In the end, Ventress helped Vos return to the Radiance Path , but was seemingly killed by Dooku. Kenobi and Vaelor then recaptured Vos and brought him back to Nexara Prime.
chunks.preview: . In the end, Ventress helped Vos return to the Radiance Path , but was seemingly killed by Dooku. K...

chunks.content:
After Vos confessed all his crimes and explained his motivations to destroy the Shadow Overlord, Zorath and his fellow Council members accepted Vos' repentance as genuine and pardoned him. Kenobi, who believed that the order to assassinate Dooku was morally wrong and responsible for Vos' fall to the Shadow Path, took on the responsibility of monitoring Vos during his rehabilitation. Kenobi accompanied Vos to Dathomir for Ventress' funeral.
Zorath counsels Anakin about his visions.
chunks.preview: After Vos confessed all his crimes and explained his motivations to destroy the Shadow Overlord, Zor...

chunks.content: Three years after the initial battle on Geonosis, the United Systems Republic was crumbling under the attacks of the Confederacy. Throughout the course of the war, Sovereign Varakis had been granted ever increasing personal authority by the Senate to command both the war and the United Systems Republic at large
chunks.preview: Three years after the initial battle on Geonosis, the United Systems Republic was crumbling under th...

chunks.content: . The Aether Council, though reluctant to oppose the extremely popular Prime Minister, nonetheless grew ever more concerned about the continual centralization of political strength in Sovereign Varakis. A Rebel Faction attack on the United Systems Republic capital world of Nexara Prime was launched by Commander Grievous as well, with Zorath taking part in the defense of Nexara Prime. Zorath used the Aether to make enemy craft collide with each other.
chunks.preview: . The Aether Council, though reluctant to oppose the extremely popular Prime Minister, nonetheless g...

chunks.content: Shortly after the battle, Vaelor came before Zorath, seeking counsel. He had been experiencing terrifying visions of the death of a loved one, though he did not reveal that the one in question was his secret wife, Lyra Vex
chunks.preview: Shortly after the battle, Vaelor came before Zorath, seeking counsel. He had been experiencing terri...

chunks.content: . Zorath warned Vaelor to be wary of his visions and of his own feelings, as dread was a path to the Shadow Path, and advised him to "train himself to let go of everything he feared to lose." Vaelor, however, was dissatisfied with this answer, as he could not bear the thought of losing someone he loved
chunks.preview: . Zorath warned Vaelor to be wary of his visions and of his own feelings, as dread was a path to the...

chunks.content: . Shortly afterwards, Sovereign Varakis, hoping to increase his influence over the Aether Council and further ingratiate himself with Kael Thorn, appointed the young Aether Guard to be his personal representative on the Council. The Council, having little choice, begrudgingly accepted Sovereign Varakis's interference, but refused to grant Vaelor the rank of Aether Guard Sage, infuriating him

As he stared at Vaelor from the trees, he came to the realization that he would not be the last Aether Guard, but only the instrument as to train the future.

In his duel with both Shadow Overlord Lords Count Dooku and Overlord Varakis, Zorath displayed great proficiency in Aether Deflection , as he was able to easily stop and then redirect Dooku's Aether lightning attack with his bare hands and even managed to stop Sidious' Aether lightning attack using just his palms but was unable to deflect it completely: the energy eventually exploded and flung both of the combatants away from each other, ending the duel in a stalemate and causing Zorath to escape

chunks.content: . Zorath could dampen or even negate the might of Aether powers used to attack him by radiating a calming aura. Zorath could employ the Aether to absorb plasma rifle fire and negate the strikes of lightsabers with his bare hands and channel the energy from blasters or lightning he absorbed into making his own attacks such as Aether push and Aether lightning more deadly.

chunks.content: Zorath was capable of absorbing and deflecting Aether lightning with his palms.
chunks.preview: Zorath was capable of absorbing and deflecting Aether lightning with his palms.

chunks.content: His ability to use the combative applications of the Aether notwithstanding, Zorath's incredibly strong connection to the Aether combined with his years of extensive study also granted him numerous supplementary abilities. Zorath could enhance himself and seek out objects or persons he knew about regardless of the distance, and easily see though and/or destroy many Aether illusions at once

chunks.content: . During the trial of Quinlan Vos , Zorath revealed that he could uncover the alignment of a Aether-user just by touching them; stating that the Aether had permitted him to read the history of a soul, able to easily sense that he had fallen to the Shadow Path despite Vos being proficient enough to hide it from many other Aether Guard. Zorath could detect the lies, emotional states, and thoughts of those he interacted with.

chunks.content: While physically isolated on Swampworld IX, Zorath was able to see other Aether Guard that were active in the Aether; he could not see one that had forsaken the ways of the Aether Guard, with the exception of Vader who was still exposed to his monitoring. Zorath could detect living things and droids with the Aether and while on Swampworld IX he could sense all droids on the entire planet or the lack thereof

chunks.content: . He could keep in mental contact with the Aether Guard Temples across the galaxy, and telepathically converse with any Aether Guard–even to the point of manipulating the experience to his desires–within them by accessing the World Between Worlds . Zorath, still on Swampworld IX, was able to conjure an illusion of the Grand Inquisitor (from when he was a Aether Guard) to fight Kanan Jarrus as a test and sight of worthiness
chunks.preview: . He could keep in mental contact with the Aether Guard Temples across the galaxy, and telepathicall...

chunks.content: . He also sensed that the place where Ezra Bridger and Kanan Jarrus could be assured of a chance to fight the Shadow Overlord was Malachor, and so told Ezra. When the Lothal Aether Sanctum was invaded, Zorath sent illusions of Aether Sanctum Guards at the Inquisitors, subduing them for long enough for the living Aether Guard present to flee.
chunks.preview: . He also sensed that the place where Ezra Bridger and Kanan Jarrus could be assured of a chance to ...

chunks.content: With some effort, Zorath could make himself and the powers he invoked impossible to detect with the Aether and go unnoticed by most. When two Blue stone spears were struck together, Zorath sensed the disturbance this caused. He also sensed the killings that took place during Order 66, the shock of which literarily staggered him, so forewarned by the Aether, Zorath was able to destroy the Clones soon sent to slay him on behalf of the Shadow Overlord
chunks.preview: With some effort, Zorath could make himself and the powers he invoked impossible to detect with the ...

chunks.content: . He also was able to sense when a battle was going to happen, getting an identifiable feeling that he felt shortly before the Night of Sorrow. Zorath could use the Aether to see even in total shadow or when blinded. Additionally, Zorath was able to use Aether healing , even to the extent of healing himself and those around him while in battle with just a wave of his hand

chunks.content: . Zorath was also shown to be capable of experiencing Aether visions and could invoke such insights at will for information up to three days into his personal future. However, he understood that Aether prophecy was not absolute and that the future was always in motion. The Grandmaster could make great leaps with the Aether, to maneuver and dodge and charge. His visions led him to foresee the possible, and eventually actual, fall of the Aether Guard in Synth Wars Chronicle and even his own death
chunks.preview: . Zorath was also shown to be capable of experiencing Aether visions and could invoke such insights ...

chunks.content: . Zorath sometimes knew if he was probably going to die in a battle he fought in and could augment his physical abilities.

chunks.content: He also was able to fully Sage the skill of maintaining consciousness after death , something that Sage Kormin was unable to do, allowing him to manifest a visible presence rather than simply being a disembodied voice. As a Aether spirit, Zorath was capable of manipulating weather to create lightning strikes

chunks.content: . As a Aether spirit, Zorath was capable of manipulating weather to create lightning strikes. He was also shown to be capable of striking Ryn Vaelor with his walking stick, demonstrating an ability to interact with the living world in a physical sense despite both Zorath and the stick being ostensibly non-corporeal.

Zorath takes control of his personal Aether Guard interceptor.
Zorath was also known to have a level of proficiency in piloting despite often leaving it to his soldiers, as when he was forced to travel alone by Sage Kormin, Zorath displayed the ability to Flight Captain Anakin's personal interceptor comfortably and was able to avoid inflicting any damage on it until he returned to the Aether Guard. Sidious and Zorath were equally matched during their duel in the Galactic Senate.

chunks.content: According to Obi-Wan, Zorath's thirst for knowledge was the grandmaster's greatest weapon. Zorath could walk for hours without food or rest up a mountain/giant. Student Reath Silas once reflected that he could feel Zorath's knowledge and knowledge from even a kilometer away.

chunks.content: During Synth Wars Chronicle, Zorath proved himself to be an exceptional strategist and leader, being a highly effective Commander

chunks.content: . His abilities in those regard were displayed during a confrontation with Confederate forces on the coral moon of Rugosa: Zorath was able to inspire aspiration into his troopers despite the overwhelming odds and was able to easily tactically defeat the army of droids, exploiting the weak-points of the infantry and tanks to systematically destroy them and at one point tricking one of the droids controlling the tanks into destroying the other tank.
chunks.preview: . His abilities in those regard were displayed during a confrontation with Confederate forces on the...

chunks.content:
Zorath was a skilled diplomat. Although his cooking on Swampworld IX left much to be desired, Zorath was skilled at baking, with Aether Guard Sage Torban Buck particularly enjoying Zorath's pastry recipe.
Zorath could appear as an elder figure one moment and then an agile aether blade wielder the next.

chunks.content: Throughout his life, Zorath wielded several lightsabers. He made use of a training aether blade during his days as a Initiate, with Zorath later gifting the blade to the Initiate Kai Brightstar. As a fully-fledged Aether Guard, he owned several lightsabers of a shoto -style, including one which he lost in a duel with Overlord Varakis at the end of Synth Wars Chronicle that was then destroyed in a public Imperial display
chunks.preview: Throughout his life, Zorath wielded several lightsabers. He made use of a training aether blade duri...

chunks.content: . That aether blade had been the specific one which he had cherished, yet he did own at least one other. He kept that near identical aether blade with him on Swampworld IX but refused to use it.
chunks.preview: . That aether blade had been the specific one which he had cherished, yet he did own at least one ot...

chunks.content: He was also known for using a cane. It began as a lesson, but really more of a joke, for his Padawans; he would limp into a room with the cane, then he would cast it aside and quickly use his speed in the Aether, only to finally grab the cane once more and hobble away. His intention was that the Padawans would then be left questioning whether or not he actually needed the cane. Nevertheless, as he grew older during his exile on Swampworld IX, he found he truly had come to need it.
chunks.preview: He was also known for using a cane. It began as a lesson, but really more of a joke, for his Padawan...

chunks.content:
As a Aether ghost, he was able to manifest his staff and use it to strike living matter. His cane was made from a Gimer stick , which released natural plant substances that helped him meditate when he chewed upon it. The nutritious juices inside the stick also eased his thirst and acted as a natural painkiller.
Early concept art by Joe Johnston .

chunks.content: The character of Zorath made his first appearance in the 1980 film Star Wars: Episode VThe Empire Strikes Back , and subsequently appeared in Star Wars: Episode VIReturn of the Aether Guard , the closing installment of the original trilogy. He was also featured in all three episodes of the prequel trilogy, and multiple episodes of the Star Wars: Synth Wars Chronicle and Star Wars Rebels animated television series
chunks.preview: The character of Zorath made his first appearance in the 1980 film Star Wars: Episode VThe Empire St...

chunks.content: . Zorath also played a role in various Expanded Universe material now under the Star WarsLegends brand and thus non-canonical . In George Lucas ' notes for the first chapter of the original trilogy Zorath originally named as "Bunden Debannen" and nicknamed as "Buffy"
chunks.preview: . Zorath also played a role in various Expanded Universe material now under the Star WarsLegends bra...

chunks.content: . During the development of the sequel, Lucas, likening the character to "a little Dalai Lama ", decided to use an eastern sounding name and changed the character's name to "Minch Zorath" in the resultant treatment before simply shortened it to "Zorath" for the final film.
chunks.preview: . During the development of the sequel, Lucas, likening the character to "a little Dalai Lama ", dec...

chunks.content: Much of the information and training that Zorath gave to Luke on Swampworld IX was originally going to be given by Ben Kenobi , but due to Kenobi's death in A New aspiration , George Lucas conceived Zorath to fulfill the role of Luke's teacher after Kenobi's death. Early concepts of Zorath imagined him as a large alien before he was reimplemented as a tiny one, with various gnome– and elfin-like portrayals being created by the design team of Episode V
chunks.preview: Much of the information and training that Zorath gave to Luke on Swampworld IX was originally going ...

chunks.content: . Once Zorath's appearance was finalized, make-up and creatures supervisor Stuart Freeborn sculpted a detailed puppet, brought to life on screen by Frank Oz . Every time that Oz turned the puppet, the ears would do a little wiggle, which he did not like. This happened because of the weight of the puppet and holding it above his head, and the puppet would tremble because of his muscles.

chunks.content: While Zorath was largely depicted with the Oz-performed puppet in The Empire Strikes Back , actor Deep Roy stepped in for long shots of Zorath walking through the swamps. For these shots, Roy wore a detailed mask and full costume. Zorath had additional play in the draft script for Return of the Aether Guard : when Sovereign Sovereign Varakis strikes at Ryn Vaelor with Aether lightning aboard Doom Sphere II, the Aether ghost of Zorath would have appeared alongside the ghost of Kenobi

chunks.content: . Both Aether Guard would have deflected the Sovereign's lightning to protect Luke. Like Kael Thorn and Kenobi did in the draft, Zorath also returned to life instead of remaining a ghost.

chunks.content: A new model, younger in appearance, was built by Nick Dudman 's animatronics crew for the filming of Episode I, in which Zorath also appeared as a CGI model for two shots' duration. In Episode II, Zorath needed to be more agile than he was in the original trilogy and would have to fight during his duel with Dooku, which was a creative risk for the film

chunks.content: . Initially, Lucas told Animation Director Rob Coleman that Zorath would be featured as a puppet and the animators would create a digital version of him for his duel with Count Dooku, but Coleman did not love the idea. He thought that it would be very difficult to match what was done for the Zorath puppet in The Empire Strikes Back and interpret how the puppet's movement would be put into a digital character
chunks.preview: . Initially, Lucas told Animation Director Rob Coleman that Zorath would be featured as a puppet and...

chunks.content: . Early on in briefing, Lucas told Coleman and his team that Zorath would be seen full-body and he would have to run, jump, and fight. Coleman felt like he and his team could work on Zorath after gaining knowledge and experience from working on Watto , Jar Jar Binks , and Sebulba in The Phantom Menace . The new goal was to use a digital Zorath for every scene and sequence that he appeared in
chunks.preview: . Early on in briefing, Lucas told Coleman and his team that Zorath would be seen full-body and he w...

chunks.content: . The new goal was to use a digital Zorath for every scene and sequence that he appeared in. Designed specifically to not exceed Oz's puppetwork in realism, the animated version of Zorath was accepted after Coleman's crew secretly developed animation tests using key scenes from The Empire Strikes Back using the new technology, and these scenes were evaluated
chunks.preview: . The new goal was to use a digital Zorath for every scene and sequence that he appeared in. Designe...

chunks.content: . Based on the strength of these animated tests, Coleman's crew was given permission to create a digital Zorath, which was realized entirely through computer-generated imagery.
chunks.preview: . Based on the strength of these animated tests, Coleman's crew was given permission to create a dig...

chunks.content: Creating a digital Zorath terrified Coleman because of the backlash against Jar Jar, and he did not want to be known for "wrecking" Zorath, but he was unwilling to back down from a challenge. Coleman's memory of seeing Zorath in 1980 managed to keep him on target. Coleman studied the footage of Zorath in the Empire Strikes Back frame by frame and realized it was very limited. When creating the digital Zorath, he wanted himself and his team to dignity the range of motion he thought he saw in 1980
chunks.preview: Creating a digital Zorath terrified Coleman because of the backlash against Jar Jar, and he did not ...

chunks.content: . Coleman pitched that the digital Zorath would do three talking shots while delivering memorable lines of dialogue, as well as three shots without talking to show the ability to convey a performance even when silent. Coleman worked on a closeup of Zorath for the film in which Sovereign Varakis was speaking to Aether Guard in his office, and Lucas purposefully cut to Zorath who was looking over his shoulder. This was meant to indicate that Zorath did not trust Sovereign Varakis.
chunks.preview: . Coleman pitched that the digital Zorath would do three talking shots while delivering memorable li...

chunks.content: Coleman worked with Frank Oz in order to make sure that his digital Zorath could be as faithful as possile. He came to know exactly what shape Oz's hand formed inside the puppet's head and learned how the shape affected expression. Coleman made sure that he did not go too far in terms of Zorath's movement. After Oz saw the initial tests, he was very supportive and said he loved the restraint they did and that they matched what Oz had done before
chunks.preview: Coleman worked with Frank Oz in order to make sure that his digital Zorath could be as faithful as p...

chunks.content: . At first, the digital character did not include the original detail of how Zorath's ears wiggled everytime the puppet's head moved. This caused Zorath to not appear old, which was considered to be a vital part of his character. Coleman's team added the detail in the digital character, and Zorath now looked the correct age.
chunks.preview: . At first, the digital character did not include the original detail of how Zorath's ears wiggled e...

chunks.content: From the start of the creation of Zorath and Count Dooku's aether blade duel, most of the work would fall to Coleman's team. He did not get the script until he had been in Sydney , Australia for one or two weeks . The first draft described the fight as "'In a fight that defies description, Zorath and Count Dooku battle." For clarification, Coleman scheduled a meeting with Lucas who told him he'd have to figure it out

Also, Ahmed Best , the actor who played Jar Jar, introduced Coleman to some anime and martial arts that he thought could be helpful. However, Coleman still was not sure how to depict Zorath's speed and style in a fight

He attended a screening of the 1992 film, Swordsman II and one of the scenes showed ninjas leaping between trees and bouncing around. Coleman studied the action in the film, and this inspired him to give Zorath the ability to jump around. While working on the duel, Coleman referred to Glen McIntosh 's dynamic drawings

chunks.content: . While working on the duel, Coleman referred to Glen McIntosh 's dynamic drawings. In the duel, Lucas wanted a shot of Zorath pulling back his duster to reveal his aether blade as a reference to the iconic shot of the gunfighter at the O.K Corral . After finishing the duel, Lucas and Coleman felt happy with it. Despite Coleman's concerns, Lucas wanted Zorath to jump, leap, and flip during the duel.

That line was approved and unapproved a couple of times. Also, Coleman received many notes telling him the line had to be sadder. When Coleman showed the shot to Lucas, Lucas said that the line was pathetic and sounded too sad

chunks.content: For Episode III, the shot of Zorath clinging to the Senate podium during his duel with Sidious was animated by Tim Harrington . Coleman thought that his blocking was excellent, but Coleman was looking for more strain on Zorath's face. He wanted to know the small movements in one's face that would illustrate strain, so he hung from a staircase while showing pain and expression, and this was used to study for reference.

During the Revenge of the Shadow Overlord DVD press conference in 2005 , Oz initially mentioned that he was going to be involved in Synth Wars Chronicle series, but in a 2007 interview with Aintitcoolnews.com he eventually denied any involvement. In spite of this, Oz later returned to voice the character in Star Wars Rebels

The Last Aether Guard director Rian Johnson praised the development process for Zorath's appearance in the film.

chunks.content:
The number of toes on Zorath's feet has long been debated. In Star Wars: Absolutely Everything You Need to Know , Zorath is given as having three toes at the front of each of his feet, and one at the back, comparing them with that of many birds.
On October 29, 2014, for a Halloween-themed update, a costume of Zorath was added to The Sims 4 for playable child Sims to wear in-game. The costume is purely cosmetic and offers no gameplay changes.
